job.title: AI Supervisor, Scripted - FoxNXT
job.description: OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY FOX Entertainment With a legacy spanning nearly 40 years, FOX Entertainment is one of the world’s most recognizable media brands and a leading global creator of multi-genre content across broadcast, streaming, digital and emerging platforms. Known for its independent, innovative spirit and bold storytelling, the company is committed to reaching audiences where they are through a platform- and format-agnostic approach to developing, testing and scaling intellectual property worldwide. FOX Entertainment consists of three core business units. The FOX Television Network, which encompasses its flagship linear platform and streaming partnerships with Hulu and FOX One, is home to hit series including The Simpsons, The Masked Singer, Doc, Memory of a Killer, Fear Factor: House of Fear, The Floor and Hell’s Kitchen. FOX Entertainment Studios, operates the in-house scripted and unscripted studios behind series such as Animal Control, Best Medicine, The Faithful, and The Way Home, as well as Bento Box Entertainment with animated hits such as Hazbin Hotel and Krapopolis; Studio Ramsay Global with Next Level Chef, Gordon Ramsay’s Secret Service and Knife Edge: Chasing Michelin Stars; entertainment studio TMZ; and the independent film label Tideline. FOX Entertainment Global is the company’s worldwide content sales and distribution arm. As part of its evolution into a modern next-gen studio, FOX Entertainment is expanding its digital storytelling ecosystem with investments across vertical video with Holywater, Chain’s experiential storytelling, podcasting with Meet Cute, a two-way content pipeline with HarperCollins Publishing, and creator-led formats through the newly formed FOX Creator Studios. Through these strategic initiatives, the company is investing earlier in emerging ideas and new forms of audience engagement, while maintaining the ability to grow successful concepts into premium franchises across broadcast, streaming and global platforms. A prolific content creator and production partner, FOX Entertainment collaborates with leading studios, creators, and platforms worldwide to produce and distribute premium content at scale across broadcast, streaming, and digital ecosystems, while continuing to grow its portfolio of owned IP and next-generation storytelling formats. JOB DESCRIPTION The AI Supervisor, Scripted is responsible for building and executing AI powered workflows for scripted content. This role partners with production teams to reimagine how scripted content is developed, captured, and delivered using AI, driving efficiency, scalability, and new creative formats. You will operate in a highly experimental environment, translating early-stage tolls into real world production pipelines. Regular, on-site attendance at the workplace for a minimum of four (4) days per week is an essential function of the position. The selected candidate must be able to reliably meet this requirement A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES Lead AI enabled scripted projects from concept through execution and delivery Design and implement production workflows from scratch that integrate AI into scripted formats Conduct intake sessions with studio and production teams to identify opportunities for AI integration Define project scope, timelines, deliverables, and resource plans for AI driven productions Collaborate with R&D and technical teams to test and deploy new AI tools in live production environments Oversee field, post-production, and delivery workflows with a focus on speed and scalability Manage across functional teams, vendors, and production partners. Identify risks, solve problems, and adapt workflows in rapidly evolving production environments WHAT YOU WILL NEED 7+ years of experience in scripted production Experience with data driven storytelling and automated editing workflows Fluency in field production, post production workflows, and delivery pipelines Familiarity with AI tools for transcription, logging, editing, or content generation Ability to build processes in fast moving and ambiguous environments Strong stakeholder management and communication skills Excellent time management and ability to consistently meet deadlines in high-pressure, fast paced settings We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable law. Pursuant to state and local pay disclosure requirements, the pay rate/range for this role, with final offer amount dependent on education, skills, experience, and location is $114,000.00-150,000.00 annually. This role is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus, various benefits, including medical/dental/vision, insurance, a 401(k) plan, paid time off, and other benefits in accordance with applicable plan documents. Benefits for Union represented employees will be in accordance with the applicable collective bargaining agreement. View more detail about FOX Benefits.

job.title: News Producer
job.description: OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY Fox TV Stations FOX Television Stations (FTS) owns and operates 29 full power broadcast television stations, including stations in 14 of the top 15 markets and duopolies in 11. Eighteen are FOX Network affiliates, and together the stations produce approximately 1,300 hours of local news every week. FOX LOCAL, the company's free ad-supported digital and streaming product, extends that news, weather and local content across connected TV & mobile devices. LiveNOW from FOX expands the FTS portfolio even further as the only national streaming services to be truly live 24/7, covering breaking news and events as they happen. JOB DESCRIPTION WTXF- Fox 29 Philadelphia is a dynamic and forward-thinking news station committed to delivering high-quality news content to our audience. We are seeking a passionate, enthusiastic, and creative News Leader to join our team and help shape the future of our broadcasts. The ideal candidate will have a real passion for owning a show, the ability to collaborate effectively across teams, and the creative vision to help develop multi-platform show concepts that thrive on both broadcast and streaming. Position Overview: We are looking for a talented Line Producer with a proven track record and a dedicated, driven, and tireless work ethic. The ideal candidate will have a real passion for owning a show and the ability to collaborate effectively with on-air talent, writers, and editors on all editorial issues. Key Responsibilities: Produce all elements of our newscasts, including leads, stories, teases, and breakouts. Mine social media for information and integrate it into our news coverage. Participate in the selection and development of stories, ensuring comprehensive coverage of news events. Run the control room editorially during shows and breaking news situations. Innovate and bring ideas to evolve our broadcasts, attracting a demographically driven audience. Pitch and produce creative content tailored for OTT/streaming platforms, developing show concepts and digital-first segments that expand our reach beyond linear broadcast. Drive innovative show ideas and adapt broadcast content for our streaming platforms to engage on-demand viewers across digital ecosystems. Qualifications: Strong writing and show production skills. Strong editorial knowledge and active decision-making abilities. Excellent news judgment, writing skills, and knowledge of current events. Exceptional communication and people skills. Knowledge of TV production techniques and newsroom computer systems. A strong background in entertainment and talk programming is a plus. LiveNOW from FOX expands the FTS portfolio even further as the only national streaming services to be truly live 24/7, covering breaking news and events as they happen. JOB DESCRIPTION FOX 2 Detroit is seeking a visionary, competitive Vice President, News Director to lead our newsroom in the vibrant Detroit market. We need an innovative storyteller and dynamic people-leader who can reimagine local news, move beyond traditional broadcast formats, and aggressively leverage digital and streaming platforms to elevate our brand. In this position, you will discover, nurture, and develop compelling, consumer-focused content that enlightens and empowers our audience daily. Reporting directly to the SVP/General Manager, you will serve as an empathetic, high-impact leader dedicated to mentoring talent, driving continuous growth, ensuring journalistic integrity, and executing a forward-thinking digital strategy. Key Responsibilities Executive Leadership & Team Development: Oversee all daily newsroom operations in close collaboration with the SVP/General Manager; actively coach, mentor, and empower journalists, producers, and managers to maximize their professional growth. Culture & Conflict Resolution: Constructively resolve workplace challenges, address team concerns with tact and diplomacy, and champion a fair, balanced, and collaborative newsroom environment. Multi-Platform Strategy: Partner with the Executive Producer of Streaming to execute a modern, digital-first content strategy across broadcast, web, social, and streaming platforms. Operational Management: Direct the news department’s budget, expenses, technology integration, and long-term strategic planning. Journalistic Integrity: Set and uphold strict standards for journalistic ethics, accuracy, fairness, and libel/privacy compliance. Community Engagement: Build strong relationships with internal department heads, corporate leadership, and key Detroit community leaders. Labor & Talent: Negotiate personal service agreements (PSAs) and navigate labor contract administration. Qualifications & Requirements Leadership & People Management Proven track record as a strong, compassionate leader with exceptional supervisory, team-building, and motivational capabilities. Demonstrated ability to navigate sensitive workplace situations with high emotional intelligence, sound judgment, and professionalism. Passion for talent development—discovering, recruiting, and actively cultivating high-performing journalism and production talent. Excellent interpersonal, written, and presentation skills with an approachable, open-door management style. Experience & Background Minimum of 5 years managing a newsroom team, with a track record of launching successful new programs. Proven leadership experience within a Top 30 TV market. Demonstrated success transforming traditional news operations into digital-focused, multi-platform operations. Practical background managing multiple hours of daily live newscasts and broadcasts. Technical & Operational Skills Bachelor’s degree in Journalism, Communications, or a related field preferred. Strong technical acumen across newsroom computer systems (including iNews preferred), broadcast technology, and engineering workflows. Thorough knowledge of media law, privacy issues, and journalistic ethics. Hands-on expertise in newsroom system optimization, budgeting, purchasing, and cost control. Forward-thinking insight into the future of local news, streaming, and digital distribution. Why FOX 2 Detroit? Be part of a dynamic, forward-looking media organization that values bold storytelling, continuous innovation, and investing in its people. If you are a visionary newsroom leader ready to build talent and shape the future of local journalism in Detroit, we want to hear from you. #LI-AP2 We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. JOB DESCRIPTION This role sits at the intersection of Sales, Content, and Talent, owning the development of strategic sponsorship and custom programs while serving as the primary revenue partner to podcast hosts and show teams. As our Revenue Partnerships Lead, you will build and lead a high-performing team that transforms creator audiences into powerful, cross-platform revenue engines. You will architect innovative sponsorship packages that start with audio but extend seamlessly across every extension our creators own. Sitting at the strategic intersection of content and sales, it will be a key revenue generator in the entire organization. A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES Serve as the primary commercial partner to podcast hosts, creators, and show teams, helping align content, audience insights, and sponsorship opportunities to maximize revenue growth. Along with Creator Partnerships and Sales, contribute to monthly revenue and business review meetings with hosts and show stakeholders, providing updates on revenue performance, pipeline activity, upcoming sponsorship opportunities, market trends, and growth initiatives. Develop strategic and custom packaging recommendations and monetization plans tailored to individual shows and talent portfolios. Partner with Sales Leadership, Account Executives and Creator teams to identify new sponsorship opportunities, optimize inventory, and maximize yield across the podcast portfolio. Communicate marketplace feedback, advertiser demand, and audience insights to hosts and show teams to inform future partnership opportunities. Lead solution creation from initial strategy through proposal development and pre-sale project management. Assess feasibility and align stakeholders across departments to ensure programs can be executed successfully. To connect with us, visit www.usatodayco.com The Milwaukee Journal Sentinel, part of the USA TODAY NETWORK, is seeking an experienced reporter with multimedia skills to advance our daily, enterprise and explanatory higher education coverage. Our aim is to deepen and grow our connection with our audience, fully tapping into stories that resonate with students, parents, employers, taxpayers, faculty and administrators. Coverage includes public and private four-year colleges and universities as well as technical colleges — a broad range of stories requiring a mix of interests and skills. In Wisconsin, the state’s university system is at a pivotal point, as it copes with turnover in three key roles: the system president, chancellor of the state’s flagship university in Madison and athletic director. The ideal candidate will be able to understand budgets and funding, explain policy concerns and navigate the political and demographic changes that are creating a period of upheaval in higher education. This reporter must demonstrate curiosity and be able to shift easily between different topics, such as the burden of student debt, interesting research, campus trends and education institutions’ efforts to reimagine their mission. Success in the job will require: • Effort in reaching new audiences. We need someone who can mix creative stories aimed at drawing new readers and in-depth enterprise that will satisfy longtime subscribers. • Flexibility in how to approach stories. We need someone comfortable telling stories via text, audio and video, and able to identify the right format for each story. The reporter should be able to tell stories quickly when needed, in-depth when called for and always with accuracy. • Familiarity with the demands of a digital world. We need someone who can ensure content is optimized with strong headlines, links, video and photo galleries, aware of the contribution strong SEO can play in reaching our readers. • Commitment to diversity in topics and sources. We need someone who sees all facets of higher education and how it intersects with people of different backgrounds. • We're looking for someone who can smoothly partner with other reporters when stories touch multiple beats, bringing greater context to our readers. • Patience and drive in creating a rich source network. We need someone who is able to put issues in state and national context. • Ability to step back and see larger stories, and put issues in state and national context. We need someone who can maintain the rhythm of a daily beat while recognizing topics that are ripe for broader exploration or investigation. Requirements: • Bachelor's or master’s in communications, journalism or an equivalent combination of education and experience. • Minimum of three years of reporting experience. • Strong command of newswriting grammar and style. • Strong copy-editing skills and the ability to produce content that is clean, accurate and publication ready. • Is passionate and enthusiastic about news and content that will work well with audiences on social platforms. • Is comfortable using social media platforms to enhance reporting and deliver stories. • Understands reporting ethics and sourcing. • Excels in a fast-paced news environment and understands the digital first mission. • Collaborates well with others and can work with a team on the biggest stories. • Must be willing to travel on short notice to cover breaking news events. • This role requires a valid driver’s license, reliable transportation, and the minimum liability insurance required by state law. Application instructions We are eager to learn more about you and how you fit this role. When you apply, don’t limit your upload to a resume; show us what you’ve done. To do so, please submit: 1. To connect with us, visit www.usatodayco.com Integrated Media Specialist – Outside Sales Territory-Based | Hybrid | Client-Facing Market Role Company: LocaliQ, powered by the USA TODAY Network Location: Outside Sales, territory-based role in Port Huron, MI | Hybrid (Remote + In-territory) About LocaliQ At LocaliQ, part of USA TODAY Co., we help businesses grow by bringing together advanced marketing technology, trusted audience reach, and the expertise to turn it into results. In this role, you’ll work at the intersection of digital marketing and one of the most trusted media networks in the country—helping businesses connect with customers across the full marketing funnel. You’ll partner with clients to understand their goals, build strategies that combine performance-driven digital solutions with the reach of the USA TODAY Network, and deliver measurable outcomes. This is an opportunity to be part of a team that doesn’t just sell products. We bring together the right mix of solutions to drive real business growth. About the Role Our Integrated Media Specialist role is a consultative, relationship-driven sales position for someone who loves owning the full sales cycle—from net-new prospecting through long-term account growth—and who thrives in both hunting and managing client relationships. In this role, you will actively hunt for net-new business, while also managing, growing, and expanding an ongoing book of clients. You’ll create tailored marketing strategies, guide businesses from first conversation through ongoing performance discussions, and continually identify opportunities to deepen partnerships over time. You’ll act as a trusted marketing partner—not a transactional seller—balancing new business development with retention, upsell, and account expansion to drive long-term client value. Our Integrated Media Specialist role is partnered with a post-sales team that manages campaign performance, optimizes results, and prepares reporting. Additional support resources are available, including the Data and Insights team, Client Strategists, and other product-specific resources. In your first 90 days, you’ll gain confidence in LocaliQ’s solutions, tools, and sales approach while building meaningful prospecting and discovery habits. By the end of this period, you’ll be owning your territory and sales cycle end-to-end, with the support and coaching needed to set you up for long-term success. Why This Role Stands Out: • Competitive base salary with uncapped commission and strong earning potential • Contests, and recognition programs for top performers • Consultative, full-cycle sales role with ownership from first conversation through long-term account growth • Hybrid flexibility with autonomy to manage your schedule and territory • Strong onboarding, coaching, and sales enablement to support a successful ramp • Access to an extensive mix of digital and traditional marketing solutions, enabling consultative, end-to-end strategies tailored to each client’s growth objectives • Career progression into senior sales and leadership roles • Backed by marketing expertise, post-sale specialists, and industry-leading tools What You Will Do • Build a consistent prospecting cadence using cold calls, email, social outreach, networking, and in-person or virtual meetings to develop a strong pipeline. • Manage and grow a territory by balancing new business development, client retention, and account expansion. • Lead thoughtful discovery conversations to understand business goals, marketing challenges, and growth opportunities. • Build and present data-informed digital and traditional marketing proposals that connect strategy, tactics, and budget to client goals. • Own the full sales cycle—from initial outreach through close—while maintaining accurate CRM activity, pipeline management, and forecasting. • Partner with internal account management, creative, and strategy teams to support strong client outcomes. • Stay engaged post-sale through reporting, optimization, and performance conversations that support renewals and continued growth. Qualifications • 3+ years of B2B sales experience with success in new business development, account growth, or business development roles (experience level may vary by market and role level; Recruiter to update). • Ability to run a full-cycle, consultative sales process—from discovery through proposal, negotiation, and close. • Strong prospecting skills across phone, email, social, networking, and relationship-based outreach. • Experience using CRM and sales tools with disciplined pipeline management and follow-up. • Comfort learning and discussing digital marketing solutions such as search, social, display, and video (direct experience is a plus, not required). • Excellent communication skills, business curiosity, and the ability to build credibility with diverse clients and stakeholders, influencing decisions through clear data-driven recommendations. • Proficiency with CRM, Microsoft Office Suite, and AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot and Perplexity. • Valid driver’s license and vehicle insurance Who Thrives Here High performers in this role are resilient, self-motivated, strategic and creative minded and competitive, with a strong drive to outperform and continuously take on greater impact. They are coachable and highly self-directed, comfortable initiating outreach, staying organized, asking thoughtful questions, and using data and tools to work efficiently. Energized by real-time results, they handle rejection well and maintain full ownership of their performance and trajectory. Benefits We believe high performance should be recognized and supported through compensation, development, and real opportunity to grow your skills. • Competitive base salary + Uncapped commission opportunity • 401(k) with company match • Career progression opportunities • Flexibility and autonomy in a hybrid/remote work environment • High-performance culture with recognition, incentives • Comprehensive health, dental & vision coverage options and more • Unlimited MTO time off, including paid holidays • Structured onboarding to get you ramped fast • Ongoing coaching from experienced leaders • Access to industry-leading tools, resources, and marketing expertise Step into a territory where you can own the full sales cycle, bring smart marketing solutions to the table, and be recognized for the results you deliver. If you’re ready to grow your career and be part of a high-performing team, we encourage you to apply. #LI-AM #LI-Remote The annualized base salary for this role will range between $50,000 and $65,000. $83,333-$108,333 OTE. To connect with us, visit www.usatodayco.com Michigan labor/state workers reporter: The Lansing State Journal/lsj.com is seeking a journalist who is passionate about labor and issues of importance to the state of Michigan’s workforce as well as other unionized employees in healthcare, K-12 education and at Michigan State University. This beat is framed around the state’s 53,000 state workers, about 15,000 of which live and work in the Lansing area. This is not a traditional state government reporting position focused on the Legislature or the news of the day from the Capitol. Rather, it’s focused on staffing levels, working conditions, pay, benefits, work-from-home, state office space and other issues involving the state workforce. The successful candidate is expected to be able to attract audience locally and across the state by drilling in on issues that are critical to the state’s workforce. The beat also includes some degree of state politics on a local level for the Greater Lansing region, which includes 12 state legislators and two U.S. House seats. We’re looking for an experienced journalist who can balance daily journalism with enterprise and investigative reporting, someone who can identify high-interest issues on the beat, cut through the political messaging and produce explanatory and revelatory journalism that is meaningful to readers. The reporter will be expected to identify trends across the region and state, pivot between different topics and consistently produce content that resonates with current readers and helps grow our audience, especially within underserved communities. The reporter must be attuned to political trends, alliances and influence in polarizing times and deliver coverage that holds public officials accountable and helps readers make informed decisions about their community. This beat is one of the lead investigative positions in our newsroom. The reporter must excel at developing professional sources, identifying important details in public documents, using FOIA to uncover records and have a dedication to relentless accuracy. The reporter must consistently – and persistently – dig below the surface and bring clarity to the issues they are covering. The reporter must be able to work collaboratively and effectively in a team with reporters who cover business and development, crime and courts, regional communities, trending news, local government and other topics, and demonstrate an awareness of and adherence to the highest journalistic ethical standards. Responsibilities: • Identifies key issues through source development, data analysis and document reporting. • Shapes coverage with independent judgment and strategic insight. • Collaborates closely with editors to set priorities and deadlines. • Produces high impact, multi platform work with a disciplined approach. • Uses audience metrics to inform coverage plans and meet reader needs. • Writes clearly and concisely, with strong nut graphs and clear relevance. • Develops and executes distribution and optimization strategies. • Delivers strong reader service, helping audiences find answers and solutions. • Builds trust and credibility within the coverage area. Requirements: • Bachelor's degree in communications, journalism, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. • Minimum of two years of reporting experience. • Energetic self-starter and quick thinker who can identify stories that matter. • Ability to multitask and perform well in a fast-paced environment under tight deadlines. • Ability to work collaboratively and efficiently with a team of journalists. • Strong communication skills, news judgment, and headline-writing ability. • Strong interpersonal skills, including empathy and compassion. • Proficiency in social media platforms, including but not limited to Facebook, Twitter, Threads, Instagram, TikTok, and Reddit, with experience engaging readers in this public space. • Experience shooting and editing photos and videos on an iPhone. • Excellent writing, spelling, and grammar skills with knowledge of AP style. • Understanding of media law and principles of ethical conduct. • Fluency in Spanish is a plus. • This role requires a valid driver’s license, reliable transportation, and the minimum liability insurance required by state law. Application Instructions We are eager to learn more about you and how you fit this role. When you apply, don’t limit your upload to a resume; show us what you’ve done. To do so, put together a single document file that includes the following, in this order: 1. Your resume – one to two pages. 2. A cover letter that outlines how you would approach the job. 3. Links to 3-6 online samples of your work. Show us what best reflects what you can do in your desired role. It is important that these items be assembled into a single document and uploaded in PDF format. Completing these steps will ensure that your application receives the highest consideration. job.title: Reporter
job.description: |Current USA TODAY Co. Employees- Please ensure you are using our abbreviated process on the internal Careers site by logging into Dayforce through MyApps| USA TODAY Co., Inc. is a diversified media company with expansive reach at the national and local level dedicated to empowering and enriching communities. We seek to inspire, inform, and connect audiences as a sustainable, growth focused media and digital marketing solutions company. Through our trusted brands, including the USA TODAY NETWORK, comprised of the national publication, USA TODAY, and local media organizations, including our network of local properties, in the United States, and Newsquest, a wholly-owned subsidiary operating in the United Kingdom, we provide essential journalism, local content, and digital experiences to audiences and businesses. We deliver high-quality, trusted content with a commitment to balanced, unbiased journalism, where and when consumers want to engage. Our digital marketing solutions brand, LocaliQ, supports small and medium-sized businesses with innovative digital marketing products and solutions. USA TODAY Co. open roles are featured on various external job boards. When applying to a position at USA TODAY Co., you should be completing an application on USA TODAY Co. Careers via Dayforce. Job postings directing you to complete an application on other external sites may not be valid. If you are a California resident, you acknowledge that by applying for a job with us, this California Job Applicant Privacy Notice will apply to our collection, use, and disclosure of your personal information. To connect with us, visit www.usatodayco.com The Erie Times-News and GoErie.com, part of the USA TODAY Network, seek an ambitious public trust and accountability journalist to help residents understand how public institutions shape life across Erie County, Pennsylvania. This is not a traditional government reporting role. We're looking for a reporter who understands that meaningful accountability journalism is about outcomes, not process. Rather than focusing on meetings and political statements, this reporter examines whether public promises produce results, how taxpayer dollars are spent and how decisions made by governments and public agencies affect people's lives. The public trust and accountability reporter covers governance, transparency, public investment and institutional performance. They'll build sources throughout the community, use records and data to find answers and pursue the questions residents most want answered. Politicians and administrators are not the center of the story. Accountability is. Coverage may include public spending, infrastructure, neighborhood conditions, budgets, government transparency, civic participation, boards and commissions and long-term tracking of major public initiatives. The reporter will work closely with colleagues covering housing, public safety, education, health and business, leading accountability reporting that cuts across every beat. We're seeking a journalist who combines strong enterprise instincts with community engagement skills and a passion for helping residents navigate public systems. Video journalism is a core responsibility, and the successful candidate will regularly produce visual storytelling that explains complex issues and connects directly with audiences. Candidates should have facility with AI and automation and experience using those tools to enhance their journalism. Typical job duties • Creates storytelling that accurately informs, engages and empowers audiences. • Produces accountability and enterprise journalism focused on government performance, transparency and public outcomes. • Develops deep sourcing among residents, community leaders, public officials and institutional stakeholders. • Builds and maintains long-term reporting arcs that track promises, implementation efforts and measurable outcomes. • Uses data, public records and document-driven reporting to uncover trends and hold institutions accountable. • Produces video, social and digital storytelling that expands the reach and impact of reporting. • Collaborates with audience, visual, investigative and beat reporters across the newsroom. • Works with content and audience strategists to identify information needs and strengthen community engagement. • Captures basic photos and video when appropriate. • Promotes personal brand, newsroom brands and the USA TODAY Network mission. • Provides outstanding service journalism by helping readers find answers and navigate public systems. Requirements • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience. • Proven record of strong reporting and enterprise journalism. • Ability to develop sources and build trust across diverse communities. • Strong news judgment and accountability reporting instincts. • Experience using public records, data and document-driven reporting. • Excellent interviewing, research and storytelling skills. • Knowledge of AP style. • Understanding of digital audience needs, SEO and social media strategy. • Experience producing or appearing in video journalism is preferred. • Strong ethical standards and commitment to accurate, fair reporting. • Willingness to experiment with new tools and storytelling formats, including responsible use of AI. • Ability to collaborate effectively across teams and within the USA TODAY Network. • Comfort balancing breaking news demands with longer-term enterprise projects. • Valid driver's license, reliable transportation and minimum state-required auto insurance. About Erie County Set on the shores of Lake Erie, Erie County offers journalists the chance to cover a community of more than 260,000 -- big enough to matter and small enough to make an impact. The region combines a freshwater coastline, rich history, vibrant arts and cultural amenities and abundant outdoor recreation with affordability and accessibility often missing in larger markets. Buffalo, Cleveland and Pittsburgh are within easy driving distance. Yes, winters can be cold and snowy, but they are part of the region's character and resilience. For journalists who want their work to be seen, felt and remembered, Erie remains a place where strong reporting can genuinely make a difference. Application instructions We are eager to learn more about you and how you fit this role. When you apply, don’t limit your upload to a resume; show us what you’ve done. To do so, put together a single document file that includes the following, in this order: 1. Your resume – one to two pages. 2. A cover letter that outlines how you would approach the job. 3. Links to 3-6 online samples of your work. Show us what you’ve produced or had a hand in that best reflects what you can do in your desired role. It is important that these items be assembled into a single document and uploaded in PDF format. Completing these steps will ensure that your application receives the highest consideration. Qualifications • 1+ years of customer service, account support, administrative, sales support, operations, or related experience preferred. • Associate degree preferred; a comparable combination of education, experience, and/or training may be considered. • Experience working in a deadline-driven environment preferred. • Experience using CRM systems such as Salesforce preferred. • Strong verbal and written communication skills. • Strong attention to detail, organization, and follow-through. • Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously. • Strong customer service orientation and professional communication skills. • Process-driven, accountable, and comfortable following established sales and lead management processes. • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment. • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to learn new systems and processes quickly. • Ability to adapt to change and support organizational transformation initiatives. • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, email, Salesforce, and other sales or business systems. • Valid driver’s license and vehicle insurance Who Thrives Here High performers in this role are curious, organized, resilient, and highly accountable. They enjoy connecting with people, asking thoughtful questions, learning new tools and processes, and building strong daily sales habits. They are comfortable with outbound outreach, motivated by activity and progress, and able to stay focused in a deadline-driven environment. They are also strong collaborators who communicate clearly, follow through on details, and take ownership of how their work contributes to the broader sales organization. This is a great opportunity for someone who wants to build a foundation in sales, learn from experienced leaders, and grow into future opportunities within LocaliQ. job.title: Broadcast Operations Technician
job.description: WTAE-TV, the ABC affiliate in Pittsburgh, PA, is seeking an experienced Broadcast Operations Technician to join our Engineering team. This position is responsible for delivering and monitoring the station’s on-air signals from content acquisition through distribution. The successful candidate will support both in-studio and remote production operations and report directly to the Assistant Chief Engineer . Responsibilities Operate and manage file-based broadcast workflows, including media preparation, playlist management, recording schedules, and robotic camera shot recall. Provide creative input and work with newscast producers and production crew. Staff the master control room to operate and monitor studio and transmission equipment, including: Broadcast automation systems Robotic cameras Satellite downlinks HD video servers Ensure the accurate execution of on-air playlists, commercial breaks, and programming. Perform floor directing duties during live and recorded productions, communicating effectively with anchors, reporters, and other on-air talent to ensure seamless coordination between the production control room and the studio. Operate and monitor news automation systems to ensure clean technical execution of the newscast. Monitor video and audio quality using waveform monitors, vectorscopes, and other quality control equipment to ensure broadcast standards are met. Quickly identify technical issues and communicate equipment problems promptly to Engineering staff to minimize operational disruptions. Support station operations during live broadcasts, special events, and remote productions. Qualifications Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while maintaining exceptional attention to detail. Strong decision-making skills with the ability to troubleshoot issues and respond effectively under time-sensitive conditions. Highly proficient with computers and comfortable learning new software and broadcast technologies. Understanding of newsroom ENPS and video playback systems. job.description: Business Affairs Director Overview Hearst Media Production Group (HMPG) is seeking a Business Affairs Director to join our team. This position will primarily focus on compliance with FCC-mandated rules for Educational/Informational (E/I) television production and distribution and oversight of rights, clearances, and general production documentation in addition to business issues surrounding HMPG’s general market entertainment. Will work with leadership to maintain HMPG brand integrity of all current series and to manage day-to-day business affairs for development and production. The Business Affairs Director will also draft, review and close various short-form business and production documents. As such, a legal background and/or related experience in the media and/or entertainment industry is required. The position reports to the Vice President, Business Affairs. The position is on-site for four (4) days at our Hearst offices in either Glendale, CA or Charlotte, NC. Responsibilities Review, negotiate, and draft short-form business, production, and vendor documents including location, third-party acquired materials, and appearance releases, production services agreements, permits, letters of intent, NDAs, etc. in coordination with the production management team, Rights & Clearances team, and in-house and external counsel. Partner with management, sales, production, post-production, regulatory counsel, and network partners to ensure content compliance with applicable FCC, FTC, COPPA, and other regulations, while maintaining HMPG brand integrity and industry standards. Assist Vice President, Business Affairs in overseeing Rights & Clearances and Standard & Practices. Support Standards & Practices team responsible for content review, with an emphasis on compliance with E/I regulations, legal clearance, and appropriate execution of branded content. Assist on rights management efforts via the RightsLine database. Engage in logistics and issues surrounding program sponsorships, schedules, content and contractual obligations. Collaborate with internal and external counsel when necessary. Experience Minimum of 5 years of experience working in television business affairs department, legal affairs department and/or entertainment law firm. Qualifications Precision in reviewing, annotating, and drafting agreements. Familiarity with FCC, FTC, and COPPA (and related online privacy) regulations. Familiarity with copyright and trademark laws and regulations. Previous experience in performing legal and/or clearance review of episodic or long form audio/visual content. Experience with market-leading enterprise rights management systems. Skilled at maintaining positive relationships with showrunners and sales executives while enforcing standards and decisions and protecting HMPG’s interests. Ability to make judgement calls on sensitive topics, removing personal opinions from decision-making process. Proven ability to manage a high volume of projects with competing deadlines. Excellent organization and time management skills. Superior written and oral communication skills, with proven ability to communicate effectively and collegially with C-Suite and all colleagues, as well as with outside parties in negotiations. Detail-oriented with strong analytical capabilities and judgement. Familiarity with music rights and cue sheets, production insurance, and union issues a plus. Working knowledge of project management software, preferably Monday.com. Education Law degree (J.D. or LLM) a plus. HMPG is a proud supporter of military veterans. job.description: Hearst Television is seeking a News Producer to join our Washington, D.C. News Bureau. In this role, you’ll help deliver major national political stories and meaningful local angles to our 28 newsrooms and digital platforms. You’ll coordinate coverage, create and edit multiplatform content, and keep stations informed as stories develop — all while working at the center of national politics. This is an in-person role based in Washington, D.C., reporting to the Deputy Bureau Chief. The work requires close collaboration with bureau journalists, station newsrooms, photographers, technical teams, and Hearst partners, particularly during breaking news and deadline-driven coverage. What You'll Do Plan and execute daily and breaking-news coverage for Hearst Television stations, combining strong editorial judgment, production skills, and logistical coordination to deliver accurate, timely, and locally relevant journalism across broadcast and digital platforms, while seeking and incorporating enterprise content elements from our national data, investigative, and consumer teams and our Hearst partners. We are looking for a self-motivated, creative storyteller who can capture the essence of what’s happening in the field and deliver it seamlessly across broadcast, digital, and social platforms. The ideal candidate understands how audiences consume content differently on television, mobile, and social media—and can adapt storytelling styles seamlessly. This role would require field shooting, editing, and executing live shots, while also producing content optimized for linear TV, station websites/apps, and social platforms such as Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and YouTube. The winning candidate is tech-savvy, forward-thinking, and fluent in modern newsgathering tools and formats. You must be able to shoot with Sony XDCAM or similar ENG cameras, as well as mobile-first tools like iPhone, gimbals and emerging digital formats, with editing in Adobe Premiere or comparable platforms. Familiarity with ENG, SNG, and cellular “backpacks” (TVU, LiveU, etc.) for live transmission and file transfer is essential. Strong editing skills, excellent time management, clear communication, and a sharp editorial eye are critical. A commitment to high journalistic standards and visual excellence is a must. If you’re quick-thinking, adaptable, and thrive in a fast-paced, multi-platform newsroom, we want to hear from you. This position reports to the Chief Photographer. Responsibilities Shoot and edit VOs, VO-SOTs, and packages for broadcast, digital, and streaming platforms Create and adapt content for multi-platform distribution, including TV, web, app, and social media Serve as show editor, cutting and attaching video content into a newscast rundown (ENPS proficiency is a bonus) Produce vertical and mobile-first video optimized for platforms like Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts Collaborate with the Assignment Desk, reporters, and producers to cover stories and meet deadlines Work with producers to bring editorial vision to life through strong visuals, sequencing, and natural sound Identify opportunities for real-time social content and behind-the-scenes storytelling in the field Ensure all content meets journalistic, ethical, and brand standards across platforms Requirements Experience with non-linear editing systems (Adobe Premiere preferred) Understanding of multi-platform storytelling, including broadcast and social/digital video formats Previous newsroom experience preferred; military experience strongly considered Ability to carry up to 50 pounds of equipment Comfortable working in all weather conditions Valid driver’s license with a strong driving record; ability to operate large vehicles Proficiency with mobile journalism tools and emerging video technologies Strong organizational, time-management, and problem-solving skills Ability to work under pressure and make quick editorial decisions Strong interpersonal and communication skills A proactive, self-starter mindset with a “go-getter” attitude Equivalent military training (DINFOS) and related experience highly valued In-person attendance is required Values in Action At Hearst Television we tell stories every day. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. Values in Action At Hearst Television we tell stories every day. Stories about people of all cultures, backgrounds, perspectives, and identities. That's why, behind the scenes, we believe in being an organization as diverse and varied as the audience we reach, ensuring that the content we create is more compassionate, and more representative of the communities we serve. Benefits Eligible employees will have access to enroll in health coverage through our partnership with Entertainment Partners’ EP Cares program. Medical Dental Vision Emotional Wellness Support Additional benefits to meet your and your family's needs About Hearst Media Production Group Hearst Media Production Group (HMPG), a business unit of Hearst Television, is an independent producer and distributor of original programming for TV stations, broadcast and cable networks and streaming services. HMPG produces hundreds of hours of programming annually across linear, streaming, digital and social media platforms for domestic and international distribution in nearly 100 countries. Its popular shows include the Emmy® Award-winning educational/informational (E/I) programming blocks airing weekends nationwide including “Weekend Adventure,” on ABC stations; “CBS WKND,” on the CBS Network; “The More You Know,” on the NBC Network; “One Magnificent Morning,” on the CW Network; “Mi Telemundo” on the Telemundo Network and “Go Time” on independent stations. HMPG also produces and/or distributes a diverse slate of other programming and content including Matter of Fact with Soledad O’Brien , America’s #1 nationally syndicated public affairs news magazine; Consumer Reports TV , and the company’s dedicated FAST channels Xplore, The Jack Hanna Channel and Rovr Pets, available on some of the most popular smart TVs and streaming platforms. HMPG has offices in New York, Los Angeles, Washington, D.C. and Charlotte. HMPG is represented by United Talent Agency.

job.title: WISN Fall Intern
job.description: WISN Fall Intern Milwaukee WI, United States Job Description Do you want to join a premier multimedia company? When you start a career with Hearst Television, not only will you work amongst passionate professionals who take pride in what they do, but you will be a part of a progressive culture where your talents will be valued. WISN-TV offers paid internships for 10-12 weeks in the departments below. In order to apply for an internship at WISN-TV, please provide a cover letter with your application. The cover letter should include: Semester i.e. Spring, Summer, or Fall Department preference Available start and end dates Days and hours available to intern Application Deadlines Fall: August 31 WISN-TV Internship Criteria Candidate must be a Junior or Senior with a declared major in a related field (for example): Broadcast Communications Journalism Digital Marketing Public Relations Meteorology Sports Technical Creative Services Production Intern must receive credit from an accredited college, university or trade school Written verification is required from the institution Available Internships Newsroom: Newsroom interns will spend time rotating through each of the following areas: Assignment desk, where they will assist in gathering news and information. This includes taking and placing telephone calls from reporters, sources and the general public. It may also include research, scheduling and organizational tasks. TV News production, where they will practice writing and formatting scripts for broadcast as well as spending time in a news satellite or microwave van on the scene at a live news report. Digital news production, where they will research and write content for WISN digital platforms including the WISN app, WISN.com and various social media platforms. Creative Services: Attend news meetings and department meetings to go over daily news topics and performance goals Write copy for voice-overs and promotional identifications. Perform production assistant duties such as locating props and photographs, researching music and video copies for the Creative Services Department. Shadow promotion producers to gain a strong overview of editing and shooting responsibilities of the Creative Services/producer function. Maintain anchors/reporters bios, photos and files Write press releases, advisories, articles, etc. Assist in promoting WISN programming by drafting Tweets and Facebook posts Observe unlimited newscasts and editing sessions Participate in promo shoots in the station and on location Sports: Checks sports and news wires for any breaking sports news. Compiles and submits complete list of chyron material to be used in the show. Gathers all professional and collegiate scores. Logs all sports events recorded by the Sports staff. Answering phone calls, taking messages and making calls for the producers and talent. May accompany reporters on location shoots. Technical: News Edit ENG Receive Microwave News Gathering Satellite News Gathering News Photography Studio Operations (Floor Direct) Control Room Operations (Robos/Audio/TD) Air Operations (Master Control/Air Assist) Maintenance IT Shifts are normally in the daytime, evenings and on weekends. After completing a week in each of the above areas, the final two weeks of the program will be designated for students to return to their areas of choice in order to gain additional training. *Set days may be set for an intern's semester, but shifts will constantly change based on the department in which they work. Weather: ***Please note: All candidates for weather internships with WISN must be enrolled in a meteorology curriculum or closely related program of study. • Analyze weather charts and models • Contribute to daily forecast preparation • Assist with weather graphics production • Assist meteorologists in gathering critical & breaking weather information and data • Relay important information to/from News, Assignment Desk, and Web staff • Attend editorial and news meetings • Research statistical data • Practice forecast delivery in-studio • Assist with social media efforts and email communication Hours are flexible and may require early mornings (4 a.m. - noon, later evenings 2:30 p.m. - 11 p.m.), and weekends (morning and evening shifts).

job.title: Writer Producer
job.description: Promotions Writer Producer WYFF 4, the NBC and CBS affiliate in Greenville, SC is looking for a creative Promotions Writer Producer to write, shoot, edit and design promotion for all media platforms. job.title: Account Executive
job.description: Hearst Times Union Media Group is looking for a driven Account Executive to join our Capital Region sales team. This is a full-cycle, new business-focused sales role where you’ll be responsible for prospecting, closing, and growing new accounts, while building long-term partnerships with local and regional companies. You’ll also have a book of existing accounts that generate commissions and you can upsell on our wide swath of digital marketing solutions. You’ll have the backing of one of the most recognized media brands in the country, plus access to cutting-edge AI tools that help you prospect smarter, close faster, and maximize your earning potential. If you’re competitive, resourceful, and motivated by uncapped earnings , this is an opportunity to take your sales career to the next level. Why Join Hearst Times Union Media Group? Uncapped Earnings Potential Base salary + aggressive commission structure. Top performers consistently exceed targets. Sell with a Competitive Edge Leverage advanced tools like ChatGPT Enterprise to streamline prospecting, sharpen presentations, and accelerate deal cycles. High-Impact Role in a Strong Market Albany is a dynamic market for SMB’s, with endless opportunity to build new business and expand client relationships. Trusted Brand & Premium Products Represent a respected media organization with a powerful portfolio of advertising solutions and a massive audience reach. Our team makes sales from $5000 to $500,000. Career Growth & Mobility We invest in our people. Whether you want to grow your book, move into leadership, or expand into new markets, there’s a path here. Be part of a team of six AE’s reporting to a Sales Director who invests their time in you, making you better every day! Work inside (presenting on Microsoft Teams) and Go outside , we highly value in person meetings. Regular get togethers , happy hours, be part of a Sales office of over 30 sales and support staff. Hybrid schedule , Monday and Friday remote, Tues/Wed/Thursday in office. What You’ll Do: Own the Full Sales Cycle Prospect, pitch, close, and grow accounts across digital, event, and print solutions. Drive New Business Proactively identify and connect with small, medium and large businesses through outreach, networking, and market awareness. Present a compelling suite of products including best in class Content Marketing, Hearst Any Screen Streaming Television Advertising, SEO, SEM, display including programmatic, paid social media marketing, Email marketing, print solutions, and more. Build & Manage Your Pipeline Maintain a strong pipeline of new and existing business using Salesforce, Outreach, ChatGPT Enterprise, and consistently meet activity and revenue targets. Deliver Compelling Presentations Lead discovery conversations and present media plans that clearly demonstrate value and ROI. Leverage AI to Win More Deals Use over a dozen of our customized GPT’s, AI-powered tools that increase your efficiency, improve client engagement, and close business faster. What Sets You Apart: You’re a hunter who thrives on winning new business You are dynamic on the phone and in person. You know Albany and the Capital Region well. You’re competitive and goal-oriented , with a track record of exceeding targets You’re confident in client-facing situations , from cold outreach to executive presentations You’re adaptable and resourceful , able to navigate challenges and find solutions You’re strategic in your approach , not just transactional You bring strong communication and relationship-building skills Qualifications: BA/BS degree in Advertising, Marketing, or Communications a plus or equivalent experience. 2+ years of B2B sales experience (media, advertising, business or related industry preferred) Proven success in new business development and revenue growth Experience managing a full sales cycle Adept at using CRM tools (Salesforce, Outreach, or similar. Existing relationships in the Albany market are a plus Our Benefits: At Times Union Media Group we not only support our employees through personal and professional development, but we also believe in promoting each individual’s physical, financial and emotional wellbeing (and that of their family). Our industry-leading benefits include: Physical Wellbeing: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage to keep you and your family healthy. Invest for the Future: Competitive retirement plan with matching program in most markets. Generous Paid Time Off: Recharge with ample time off, including holidays and vacation. Paid Parental Leave: Support for growing families, with paid leave for new parents. Monthly Child & Dependent Care Reimbursement: Financial support for the care of your loved ones. Emotional Wellbeing: Be your best self with our mental wellness benefits. LGBTQ+ & Inclusive Health Services: Inclusive healthcare designed for every individual’s unique needs. Fertility Coverage & Menopause Support: Helping you along every step of your family journey. Pet Wellness Reimbursement & Rover Credits: We care about your pets, too – helping you keep them happy and healthy. And more, click here for additional benefits and details. Ready to Make an Impact? Join us and be part of a team that’s transforming local media through technology and human connection. Apply now to launch your next chapter as a trusted media partner to businesses across Albany. Learn more about Hearst Newspapers at www.joinhnp.com In accordance with applicable law, Hearst is required to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation for this role if hired in New York State. The reasonable estimated starting base salary, if hired in New York State, would start at about $50,000 (base salary), plus commissions with on target first year earnings potential of $75,000 - $125,000 (annualized) based on individual performance. There is no commission cap. Please note this information is specific to those hired in New York State. If this role is open to candidates outside of New York State, the salary range would be aligned to that specific location. A final decision on the successful candidate’s starting salary will be based on a number of permissible, non-discriminatory factors, including but not limited to skills and experience, training, certifications, and education. About Us: Based in Albany, the Times Union (www.timesunion.com) is the leading news organization in New York’s Capital Region, Hudson Valley and beyond. The news organization is widely respected for its focus on local news and watchdog reporting, particularly on state government and politics. It has won numerous state and national awards for its work on both print and digital platforms and has repeatedly been named New York’s ‘Newspaper of Distinction’ by the state editors association. Through the Times Union Media Group, we offer innovative marketing and advertising solutions to local, regional, and national clients. These include event marketing, a full complement of digital marketing solutions, targeted and total market coverage print solutions and more. HNP Overview: With 2,500 employees across the nation, Hearst Newspapers (HNP) represents a network of 28 daily and 50 weekly publications, including the Austin American-Statesman, Houston Chronicle, San Antonio Express-News, San Francisco Chronicle and Times Union (Albany). Our portfolio also includes several top digital-only news and lifestyle sites such as Chron., CT Insider, MySA and SFGATE, along with marketing services businesses like Medium Giant and entertainment brands such as King Features Syndicate. At HNP, we’re investing in new and innovative ways to tell stories — growing newsrooms, diversifying tools and evolving platforms — to support the millions of people who trust us each month to help them make decisions, take action and be inspired. Be part of something bigger — Your Headline Awaits #LI-DH1 #LI-Hybrid

job.title: Energy and Data Center Reporter
job.description: The Houston Chronicle is seeking an ambitious reporter to cover one of the most consequential stories shaping Texas’ future: the intersection of energy, the electrical grid and the rapid expansion of data centers. Based on our Business desk, this reporter will examine how unprecedented demand for power is transforming the state’s electric system, economy and communities. This beat sits at the crossroads of business, public policy, infrastructure and climate. The reporter will cover the power industry with a particular focus on how Texas’ electrical grid is adapting after the 2021 winter storm, how utilities and regulators are responding to growing demand, and how the explosive growth of data centers is reshaping energy planning across the state. We are looking for a journalist who thrives on accountability reporting, develops deep sources and consistently breaks news. This reporter will move beyond corporate announcements to explain who benefits, who bears the costs and how decisions made by utilities, regulators, technology companies and elected officials affect Texans. Key Responsibilities Cover Texas’ electrical grid, power markets and the rapidly growing demand for electricity driven by data centers and other large industrial users. Break exclusive news on utilities, grid operators, regulators, energy companies and technology firms. Develop deep sourcing across the energy industry, state agencies, utilities, lawmakers, environmental groups and major technology companies. Produce accountability journalism that examines grid reliability, infrastructure investments, ratepayer impacts, regulatory decisions and resilience planning. Explain complex energy and technology issues in clear, accessible ways that help readers understand how they affect daily life. Use public records, regulatory filings, data analysis and investigative reporting techniques to uncover exclusive stories. Produce a mix of breaking news, scoops, utility content that breaks down complex topics and longer-term accountability projects. We’re Looking for Someone Who Has approximately 5 years of relevant reporting experience, preferably covering energy, business, infrastructure, government or another complex policy beat. Has a track record of breaking news, cultivating sources and producing exclusive reporting. Can translate complicated technical and regulatory issues into compelling journalism for a broad audience. Is naturally curious about how industries, markets and government intersect and can identify stories others overlook. Is comfortable digging into public records, financial documents, regulatory filings and datasets. Understands that business reporting is ultimately about people and can connect corporate and policy decisions to their real-world impact. About the Houston Chronicle: The Houston Chronicle, recognized for its Pulitzer Prize-winning journalism, serves its 2.3 million residents with content and marketing solutions across two of Houston’s largest websites — HoustonChronicle.com and Chron.com , along with our magazine, television and newspaper brands. Our mission is to spark conversations that inspire action to create a better Houston. All our content and the innovative business solutions we provide invite Houstonians to join conversations about a community we’ve been committed to covering and helping prosper for more than 120 years. The community we all call home. About Hearst Newspapers: With 2,500 employees across the nation, HNP encompasses a network of 24 daily and 52 weekly publications, including the San Francisco Chronicle, Houston Chronicle, San Antonio Express-News and Albany Times Union, several top digital-only news and lifestyle sites, marketing services businesses, and entertainment businesses such as King Features Syndicate. At HNP, we are investing in new and innovative ways to tell stories – growing newsrooms, diversifying tools, evolving platforms – to support the millions of people who trust us each month to help them make decisions, take action and be inspired. Be a part of something bigger – your headline awaits. Please do not use this email address to inquire about the status of applications. We will only respond to inquiries concerning requests for a reasonable accommodation through this email address. #LI-KR1 #LI-Hybrid

job.title: General Assignment Reporter/Staff Reporter
job.description: Reporter, The Beaumont Enterprise Tell the Stories That Matter Most to Your Community Your work can make a real difference here. In a smaller market, local journalism is personal. It’s about more than headlines — it’s about helping a community stay informed, feel connected, and understand the people and issues shaping daily life. At Hearst Newspapers and The Beaumont Enterprise, we’re looking for a curious, driven Reporter who wants to do meaningful work in a place where strong journalism truly matters. This is an opportunity to be at the center of a community’s conversations — covering breaking news, uncovering important stories, and building trust with the people you serve. If you’re energized by local reporting, excited to be part of a collaborative newsroom, and motivated by the idea of making a visible impact, we want to hear from you. The Role As a Reporter, you’ll cover the stories, people, and issues that matter most in the community. You’ll report on breaking news, attend meetings and events, build local sources, and develop enterprise stories that add depth and accountability. In a smaller market, this role is both important and highly visible. You won’t just be filing stories — you’ll be helping readers understand what’s happening around them and why it matters. This is a hands-on role for someone who is naturally curious, comfortable working in a fast-moving environment, and excited to be deeply connected to the community they cover. What You’ll Do Cover the community with urgency and purpose Report on breaking news, local developments, and key community issues Attend meetings, events, and public forums to stay close to the story Write quickly and clearly across digital and print while balancing daily production with longer-term reporting and follow-up. Prioritize and move stories forward independently, knowing when a story requires a quick digital report, a follow-up, or deeper reporting Develop strong, meaningful local coverage Build a broad, diverse network of reliable sources and consistently develop new relationships beyond official spokespeople and press releases. Generate original story ideas and pursue reporting beyond official sources. Produce enterprise stories that go beyond the daily headline Develop expertise in an assigned subject and geographic area, becoming a reliable source of news and information in them. Help strengthen the local news report Collaborate with editors, photographers, and other newsroom teammates Contribute story ideas and bring energy to daily coverage planning Use digital tools, social media, and audience insights to better reach readers Comfortable creating video and social content, with a strong instinct for stories that will resonate on digital platforms. What You Bring Bachelor's degree in journalism or related field required Newsroom reporting experience with strong news writing skills and familiarity with AP style. Strong reporting, interviewing and newsgathering skills, with sound news judgment and the ability to work effectively under deadline. job.title: Graphics Designer
job.description: Graphic Designer Hearst Midwest Bring Ideas to Life. Create Work That Makes an Impact. At Hearst Newspapers, we're transforming how local businesses connect with their communities. We're looking for a talented, creative Graphic Designer to join our Midwest Creative Services team—someone who thrives on bringing ideas to life through compelling visual storytelling across print and digital platforms. If you're passionate about great design, enjoy collaborating with a variety of teams, and love balancing creativity with strategy, we'd love to meet you. What You'll Do As a Graphic Designer, you'll create engaging marketing materials that help businesses grow and support Hearst's award-winning brands. Every day is different—you might be designing a digital campaign, creating a print advertisement, developing promotional materials, or collaborating with Sales and Marketing to bring a client's vision to life. You'll: Design high-quality print and digital marketing materials, including advertisements, brochures, direct mail, presentations, signage, social media graphics, and promotional campaigns. Create production-ready files that meet print and digital specifications. Partner with Sales, Marketing, Production, Editorial, and other internal teams to develop creative solutions that achieve business goals. Work directly with internal stakeholders—and occasionally clients—to understand project objectives and deliver exceptional creative work. Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining outstanding attention to detail and meeting deadlines. Contribute ideas that improve creative quality, workflows, and team collaboration. What Makes You Successful You're naturally creative, organized, and curious. You enjoy solving problems through design and take pride in producing polished work that exceeds expectations. You're comfortable juggling multiple priorities and understand that great communication is just as important as great design. We're looking for someone who has: Experience designing for both print and digital media. Strong proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud (InDesign, Illustrator, and Photoshop). A solid understanding of typography, layout, branding, color theory, and print production. Excellent organizational and time management skills. Strong communication and collaboration skills. A customer-focused mindset and a passion for delivering exceptional work. Bonus Points Experience working directly with clients or customers. Knowledge of print production processes and file preparation. A passion for learning new design trends, software, and creative techniques. Experiment with Advanced AI At Hearst Newspapers, we believe technology empowers creativity. Through our exclusive ChatGPT Enterprise partnership and growing portfolio of AI-powered tools, our designers use AI to streamline workflows, generate creative concepts, organize ideas, improve copy, and accelerate routine tasks—giving you more time to focus on what matters most: creating exceptional work. We're looking for someone who's excited to explore how emerging technology can enhance creativity while keeping great design and human judgment at the center of everything we do. Why Hearst Newspapers? Hearst Newspapers is one of the nation's leading media organizations, reaching millions of readers each week through trusted local journalism, digital products, and innovative marketing solutions. With more than 2,500 employees across the country, Hearst Newspapers includes iconic brands such as the Houston Chronicle, San Francisco Chronicle, Dallas Morning News, San Antonio Express-News, Albany Times Union , and dozens of other daily and weekly publications. When you join Hearst, you'll become part of a collaborative team that values creativity, innovation, continuous learning, and delivering meaningful work that helps local businesses and communities thrive. What You'll Bring Associate's degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communications, or a related field—or equivalent professional experience. Experience creating engaging visual content across multiple platforms. Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality. Ability to manage multiple projects while meeting deadlines. A collaborative, solutions-oriented mindset. A desire to continuously learn, grow, and contribute to an innovative creative team. Why You'll Love This Role This is an opportunity to work on a wide variety of creative projects, collaborate with talented colleagues across multiple Hearst properties, and make a real impact through your work. Whether you're designing for print, digital, or emerging platforms, you'll have the opportunity to grow your skills, explore new technologies, and help shape the future of creative storytelling at Hearst Newspapers. If you're ready to bring bold ideas, exceptional design, and creative energy to one of the nation's leading media organizations, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today!

job.title: Marketing Performance Manager
job.description: Marketing Performance Manager Location: San Francisco, CA - Hybrid Employment Type: Part-time Position Summary Hearst California Media is seeking a Marketing Performance Manager to support ongoing performance analysis, optimization recommendations and reporting for agency-level clients. This includes attribution tracking, paid media oversight, email production, and client-facing marketing insights. This role is responsible for turning data from sales, web analytics, paid media, email, membership, and attribution platforms into detailed analytics, problem solving, KPI optimization strategies, clear recommendations, accurate timely reports and polished executive-facing materials. This person must be an integrated team member with the ability to monitor internal team member performance, forge strong partnerships to influence perception and generate desired actions and results. They must also have the ability to serve as a consultative post-sale partner, helping clients understand results, the reason to act on recommendations, and build a strong foundation for retention and account growth. The ideal candidate is highly analytical, detail-oriented, comfortable working across multiple marketing data sources, and able to explain performance trends in a way that helps stakeholders make informed budget, channel, creative, and campaign decisions. Overall Responsibilities : Own the analysis of multi-channel performance, identifying trends and areas of optimization to support the achievement of agreed upon KPIs. This includes analyzing revenue, sales, membership, product, webinar, training, and campaign performance across paid search, programmatic, paid social, email, GA4, and other active channels, making recommendations to improve performance and monitoring implementation and results to ensure continuous improvement. Manage internal team, vendor and client relationships to foster continuous communication, common understanding and movement to improve performance and results. Ensure timely, strategic and thoughtful communication to enhance receptivity. Support HubSpot email production and QA Own and prepare client and leadership-ready materials Specific Duties: Account Performance Management and Customer Success Stakeholder Communication and Planning Attribution, Tracking, and Systems Email Production and Campaign Operations Required Qualifications: Seven or more years of experience in marketing analytics, digital marketing reporting, performance marketing, revenue operations, media analytics, or a closely related role. Hands-on experience analyzing paid search, programmatic, paid social, email, web analytics, campaign, revenue, and conversion data. Advanced spreadsheet skills, including formulas, lookups, pivot tables, workbook maintenance, data validation, cross-tab consolidation, and error checking. Experience with GA4 and HubSpot, plus familiarity with marketing reporting or media platforms such as TapClicks, Trade Desk, attribution, paid search and paid social platforms. Ability to translate performance data into clear insights, executive summaries, recommendations, slides, one-sheeters, and stakeholder-ready narratives. Strong understanding of digital marketing metrics, including impressions, clicks, CTR, CPC, conversions, purchases, CPA, ROAS, revenue, attribution, budget pacing, and goal-versus-actual performance. Excellent attention to detail and comfort reconciling data across multiple reports, workbooks, platforms, and stakeholder-provided source files. Strong communication, organization, deadline management, and cross-functional collaboration skills. Bachelor degree in marketing, analytics, business, communications, statistics, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. Preferred Qualifications: Experience with an agency level client base and associated expectations for client service, analysis, recommendations, communication and reporting. Experience with B2B, legal centric, membership based and a professional services/product environment. Experience with sales matchback reporting, order-level attribution, marketing-source reconciliation, or revenue attribution across multiple platforms. Familiarity with Google Tag Manager, pixels, conversion events, cookie-consent impacts, and marketing tracking QA. Experience building polished client-facing presentations or reports in PowerPoint, Canva, Google Slides, or similar tools. Experience coordinating approval workflows involving internal teams, clients, legal reviewers, vendors, and channel specialists.
