job.title: Packaging Supervisor
job.description: Newspaper Packaging Supervisor Position Summary The Newspaper Packaging Supervisor is responsible for supervising and coordinating newspaper packaging operations to ensure newspapers, inserts, commercial products, and other printed materials are processed, packaged, and prepared for distribution safely, accurately, efficiently, and on schedule. This is a hands-on leadership position in a fast-paced, deadline-driven production environment. The supervisor is responsible for employees, staffing, production schedules, equipment, product quality, safety, labor management, timekeeping, nightly reporting, and coordination with other departments. Due to the nature of newspaper production and distribution, this position requires flexibility and the ability to work nights, weekends, holidays, overtime, and extended shifts as required by production and business needs . Essential Duties and Responsibilities Production Operations Supervise daily and nightly newspaper packaging and inserting operations to ensure production requirements and deadlines are consistently achieved. Direct and coordinate employees operating newspaper inserting, stacking, strapping, conveying, palletizing, and related packaging equipment. Coordinate the processing of newspapers, inserts, commercial products, and other materials according to established production specifications. Monitor production schedules and adjust employees, equipment, and workflow as necessary to meet changing priorities and deadlines. Verify product quality, quantities, zoning, insert placement, labeling, packaging, and other job-specific requirements. Ensure proper setup, operation, and shutdown of packaging equipment. Support press production and ensure an efficient transition of printed products from the press into Packaging. Coordinate closely with the Pressroom to address production changes, press delays, product flow, and other issues that may affect Packaging operations. Ensure completed products are properly prepared and released for distribution according to established deadlines. Communicate production delays, equipment issues, staffing concerns, quality problems, and other significant operational issues to appropriate management and departments. Equipment and Maintenance Monitor inserting, conveying, stacking, strapping, press palletizing, and other packaging equipment to ensure reliable operation. Assist with troubleshooting equipment problems and minor repairs when appropriate. Coordinate with Maintenance when mechanical, electrical, or technical support is required. Monitor equipment downtime and take appropriate action to minimize production interruptions. Identify recurring equipment issues and communicate concerns to Maintenance and management. Support preventive maintenance activities and ensure equipment is maintained in safe and reliable operating condition. Work with employees and Maintenance to identify opportunities to improve equipment performance, reliability, and efficiency. Staffing and Labor Management Assign employees to production lines and work areas based on workload, employee skills, staffing levels, and production priorities. Monitor staffing levels throughout each shift and make adjustments as needed to maintain productivity and control labor costs. Manage overtime assignments based on operational requirements and approved labor targets. Monitor temporary or contract labor usage and adjust staffing according to production requirements. Balance staffing requirements with production demands to ensure adequate coverage without unnecessary labor expense. Communicate schedules, schedule changes, overtime requirements, and production expectations clearly and in a timely manner. Nightly Production Reports and Documentation Complete accurate and timely nightly production reports at the conclusion of each shift. Document production results, run times, staffing levels, labor hours, equipment downtime, delays, waste, quality issues, safety concerns, and other significant events. Document equipment problems or maintenance concerns requiring follow-up. Identify missed production targets, unusual circumstances, or operational concerns and provide appropriate explanations. Ensure nightly reports provide management with an accurate overview of shift performance. Distribute nightly reports to appropriate management and departments within established timelines. Clearly communicate outstanding issues requiring follow-up by the incoming shift, Maintenance, Planning, Pressroom, Distribution, Transportation, or management. Maintain accurate production records, staffing information, equipment information, and other required departmental documentation. Safety Responsibilities Maintain a strong commitment to employee safety and safe equipment operation. Ensure employees comply with established safety policies and procedures. Ensure proper use of required personal protective equipment. Reinforce lockout/tagout and other equipment safety procedures. Identify and promptly address unsafe conditions, equipment, or work practices. Participate in safety meetings, training, incident investigations, and corrective actions as required. Maintain clean, organized, and safe work areas and reinforce good housekeeping practices throughout the department. Communicate safety concerns promptly to appropriate management. Cross-Functional Coordination Work closely with the Pressroom, Planning, Maintenance, Distribution, Transportation, Receiving, and other departments to coordinate production activities. Maintain effective communication regarding schedules, delays, product requirements, staffing concerns, and equipment issues. Coordinate with internal and external partners when required to support production and distribution requirements. Participate in production meetings and other operational discussions as required. Support special projects, new equipment installations, process changes, and other organizational initiatives. Assist with implementing new processes and equipment and help employees successfully adapt to operational changes. Leadership Expectations The Newspaper Packaging Supervisor is expected to demonstrate strong leadership, accountability, professionalism, and sound judgment. The supervisor must be able to make timely decisions in a fast-paced production environment while balancing safety, quality, staffing, equipment, labor costs, and production deadlines. The supervisor is expected to: Lead by example. Take ownership of operational issues through resolution. Communicate clearly and professionally. Hold employees accountable while treating them fairly and respectfully. Remain calm and solutions-oriented during production challenges. Adapt quickly to changing priorities. Develop and support employees. Build effective working relationships across departments. Promote teamwork and shared accountability. Support organizational changes and continuous improvement initiatives. Qualifications Previous experience in newspaper packaging, printing, manufacturing, distribution, warehouse operations, or a similar production environment preferred. Previous supervisory, lead, or team leadership experience preferred. Experience with newspaper inserting, conveying, stacking, strapping, and palletizing equipment preferred. Experience with press palletizing systems or related automated production equipment preferred. Strong mechanical aptitude and basic equipment troubleshooting abilities. Strong leadership, organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills. Ability to read and understand production schedules, job instructions, reports, and production specifications. Ability to effectively manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment. Ability to make sound and timely decisions when production conditions change. Ability to effectively supervise employees with varying levels of experience and technical knowledge. Basic computer skills and ability to use email, production systems, scheduling tools, timekeeping systems, spreadsheets, and reporting applications. Ability to prepare accurate written production and shift reports. Ability to work effectively with employees, management, vendors, contractors, and other departments. Work Schedule and Availability Newspaper production operates around strict publication and distribution deadlines. The Newspaper Packaging Supervisor must maintain schedule flexibility based on production and business requirements. The position requires the ability and willingness to: Work primarily evening and overnight shifts. Work weekends on a regular basis. Work holidays as required by the newspaper production schedule. Work overtime when necessary. Work extended shifts or additional days when required. Adjust scheduled hours based on production volumes, staffing shortages, equipment problems, special publications, weather events, or other operational requirements. Respond to unexpected production issues that may require additional supervisory coverage. Regular and reliable attendance is an essential function of this position. Physical and Work Environment Requirements This position works primarily in a production, manufacturing, and warehouse environment. The position may require: Extended periods of standing and walking. Frequent movement throughout production and warehouse areas. Bending, reaching, and climbing stairs. Working around moving machinery, conveyors, forklifts, and other industrial equipment. Exposure to production noise, paper dust, vehicle traffic, and varying temperatures. Lifting or moving materials within established company safety guidelines. Wearing required personal protective equipment while in designated production areas. Our Benefits: At Hearst Newspapers we not only support our employees through personal and professional development, but we also believe in promoting each individual’s physical, financial and emotional wellbeing (and that of their family). Our industry-leading benefits include: Physical Wellbeing: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage to keep you and your family healthy. Invest for the Future: Competitive retirement plan with matching program in most markets. Generous Paid Time Off: Recharge with ample time off, including holidays and vacation. Paid Parental Leave: Support for growing families, with paid leave for new parents. Monthly Child & Dependent Care Reimbursement: Financial support for the care of your loved ones. Emotional Wellbeing: Be your best self with our mental wellness benefits. LGBTQ+ & Inclusive Health Services: Inclusive healthcare designed for every individual’s unique needs. Fertility Coverage & Menopause Support: Helping you along every step of your family journey. Pet Wellness Reimbursement & Rover Credits: We care about your pets, too – helping you keep them happy and healthy. And more, click here for additional benefits and details. About Hearst Newspapers: With 2,500 employees across the nation, HNP represents a network of 24 daily and 52 weekly publications, including the San Francisco Chronicle, Houston Chronicle, San Antonio Express-News and Albany Times Union, several top digital-only news and lifestyle sites, marketing services businesses, and entertainment businesses such as King Features Syndicate. At HNP, we are investing in new and innovative ways to tell stories–growing newsrooms, diversifying tools, evolving platforms–to support the millions of people who trust us each month to help them make decisions, take action and be inspired. job.description: Print Press Operator This pivotal role contributes to the efficient operation of our offset printing press by assisting with setup, maintenance, and operation. job.title: Real Estate & Development Reporter
job.description: Real Estate and Development Reporter, Austin American-Statesman The Austin American-Statesman is seeking an experienced reporter to cover Austin real estate — from home sales and residential trends to office, industrial, retail and multifamily development, occupancy and rent, as well as the policies shaping growth in one of the fastest-growing regions in the state and nation. The best candidate will be hungry to get scoops, write complex stories in ways that resonate with readers, and bring an entrepreneurial spirit to the beat. What will you do? As a member of the regional Business team, this reporter will break news and deliver exclusive enterprise on sales, leases, developments and market trends in residential and commercial real estate. They will produce multi-platform stories, including articles, social video, data-rich interactives, newsletter content and more. Pitch and write from three to five stories a week, ranging from breaking news to enterprise and investigations. Surface trends by mining data from a broad range of sources: area municipalities, courts, state agencies, real estate associations, brokers and banks. Develop a network of sources among developers, builders, financiers, government officials, neighborhood groups and others who impact or are impacted by development. Use audience and performance data to help determine story selection. Collaborate with the Audience and Multimedia teams on social video and community engagement initiatives. Collaborate with the Regional Data team on stories that are best told with graphics, maps and other forms of data visualization. Develop recurring newsletters, databases, guides and other products that help readers make decisions about buying, renting, investing and living in Central Texas. Identify opportunities to turn reporting into useful tools such as searchable property databases, development trackers, market explainers, calculators, maps and alerts. Represent the Statesman at industry events, public meetings, community gatherings and professional forums, while building new sources and audience relationships. What will it take to be successful? At least five years of daily journalism experience and three years in business, real estate or growth and development coverage. A digital-first mindset with strong SEO, headline writing and audience instincts. The ability to juggle breaking news with ambitious enterprise and analysis that connects the dots for readers and influences policy discussions. Experience working with public records and market data: building permits, market reports, state development filings, zoning cases, deed and plat records, and the ability to convert such data into clear, compelling stories. Adept at using social platforms to track companies, officials and community conversations. Track record of source development in publicly traded, closely held and private companies. Experience covering earnings reports and other SEC filings. Ability to collaborate in a fast-paced environment with visuals, data and audience teams across Hearst Texas newsrooms. A willingness to think beyond the daily story — developing projects, useful reader products and new distribution strategies that expand the impact of the beat. This position reports to the Austin Business Editor as part of a Hearst Texas Business news staff in Austin and San Antonio. The department also covers technology, energy, utilities, auto manufacturing, labor, trade, aerospace, cybersecurity, insurance, retail, tourism, economic development and the region’s major companies and industries. Among the companies of focus are Tesla, Dell, Cisco, Oracle, Valero, USAA, SpaceX, Boeing, Samsung, H E B and Whataburger. About The Austin American-Statesman: The Austin American-Statesman has been the leading source of news and information for Central Texas since 1871, serving a dynamic and fast-growing region anchored by the capital city of Texas. Austin is known for its vibrant tech industry, rich cultural heritage, influential government institutions and creative spirit. The Statesman's award-winning journalists provide in-depth coverage of the issues that matter most to Austinites — from local government and business to education, the environment and Austin’s ever-evolving music and cultural scenes. job.description: The Houston Chronicle is seeking an ambitious education reporter to cover one of the country’s largest and most dynamic public education systems. This reporter will examine the policies, demographic shifts and political forces reshaping schools across the Houston region, helping audiences understand not only what is changing, but what those changes mean for students, families and educators. Moving beyond a traditional district beat, this reporter will focus on the suburban districts where many of the Houston region’s biggest education stories are unfolding. The reporter will identify emerging trends across districts, produce accountability journalism that serves families and connect local developments to the broader forces reshaping public education in Texas. Key Responsibilities Lead education coverage across Greater Houston, focusing on the systems, policies and regional trends shaping public education rather than a traditional district-by-district beat. Break news on major developments affecting schools across the region while producing scoops that explain why decisions matter to students, families and taxpayers. Is comfortable interpreting data, budgets, legislation and public records and translating complex issues into accessible journalism. Understands how education intersects with immigration, economics, workforce development, housing and demographic change. Has strong news judgment and can move confidently between fast-paced breaking news and longer-term reporting Thrives in a collaborative newsroom and enjoys working across teams to produce ambitious journalism. Brings curiosity, creativity and a strong digital mindset to storytelling, using a range of formats to reach and engage audiences. job.title: SEM Strategist
job.description: IMS Search Engine Marketing Strategist As a premier multi-media organization, LocalEdge has been leading the transition to web-based advertising for small to mid-size businesses across all industries. Today, through the continued development of proprietary technology and strong vendor relationships that include major search engines, social network sites, and other leading tech-focused companies, LocalEdge offers a full line of digital marketing products that help its customers reach and interact with today’s consumers. The SEM Strategist will work with our existing Search Engine Marketing team to provide strategic SEM services for our clients. The SEM Strategist will be responsible for researching, identifying and implementing emerging SEM trends and tactics. This role will manage all aspects of day-to-day SEM strategy for clients. As part of the Search Engine Marketing Team, this individual will create new campaigns, develop targeted keyword lists, conduct bid management and optimization, prepare reports and analyze landing pages and keyword copy in support of advertiser goals. Confidence, accountability and action-oriented attitude and habits are keys to success. Success metrics will be based on growth in overall qualified PPC traffic and conversions for a specific customer base. The ideal candidate should also be comfortable in a client facing role with strong written and verbal communication skills. This individual will be required to present strategic SEM implementation plans and reports to our clients via conference calls. Candidate must possess organizational and time management skills as they will be responsible for the management of several advanced SEM campaigns. This role is remote in the Western New York area. ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS: Develops keyword lists and ad copy for search campaigns. Builds and launches SEM campaigns within Google Adwords and Microsoft Ad Center. Creates new paid search campaigns utilizing various internal Web-based systems. Analyzes the effectiveness of landing pages used in search engine marketing campaigns. Performs quality assurance prior to launching campaigns to ensure accuracy of campaigns. Makes campaign, ad copy and keyword optimization changes based on analyzing key performance indicators such as CPC, CPL, and CTC. Provides monthly updates to clients regarding performance of SEM campaigns and communicates regularly with clients to discuss metrics and trends. Performs campaign budget stewardship to ensure campaigns are managed efficiently and target CPLs are achieved. Performs in depth keyword research and strategic analysis. Performs competitive keyword and strategic analysis. Implements lead tracking systems. Monitors and implements new and emerging trends in SEM. Recommends changes in methods to increase traffic to websites. Performs other related duties as assigned. EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE: A BA/BS Degree is preferred. Internships or entry experience in marketing or similar fields. Candidate must have strong verbal and written communication skills. KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS: The incumbent/candidate must have a detailed work ethic, be highly motivated, well organized, and be able to communicate effectively with a diverse group of individual customers, as well as all levels of employees. Candidate must have solid time management and written/oral communication skills. Organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple simultaneous projects and resources are required. Compensation for this position is $38,500.00, Full Benefits & generous PTO. job.title: Senior Audience Producer
job.description: Senior Audience Producer As the state’s largest local news organization, Hearst Connecticut Media Group is reaching audiences with ambitious, compelling journalism wherever they are through CT Insider’s app and websites, in newsletters, on social media, through audio and in print. We’re looking for innovative, collaborative Senior Audience Producers who will be responsible for embedding with key departments alongside editors to help guide our reporting, understanding of analytics, responsible and relevant AI usage and optimization of our journalism. These journalists will each work with topic teams, which could include data, state politics, investigations, education, business, real estate, high school sports and UConn sports. They will work closely with the rest of the audience team, editors and reporters to help drive audience engagement, subscriptions and return visits. This role represents our desire to innovate and invest in and support key areas of our newsroom. Duties and responsibilities: Works collaboratively with editors, reporters, photographers and other audience team members to ensure our journalism engages, retains and converts local readers into subscribers Demonstrates a high comfort level with analyzing and interpreting metrics and explaining what they mean to inform coverage decisions over the short- and long-term Uses topic-area knowledge to identify story ideas and help deliver recurring content series and annual special projects Communicates effectively across departments during breaking and planned news events to alert users to key story developments across platforms Qualifications: Strong editorial judgment with experience in a deadline-driven news environment Ability to optimize stories for site, social, newsletters and search Experience editing short and mid-form video, photos and audio in tools like Canva, Photoshop or Premiere Quick, organized, technical problem solver who is able to consistently meet deadlines Excellent writing, editing and verbal communication skills Highly organized and detail-oriented with a proven ability to effectively juggle multiple tasks Ability to work a flexible schedule for breaking news and special content opportunities, including nights and weekends Preferences Knowledge of topic areas like data, politics, sports, education, business or real estate Ability to lead planning for and run livestreams and podcasts that engage and retain viewers would be valuable (one of two roles) Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in journalism, English, communications or related field The Benefits Health, dental, vision, disability and life insurance 401(k) with company matching Three weeks vacation annually Mobile phone reimbursement Paid training opportunities, including journalism conferences Flexible spending account Parental leave and support Employee assistance program Health savings account To apply: Send a cover letter, resume and clips, including strategic plans, video or social media assets, for review. HCMG is committed to growing and retaining a more diverse workforce that better reflects the communities we serve. job.title: Social Content Creator
job.description: Social Content Creator, The Austin American-Statesman The Austin American-Statesman is hiring a Social Content Creator to grow our various news products into household names, starting with Hook’em in time for the University of Texas football season. The Social Content Creator is responsible for creating and executing a vision for various Statesman Instagram and TikTok accounts, such as Hook’Em, Austin360, some reporter handles and more. They’ll work closely with our Audience Team and other newsroom departments to grow Statesman’s off-platform reach. They will shoot, edit and post video that engages social users, including podcast clips. This position will sit on the Statesman’s Audience Team. The ideal candidate will bring energy, social media best-practices and an entrepreneurial spirit to our best-in-class journalism. Responsibilities: Create and execute a vision to grow audiences for Statesman brands on social media Create a video content plan, shoot, edit and post video to Statesman social accounts Identify user-generated content that enhances our storytelling and engages our social media audience. Work with reporters to obtain permission from users to modify and publish their content. Interact with social audience in a way that grows loyalty and enhances our brand Shoot, edit and post our in-studio podcasts. Use best practices in cutting clips for social media Create promotional touchpoints for our various products, so audiences grow across channels (social, newsletters, podcasts, etc.) Comfortable being on camera Maintain high audio and visual standards and ensure content follows digital copyright laws Maintain high journalistic standards, ensuring content is accurate, fair and reported without bias Qualifications: Demonstrated ability to grow a brand on social media Experience with video editing, specifically vertical social video Experience with shooting, editing and posting podcasts Proficiency in Canva and Adobe products: Photoshop, Premiere, Audition Social-media native who enjoys keeping up and participating in trends Demonstrated ability to experiment, and pivot when things aren’t working Team player who can rally colleagues around an idea Able to learn new tools and tech independently and quickly Able to consistently meet tight deadlines Uses data to make strategic decisions. Experience with performance analytics tools like Google Analytics, Marfeel, Looker Studio Bachelor’s degree in marketing, advertising, journalism or related field 2+ years of professional experience in a similar role. Open to recent grads who have strong internship experience The Austin American-Statesman (statesman.com) has been the leading source of news and information for Central Texas since 1871, serving a dynamic and fast-growing region anchored by the capital city of Texas. Austin is known for its vibrant tech industry, rich cultural heritage, influential government institutions and creative spirit. Since its acquisition by Hearst in 2025, the Statesman continues to operate with editorial independence while benefiting from Hearst’s expansive journalistic and technological resources. The Austin American-Statesman is a division of Hearst Newspapers (HNP). With 2,500 employees across the nation, HNP represents a network of 24 daily and 52 weekly publications, including the San Francisco Chronicle, Houston Chronicle, San Antonio Express-News and Albany Times Union, marketing services businesses, and entertainment businesses such as King Features Syndicate. At HNP, we are investing in new and innovative ways to tell stories – growing newsrooms, diversifying tools, evolving platforms – to support the millions of people who trust us each month to help them make decisions, take action and be inspired. Be a part of something bigger – Your Headline Awaits. job.title: Social Media Strategist
job.description: Social Media Marketing Strategist Are you passionate about driving engagement and building communities through social media? Join our dynamic Social Media Marketing team as a Social Media Marketing Strategist , where creativity meets strategy to deliver exceptional results for our clients. In this role, you’ll spearhead innovative campaigns across platforms like Meta (Facebook and Instagram), LinkedIn, TikTok, and emerging channels. By staying ahead of trends and analyzing performance, you’ll be the go-to expert for creating impactful strategies that meet and exceed client marketing goals. What You’ll Do Design and execute data-driven organic and paid social media campaigns to elevate brands. Publish engaging social media posts to captivate audiences and drive participation. Design and develop creative assets for social media advertising campaigns, including graphics and ad variations aligned with platform best practices across social platforms. Deliver insightful campaign reports to clients, providing actionable recommendations based on performance data. Identify emerging trends and implement them to keep clients ahead of the curve. Collaborate closely with sales reps, partners, and clients to ensure a seamless experience. Monitor campaign budgets and performance to ensure efficient and effective paid social campaign management. What We’re Looking For A creative storyteller with a strategic mindset. Strong written and verbal communication skills to confidently present ideas and results. 1+ years of experience in social media marketing preferred. BA/BS Degree is a plus. Experience creating visual assets for social media advertising is also preferred, and familiarity with design tools such as Canva is a plus. Exceptional organizational and time management abilities. Take ownership of your ideas and see them come to life in meaningful campaigns. Enjoy opportunities for professional growth and development in a fast-paced environment. job.title: Video Project Coordinator
job.description: Position Overview We are seeking an organized, creative, and client-focused Video Project Coordinator to lead and manage our marketing video product line. This role will oversee video projects from initial concept through final delivery, working closely with clients, internal partners, and external production vendors. The ideal candidate is a strong communicator and project coordinator who can develop compelling video concepts, write effective scripts, coordinate production resources, manage vendor costs, and oversee a high volume of projects while maintaining quality, timelines, and budgets. Key Responsibilities Manage the day-to-day operations and continued growth of the company’s marketing video product line. Collaborate with clients and business partners to understand their goals, target audiences, messaging, and creative vision. Develop video concepts, creative briefs, treatments, and storyboards. Write clear, engaging video scripts that align with client objectives and brand guidelines. Coordinate with external video production vendors, including videographers, editors, voiceover artists, and other creative professionals. Manage video vendor costs, negotiate pricing, and ensure projects remain within approved budgets. Manage the production process from pre-production and filming through editing, revisions, and final delivery. Review video footage and edits to ensure quality, accuracy, brand consistency, and alignment with the approved creative direction. Track and project manage a high volume of video projects simultaneously. Establish project timelines, communicate deadlines, and provide regular updates to clients, partners, and internal stakeholders. Manage client feedback and revision requests while keeping projects on schedule and within scope. Develop project quotes and cost estimates based on production requirements, timelines, locations, talent, equipment, and editing needs. Maintain accurate project documentation, budgets, schedules, vendor costs, and production records. Identify opportunities to improve production workflows, vendor relationships, turnaround times, and overall product quality. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in communications, marketing, film, media production, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. Experience managing video production, creative services, marketing, or multimedia projects. Strong scriptwriting, storytelling, and creative-development skills. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, budgets, and stakeholders at the same time. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality work. Experience working directly with clients and translating business objectives into creative concepts. Ability to develop accurate project scopes, quotes, and production estimates. Experience managing vendor relationships, pricing, and production costs. Familiarity with video production processes, including pre-production, filming, post-production, editing, and final delivery. Proficiency with project management and collaboration platforms. Preferred Qualifications Experience working in an agency, digital marketing, media, or client-services environment. Experience managing external video production vendors and freelancers. Familiarity with video editing software and production equipment. Knowledge of video marketing strategies for websites, social media, paid advertising, and other digital platforms. Experience developing scalable video products or production workflows. What Success Looks Like The Video Project Coordinator will consistently deliver high-quality video projects that meet client objectives, remain within scope and budget, and are completed on time. This individual will also help strengthen our video product offering by improving processes, controlling vendor costs, expanding production capabilities, and creating an excellent experience for clients and partners. Salary: $50-$75K About Hearst Newspapers: With 2,500 employees across the nation, HNP represents a network of 24 daily and 52 weekly publications, including the San Francisco Chronicle, Houston Chronicle, San Antonio Express-News and Albany Times Union, several top digital-only news and lifestyle sites, marketing services businesses, and entertainment businesses such as King Features Syndicate. At HNP, we are investing in new and innovative ways to tell stories – growing newsrooms, diversifying tools, evolving platforms – to support the millions of people who trust us each month to help them make decisions, take action and be inspired.

job.title: Account Coordinator
job.description: KATZ Radio Group Current employees and contingent workers click here to apply and search by the Job Posting Title. As the nation’s largest media representation firm, Katz Media Group delivers local relevance at scale. Whether you want one idea that sounds local in a hundred different markets or a hundred unique ideas, we have your solution. Over our long history, the Katz name has been synonymous with leadership in the media industry. Founded in 1888, Katz was the nation’s first media representation firm. Today, Katz Media Group is comprised of two divisions, Katz Radio Group and Katz Television Group. Collectively, the company represents both the on-air and online assets of more than 4,000 radio stations and 800 television stations, making Katz Media Group the largest media representation company in America. In addition to our deeply rooted media expertise, our unique regional sales structure is key to driving our clients’ success. Katz Media Group is based in New York City, with 15 regional offices across the country, providing advertisers and agencies with local expertise and insights across the nation. Be a part of the largest media representation company in America. At Katz Media Group, we have the best, brightest and boldest talent in the media industry — individuals who deliver unparalleled value for our business partners and clients. We are looking for people who can grow, think, dream and achieve. Every employee brings inspiration and imagination to our constantly evolving and expanding business. If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. At Katz Media we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do! What We Need: At Katz Media Group, we strive for success and support our teams that are dedicated to excellence in client service. You’ll play a vital role in helping our sales teams deliver on our mission to super-serve our clients and listeners. You’ll be the operational backbone that ensures our sales process runs smoothly, efficiently, and with heart. What You'll Do: Support Account Executives in the pre-sale and post-sale process, including proposal development, order entry, campaign tracking, and reporting. Coordinate with internal departments (traffic, production, digital, promotions) to ensure flawless execution of campaigns across radio, digital, podcast, social, and event platforms. Prepare sales materials such as presentations, recaps, and client-facing documents using tools like PowerPoint, Salesforce, and internal systems. Monitor campaign performance and assist in compiling data for client reporting and renewals. Manage deadlines and deliverables to ensure all client expectations are met or exceeded. Serve as a liaison between sales, programming, and operations to ensure alignment and communication. Assist with billing and reconciliation to ensure accuracy and timely processing. What You'll Need: Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (especially Excel and PowerPoint); Salesforce experience is a plus. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. A collaborative mindset and a passion for delivering exceptional client service. What You'll Bring: Respect for others and a strong belief that others should do this in return Ability to work within standardized procedures and an understanding of when to escalate Skills to solve straightforward problems using established procedures Close attention to detail, following up until issues are resolved Common courtesy when communicating with coworkers and outside contacts Compensation: Salary to be determined by multiple factors including but not limited to relevant experience, knowledge, skills, other job-related qualifications, and alignment with market data. $19.78 - $24.73 Location: Atlanta, GA: 3495 Piedmont Rd, Bldg 11, Suite 215, 30305 Position Type: Regular Time Type: Full time Pay Type: Hourly Benefits: iHeartMedia’s benefits offering is flexible and offers a variety of choices to meet the diverse needs of our changing workforce, including the following: Employer sponsored medical, dental and vision with a variety of coverage options Company provided and supplemental life insurance Paid vacation and sick time Paid company holidays A Spirit day to encourage and allow our employees to more easily volunteer in their community A 401K plan Employee Assistance Program (EAP) at no cost – services include telephonic counseling sessions, consultation on legal and financial matters, emotional well-being, family and caregiving ​A range of additional voluntary programs, such as spending accounts, student loan refinancing, accident insurance and more! The Company is an equal opportunity employer and will not tolerate discrimination in employment on the basis of race, color, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, disability, ethnicity, national origin, marital status, protected veteran status, genetic information, or any other legally protected classification or status. job.title: Account Executive
job.description: iHeartMedia Markets Current employees and contingent workers click here to apply and search by the Job Posting Title. The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it! iHeartMedia, the number one audio company in America , reaches 90% of Americans every month -- a monthly audience that’s twice the size of any other audio company – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad-supported music streaming service. And we were just recognized as one of the Top Media Sales Organizations by The Myers Report! In fact, iHeart has: More #1 rated markets than the next two largest radio companies combined; We’re the largest podcast publisher , with more monthly downloads than the second- and third-largest podcast publishers combined. Podcasting, the fastest-growing new media, today has more monthly users than streaming music services or Netflix; iHeart is the home of many of the country’s most popular and trusted on-air personalities and podcast influencers , who build important connections with hundreds of communities across America; We create and produce some of the most popular and well-known branded live music events in America, including the iHeartRadio Music Festival, the iHeartRadio Music Awards, the iHeartCountry Festival, iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina and the iHeartRadio Jingle Ball Tour; iHeartRadio is the #1 streaming radio digital service in America; Our social media footprint is 7 times larger than the next largest audio service; and We have the only complete audio ad technology stack in the industry for all forms of audio , from on demand to broadcast radio, digital streaming radio and podcasting, which bring data, targeting and attribution to all forms of audio at an unparalleled scale. As a result, we’re able to combine our strong leadership position in audience reach, usage and ad tech with powerful tools and insights for our sales organizations to help them build success for their clients at a more efficient cost than any other option. Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity. Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone. Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia! If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do! What We Need: Looking for a new challenge? Join us as an Account Executive and leverage your proven goal-driven mindset, fast-paced work ethic, and exceptional client service skills. The ideal candidate is ready to hit the ground running and will successfully take advantage of all iHeart’s platforms to exceed their clients’ expectations. What You'll Do: As an Account Executive at iHeart, you'll learn the ins and outs of our Broadcast + Digital Marketing Products, identify and develop new business opportunities through in-person meetings with clients and research, consistent daily cold-calling, and cultivate existing business using our full suite of products. You will collaborate with internal partners to drive revenue, create effective marketing campaigns, and use your storytelling skills to deliver compelling sales presentations fueled by data to best meet your clients’ expectations. What You'll Need: You should be self-motivated (a very “go-getter” attitude!), have excellent relationship-building and problem-solving skills, and communicate persuasively. When people describe you, goal-oriented, expert negotiator and proactive should be at the top of the list. You should be able to plan and multi-task in a fast-paced environment . Comfortable with cold-calling and initiating outreach to prospective clients as part of lead generation efforts. A valid driver's license, auto insurance, and a High School Diploma (College Degree preferred) are required. You should also be skilled in Salesforce, Microsoft Office and social networking platforms. Strong problem-solving skills; by exercising these skills, you help business grow to the fullest potential. Digital/Media Sales experience are a plus but not required. The natural ability to organize and prioritize day-to-day depending on where the biggest priorities may be Additional nice-to-haves include experience managing complex, multi-platform campaigns , analytics experience, iHeart and/or audio advertising background, and are well-connected in the market. What you’ll get You'll have the opportunity for uncapped commission , and the ability to grow business across all categories on a local, regional, and national level no matter where you live A 7-week onboarding program to immerse you in the suite of tools and products available to you The potential to be recognized in our annual iHeartMedia CEO’s Club a nd iHeartMedia President’s Club programs Access to competitive benefits including paid vacation and sick time , paid company holidays , a Spirit day to encourage the opportunity to more easily volunteer in their communities, company-paid mental health and financial education resources, 401(k) matching , learning and development resources, and career navigation support. Access to additional perks include pet (they’re part of the family!), disaster , and legal insurance, student loan refinancing , and discounts on merchandise, tickets to events, and more. The support of fellow team members invested in your success. Envision your first 30 days Week 1: Complete our onboarding journey for a deep understanding of our company, job-specific trainings and spend time with your team. Week 2: Spend more time with your manager to ensure you are aligned on work and communication styles, priorities, and any other expectations. Week 3: Start “owning” your role and leaning into the real day-to-day, of course with your manager’s support and advocacy! Week 4: Prioritize a 30-day check-in to see what else you might need to be most successful in your new role. Interested in learning more about iHeart and our platforms? Visit us at www.iHeartMedia.com to learn more about our company, www.iHeartRadio.com to access all your favorite music, radio, and podcasts, and download the free iHeartRadio app! What You'll Bring: Respect for others and a strong belief that others should do this in return In-Depth knowledge of the media industry and related sales processes Ability to apply expertise in a complex sales environment to service large accounts and/or complicated business segments Confidence to prospect and quickly build rapport with customers, adapting messaging and style based on customer needs Ease working with senior level executives and using influencing skills to negotiations and drive sales Desire to stay abreast of emerging market trends and customer needs to expand relationships and trust Confidence to solve complex problems using analysis, judgement and multiple sources of information Accountability for your own work and a desire to provide guidance to new team members Business development experience with new and existing customers Location: Grand Forks, ND: 505 University Ave, 58203 Position Type: Regular Time Type: Full time Pay Type: Salaried Benefits: iHeartMedia’s benefits offering is flexible and offers a variety of choices to meet the diverse needs of our changing workforce, including the following: Employer sponsored medical, dental and vision with a variety of coverage options Company provided and supplemental life insurance Paid vacation and sick time Paid company holidays A Spirit day to encourage and allow our employees to more easily volunteer in their community A 401K plan Employee Assistance Program (EAP) at no cost – services include telephonic counseling sessions, consultation on legal and financial matters, emotional well-being, family and caregiving ​A range of additional voluntary programs, such as spending accounts, student loan refinancing, accident insurance and more! What We Need: The Vice President, Unified Partnerships is a senior sales leader responsible for driving revenue growth through the development and management of strategic agency and public sector partnerships. This role builds and maintains long-term relationships with key decision-makers and influencers across advertising agencies, government entities, nonprofit organizations, educational institutions, and other public-sector stakeholders. The VP serves as a trusted advisor to agency partners by delivering innovative marketing solutions, identifying new business opportunities, and leveraging a deep understanding of the public sector. This position is responsible for generating new revenue, expanding existing partnerships, developing government contracting opportunities, and leading responses to grants, Requests for Proposals (RFPs), and procurement initiatives. What You'll Do: Strategic Partnership Development Build, maintain, and expand strategic relationships with executive-level decision-makers and influencers within advertising agencies, public sector organizations, and community partners. Develop new partnership opportunities through networking, market research, industry events, referrals, and strategic outreach. Conduct agency and partner capability presentations showcasing the company's comprehensive marketing and media solutions. Collaborate with internal stakeholders to align partnership strategies with organizational growth objectives. Revenue Growth & Sales Leadership Achieve and exceed assigned revenue goals through account growth, new business acquisition, and cross-platform sales initiatives. Create demand for products and services by demonstrating the value and effectiveness of integrated marketing solutions. Identify, qualify, and pursue new prospects while maintaining a robust sales pipeline. Increase revenue per account through strategic planning, client retention, and expansion of services. Utilize data, analytics, and market intelligence to identify emerging opportunities and drive business outcomes. Public Sector & Government Relations Develop and manage relationships with government agencies, municipalities, state agencies, educational institutions, and public-sector organizations. Identify and pursue opportunities within government contracting and public procurement channels. Understand governmental purchasing processes, contract vehicles, compliance requirements, and procurement regulations. Establish strategic partnerships that support public awareness campaigns, community initiatives, and government outreach objectives. Grant & RFP Development Lead and support the development of grant applications, RFP responses, RFQs, and other competitive procurement submissions. Coordinate with internal departments and external partners to create compelling proposals that align with client objectives and funding requirements. Research funding opportunities and government initiatives that align with organizational capabilities. Ensure proposal content, pricing, and compliance requirements are accurate, competitive, and submitted on schedule. Track proposal outcomes and develop strategies to improve future win rates. Media & Marketing Expertise Maintain a comprehensive understanding of all media platforms and marketing channels, including broadcast, digital, social, podcasting, streaming, experiential, and emerging media. Develop integrated marketing solutions that effectively address client challenges and business objectives. Stay informed on industry trends, market conditions, competitive activity, and evolving client needs. Serve as a subject matter expert on media strategy and partnership development. Cross-Functional Leadership Partner with sales, marketing, legal, operations, and leadership teams to execute partnership strategies and client initiatives. Provide mentorship and support to team members involved in partnership development and public-sector sales efforts. Represent the organization at industry conferences, trade associations, public meetings, and community events. What You'll Need: Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Public Administration, or related field; advanced degree preferred. 5+ years of progressive experience in media sales, agency partnerships, business development, government relations, or related fields. Demonstrated success achieving and exceeding revenue targets within complex sales environments. Experience developing and managing strategic partnerships with agencies, corporations, and public-sector organizations. Knowledge of government contracting processes, procurement requirements, and public-sector sales. Experience writing, leading, or contributing to grant applications, RFPs, RFQs, and proposal development. Strong presentation, negotiation, relationship-building, and communication skills. Proven ability to engage C-level executives, agency leadership, elected officials, and public-sector stakeholders. Preferred Qualifications Existing relationships within advertising agencies, government entities, nonprofit organizations, or educational institutions. Experience selling integrated media, marketing, advertising, sponsorships, or communications solutions. Understanding of federal, state, and local government contracting opportunities. Grant writing certification or demonstrated success securing grant-funded partnerships. CRM proficiency and strong analytical skills. What You'll Bring: Achievement of annual revenue and profitability targets. Growth in agency, public-sector, and strategic partnership accounts. Expansion of government contracting and procurement opportunities. Successful submission and win rates of grants, RFPs, and competitive proposals. Client retention, satisfaction, and long-term partnership growth. Development of new business opportunities and strategic market expansion initiatives. Respect for others and a strong belief that others should do this in return In-Depth knowledge of the media industry and related sales processes Ability to apply expertise in a complex sales environment to service large accounts and/or complicated business segments Confidence to prospect and quickly build rapport with customers, adapting messaging and style based on customer needs Desire to stay abreast of emerging market trends and customer needs to expand relationships and trust Confidence to solve complex problems using analysis, judgement and multiple sources of information Compensation: Salary to be determined by multiple factors including but not limited to relevant experience, knowledge, skills, other job-related qualifications, and alignment with market data. In addition to salary, this position is also eligible for commissions. $180,000 - $225,000 Location: El Dorado Hills, CA: 5180 Golden Foothill Pkwy, Suite 120, 95762 Position Type: Regular Time Type: Full time Pay Type: Salaried Benefits: iHeartMedia’s benefits offering is flexible and offers a variety of choices to meet the diverse needs of our changing workforce, including the following: Employer sponsored medical, dental and vision with a variety of coverage options Company provided and supplemental life insurance Paid vacation and sick time Paid company holidays A Spirit day to encourage and allow our employees to more easily volunteer in their community A 401K plan Employee Assistance Program (EAP) at no cost – services include telephonic counseling sessions, consultation on legal and financial matters, emotional well-being, family and caregiving ​A range of additional voluntary programs, such as spending accounts, student loan refinancing, accident insurance and more! job.title: News Anchor/MMJ — Apple Valley News Now | Kennewick, Washington
job.description: About Us Apple Valley News Now is the local ABC affiliate serving the Yakima/Tri-Cities market of Washington state and is part of Morgan Murphy Media. We are a family-owned, people-first company, and our communities are at the core of what we do and who we are. Local journalism is changing — and so are we. We serve our audience wherever they are: on television, streaming, our website and app, and the social platforms they use every day. We believe strong reporting, compelling video and meaningful community connection matter on every screen. About This Opportunity Apple Valley News Now is seeking an innovative, audience-focused News Anchor/MMJ to anchor local newscasts and create distinctive journalism across broadcast, digital, streaming and social platforms. This role is based at KVEW-TV in Kennewick, Washington. The right candidate is a trusted on-air communicator and a curious, versatile journalist who can identify what matters to our community, report it with accuracy and empathy, and adapt each story for the platform and audience it serves. You are comfortable moving quickly on breaking news, connecting directly with viewers and experimenting with new ways to tell local stories. What You'll Do Anchor newscasts, live reports, breaking-news coverage and news briefs with credibility, urgency and personality. Research, pitch, shoot, write, edit and deliver original local stories for television, web, streaming and social platforms. Create platform-native content, including vertical video, live social updates and concise explainers that help audiences understand why a story matters. Turn daily reporting into timely, accurate digital stories, video, headlines, captions and audience-facing updates. Enterprise compelling stories that reflect the people, issues and opportunities shaping the Yakima/Tri-Cities region. Use sound editorial judgment and uphold journalism ethics, accuracy standards, fairness and libel law. Collaborate with producers, digital staff, and newsroom leadership on the strongest presentation for every story. Engage with the community online and in person; build trusted source relationships and listen for story ideas. Participate in producing newscasts and other newsroom responsibilities as assigned by the news director. Operate TV news cameras, mobile devices, editing software and production apps to produce high-quality visual journalism. What You'll Bring At least four years of experience as a multimedia journalist, reporter and/or anchor. A bachelor's degree in journalism, communications or a related field preferred; equivalent experience considered. Demonstrated ability to anchor professionally from the studio and report effectively in the field and live. Strong broadcast, digital and AP Style writing skills. A proven ability to tell clear, engaging stories with video, sound, text and social-first formats. Strong editorial judgment and knowledge of journalism ethics, accuracy standards and libel law. A collaborative, self-directed mindset, with excellent organization and the ability to meet daily deadlines. Curiosity about changing audience habits and enthusiasm for learning new tools, formats and platforms. Experience with Inception and Adobe is preferred but not required. Ability to lift and carry up to 15 pounds. What You'll Get in Return You'll join a supportive newsroom and management team that value your work, your time and your perspective. We are committed to a culture where employees can grow professionally and personally while doing meaningful journalism for the communities we serve. Pay range: $20–$27 per hour Benefits: Medical, dental, vision, prescription, life insurance and Employee Assistance Program benefits for employees and their families. Employees are also offered long-term disability insurance, flexible spending accounts, a 401(k), health savings account, employee referral program and paid time off, including vacation time equivalent to 80 hours per year depending on start date, one hour of sick time for every 40 hours worked, two personal days and nine paid holidays. Apple Valley News Now is an equal opportunity employer. APPLY NOW

job.title: Associate Commerce Editor
job.description: Job Description : About The Post: The New York Post delivers the best in news, sports, entertainment, pop culture and shopping, with wit, irreverence and authority across print, digital, video, audio, app and commerce. The Role: We’re hiring an Associate Commerce Editor for the revenue-generating commerce team. This is not a business reporting role. In this dynamic, expanded position, you will balance daily writing with foundational editing responsibilities, serving as a critical bridge between our reporting and editing desks. You will be responsible for writing a minimum of two short-form deal stories per day, continuing to publish fast, useful shopping stories that drive revenue and taking ownership of editing daily deals, updating evergreen posts and stepping up to manage larger packages when needed. This role is ideal for a prolific commerce reporter ready to hone their editorial judgment, refine their packaging skills and take on emerging leadership responsibilities across the New York Post Digital Network. What You’ll Do: ● Write a baseline of 2–3 commerce stories per shift (deals, explainers, how-tos and buyer’s guides) that drive conversions, ensuring consistent daily revenue-generating output. ● Edit 15+ fast-turn deals and standard shopping content daily from reporters. Move copy from draft to live with speed, ensuring clean formatting, airtight affiliate linking and FTC compliance. ● Take point on executing sponsored content and flat-fee product placements, seamlessly weaving revenue-driven partnerships into daily coverage while maintaining reader trust and the iconic Post voice. ● Step in to report, write or co-edit larger, high-priority features and tentpole packages (Prime Day, Black Friday, Cyber Week) as assigned by leadership. ● Share ownership of the evergreen strategy. Audit and update top-performing posts for price, stock and SEO/AEO/GEO optimization to maximize long-tail revenue. ● Write sharp, on-brand headlines (providing 3-5 variants for testing). Begin providing actionable, constructive feedback to reporters to maintain voice and standards. ● Monitor performance dashboards to iterate headlines, framing and placement. Pitch high-intent stories based on search data, real-time signals and competitor coverage. How We Measure Success: ● Output Balance: Consistent daily writing output (2–3 stories) combined with reliable, rapid editing of assigned copy and on-time handoffs. ● Quality & Accuracy: Clean copy (both written and edited), rigorous fact-checking, zero avoidable corrections and strict link hygiene. ● Impact: Measurable lift in CTR, conversion rates, revenue per session and search visibility for both authored and edited pieces. ● Ownership: Demonstrated progress in editorial decision-making, proactive pitching and the ability to seamlessly pivot between writing and editing mindsets. What You’ll Bring: ● Professional experience commensurate with an associate-level role in features, news or commerce writing, backed by a portfolio of strong clips and early experience (or a demonstrated aptitude) for editing. ● Obsession with the commerce landscape, reader value and producing service-oriented content with a commercial focus. ● Command of the iconic NY Post voice and a proven track record of writing crisp, authoritative headlines. ● Working knowledge of SEO, AEO and GEO, plus social media best practices. ● Comfort reading dashboards (Search Console, GA4, Looker or similar) and using data to pivot quickly to trends or live news without losing accuracy. ● CMS fluency and sharp attention to detail, including mastery of AP style and FTC-compliant disclosures. ● A collaborative, growth-oriented mindset – highly organized, adaptable and ready to take on coaching responsibilities. Nice to Have ● Hands-on familiarity with affiliate dashboards and networks (Amazon Associates, Skimlinks or similar), project management platforms and SEO tools. ● Experience jumping between categories and services that help shoppers protect value. ● Deeper understanding of AEO, GEO and AI overviews. ● Newsletter experience. Note: The New York Post adheres to an on-site work model. This role will be expected to report into the office 5 days per week. New York Post Data Labs is seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Commerce Business Analyst to join our Data Science and Analytics team. In this role, you will be the dedicated analytics partner for the New York Post Commerce department. You will be responsible for providing insights that drive business growth by analyzing performance metrics, identifying trends, and optimizing our Commerce strategies. This is a crucial position for someone who is passionate about data and its power to inform strategic business decisions in a fast-paced media & Commerce environment. Please note: This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Key Responsibilities: Performance Monitoring: Track and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) for all affiliate marketing campaigns, including clicks, conversions, commission, and return on investment (ROI). Data Reporting: Develop and maintain recurring reports and dashboards using business intelligence tools to provide clear visibility into performance for stakeholders. Strategic Insights: Proactively identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities in data to provide actionable recommendations for improving affiliate program efficiency and profitability. Forecasting & Modeling: Assist in building and maintaining models and forecasts to project future performance needs. A/B Testing & Optimization: Design, execute, and analyze A/B tests to optimize landing pages, offers, and partner performance. Data Partnership: Serve as a dedicated data partner to the Commerce Team, working closely with leadership to translate business goals into data strategy and deliver clear, actionable insights. Data Integrity: Ensure the accuracy and reliability of all data sources, reporting, and analysis. Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Business, Economics, Statistics, Computer Science) or equivalent professional experience. Demonstrated ability to perform in-depth analysis, draw conclusions, and present findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Experience with statistical analysis and data visualization. Strongly Preferred Experience with languages like Python & SQL for data manipulation and statistical analysis. job.title: Page Six Video Lead Editor
job.description: Job Description : The New York Post provides readers with the best in News, Sports, Pop Culture, Fashion and Entertainment – with signature wit, irreverence and authority averaging 90 million unique viewers a month. Over the past 224 years, The Post has evolved into a multi-platform media company spanning print, digital, video, audio, app, television and commerce. The Page Six video team is seeking a Lead Video Editor who will help us make existing series and compelling, shareable videos about celebrities, and fashion - subjects that are the mainstay of the nation’s most iconic gossip column. You should love celebrity journalism and possess deep knowledge about the latest celebrity gossip, trends, feuds, and hookups. You should live and breathe celebrity lifestyle, fashion and social media, with your fingers on the pulse. You’ll work in an extremely fast-paced environment enabling producers to hit production targets and goals. You’ll be the lead editor for the most important Page Six video series, both the audience favorites and the branded content as well. You’ll help create sizzles and other marketing assets as needed. You’ll supervise the rest of the editors, giving them creative notes, video editing workflow best practices, troubleshooting problems and overall quality control. You’ll coordinate media backups with our production management team. And work with our team and creative director to have graphic guidelines as well as create custom graphics and thumbnails to help click through rates. You must edit fast and with a flourish. Expertise with key products in Adobe Creative Suite (Premiere, Photoshop, After Effects) as well as Adobe graphic templates. You’ll edit videos for digital platforms using a mix of original footage, stock footage and social media content. Along with editing digitally-native video, you will help generate our content, pitching video ideas daily and contributing to the team brainstorming. We seek a candidate who is excited about new types of multimedia storytelling and has a track record of creating digital video in a fast-paced news organization. Must be aware of the latest formats and trends in digital video as a distinct form of content versus television. This is a fast-paced job that requires a love of all things celebrity, a strong editorial sense and the ability to stay organized while multitasking. Like us, you believe news doesn’t have to be boring and you appreciate the odd and unconventional stories as well as important ones. This is an opportunity to work with an iconic media brand as it experiences exponential digital growth. New York Post and Page Six videos have received more than a billion views in the past few years. Responsibilities: ● Lead the editing and post-production of high-priority Page Six video series, branded content, and celebrity-focused digital features optimized for social and web platforms. ● Supervise and mentor video editors by providing creative direction, workflow guidance, troubleshooting support, and overall quality control in a fast-paced newsroom environment. ● Edit compelling, digitally native videos using original footage, stock assets, and social media content while maintaining Page Six’s signature voice, tone, and style. ● Collaborate with producers, creative leadership, and production management to develop graphics packages, thumbnails, sizzle reels, and promotional assets that drive audience engagement and click-through rates. ● Pitch timely celebrity, fashion, and entertainment video concepts daily, contributing innovative storytelling ideas aligned with trending topics and audience interests. ● Manage multiple projects simultaneously under tight deadlines, ensuring efficient turnaround, media organization, backups, and adherence to production schedules. ● Apply advanced post-production techniques including color correction, audio mixing, multi-cam editing, and vertical video formatting using Adobe Creative Suite tools such as Premiere Pro, After Effects, and Photoshop. job.title: Page Six West Coast News Editor, Exclusives
job.description: Job Description : The New York Post delivers news, sports, pop culture and entertainment with unmatched speed, attitude and authority, reaching more than 90 million unique viewers each month. With a 225 year legacy and a fast moving digital first newsroom, the Post operates across print, digital, video, audio, app, television and commerce, and continues to define the city’s most talked about stories. Page Six is one of the most iconic brands in entertainment and pop culture journalism, and we’re looking for a strategic, experienced editorial leader to take it to the next level on the West Coast. Reporting into the News Editor, Exclusives, with a dotted line to the News Editor, California Post, the Page SIx West Coast News Editor, Exclusives will lead Page Six’s enterprise operation on the West Coast and differentiate Page Six and the California Post in an increasingly crowded landscape. This role is responsible for building and guiding a team of reporters focused on original, agenda-setting stories, identifying exclusive beats, and cultivating sources that allow Page Six to break the news, not chase it. This is a senior, strategic role that oversees stories from ideation to execution. The ideal candidate understands that exclusives are integral to the continued growth and evolution of Page Six as a business. We need someone with a proven track record of delivering fast-paced stories on the West Coast while adhering to the highest journalistic standards of sourcing and accuracy. They need a network of industry contacts and a deep understanding of California and what Angelinos really care about in the Entertainment space. Responsibilities: Lead and manage a team of West Coast reporters focused on identifying, developing, and executing exclusive, agenda-setting stories that distinguish Page Six and the California Post from their competitors, drive sustained impact and audience growth. Maintaining existing and developing new industry contacts. Attend daily Page Six Exclusives and California Post meetings to identify source opportunities, troubleshoot reporting challenges, and refine news strategy in real time. Work closely with New York and California newsrooms to drive original reporting and break exclusives. Ensure exclusive story efforts are tightly aligned with broader news priorities and coverage plans of Page Six and the California Post. Contribute to the broader growth of Page Six and the California Post by increasing editorial authority and reputation. The ideal candidate will have: A minimum of 7 years professional experience in entertainment journalism, with significant success breaking news and developing sources. Strong experience leading teams during breaking news situations and advancing stories through diverse sourcing and follow-up reporting. job.title: Prepress Technician
job.description: Job Description : The New York Post delivers the best in news, sports, entertainment and pop culture with wit, irreverence, and authority. Over the past 225+ years, The Post has evolved into a multi-platform media company spanning print, digital, video, audio, app, television and commerce. We are looking for two Prepress Technicians to join our Prepress Operations team. In this role, you’ll play a critical part in our daily print production process, ensuring the accurate, high-quality, and timely preparation and production of our pages. Responsibilities: Output Management Manage the transmission of pages to all print sites, troubleshoot transmission systems, and distribute production schedules. Maintain communication with print sites regarding production updates and page adjustments. Customer Service Monitor pages for technical errors and quality issues, and recommend actions to ensure quality and deadline adherence. Track production times and maintain detailed reports. Foster strong, collaborative relationships with editorial staff and photo editors to ensure high-quality product delivery and effective communication. Review color page proofs and perform necessary adjustments for optimal reproduction. Pagination Build and maintain page plans within production systems according to editorial specifications. Assist editorial users of the Methode pagination system with programming, troubleshooting, and training. Imaging Produce high-quality black-and-white and color image separations. Perform in-depth color correction, adjust contrast and brightness for newsprint, and optimize detail while preserving pixel integrity. Manage time effectively to meet deadlines, prioritizing complex or high-scrutiny imagery as needed. Requirements: 1+ years of experience in prepress production, print operations, or a related technical print environment. Working knowledge of page transmission systems and troubleshooting production/output issues. Strong attention to detail with the ability to monitor pages for technical and quality errors under deadline pressure. Experience with pagination systems (Methode experience preferred), including programming, troubleshooting, and user support/training. Proficiency in image correction and color separation for print, including adjusting contrast, brightness, and color for newsprint reproduction. Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with editorial staff and photo editors. Strong time-management skills, with the ability to prioritize complex or high-scrutiny work under tight deadlines. A proactive approach to process improvement and staying current with emerging prepress technologies. Note: The New York Post adheres to an on-site work model. job.title: PT Editor
job.description: Job Description : The New York Post provides readers with the best in News, Sports, Pop Culture, Fashion and Entertainment – with signature wit, irreverence and authority averaging 90 million unique viewers a month. Over the past 224 years, The Post has evolved into a multi-platform media company spanning print, digital, video, audio, app, television and commerce. The NY Post is looking for an experienced editor for a part-time role with the Sunday staff. The editor is expected to be a line and assignment editor who possesses fine attention to detail, critical thinking skills, and who can also aggressively transform breaking copy on deadline to sing in The Post's unique tabloid voice. The editor should be able to mine, assign and edit an array of stories -- impactful, quirky, scandalous, etc. -- on immediate deadline for our website, and also for the Sunday print edition. The editor must be able to give clear direction to our team of award-winning field reporters and in-office journos. The Sunday team breaks local, national and international news, investigates government corruption, crushes hypocrisy wherever we find it, mines the world for the quirky and the funny, and delivers award-winning, long- and short-form journalism in the boldest tabloid voice. The NY Post is the nation’s 5th-largest U.S. newspaper by circulation and its website routinely generates tens of millions of pageviews every weekend. The ability to handle anything from a breaking brief to a sprawling news feature, in a wide range of subjects, is needed. And you’ll even get to spitball with the rest of us on our world-famous Page 1 headlines. Qualifications: ● Bachelor’s degree or higher ● A minimum of 5 years of editing in a busy newsroom ● Comfortable editing/re-writing both breaking news and long-form stories in lively tabloid prose for web and print ● A keen understanding of the voice of the Post ● A knack for finding stories our readers crave ● A critical eye for facts and tone ● Broad knowledge base ● Willingness to collaborate and ability to communicate with a close-knit team of NYC’s best journalists Note: The New York Post adheres to a hybrid work model. As a part-time editor, you will work an 8-to-10-hour Saturday shift in the office, with the possibility of working additional hours on Thursday and Friday. At The New York Post we recognize that attracting the best talent is key to our strategy and success as a company. As a result, our ranges reflect our good faith estimate to pay fairly as to what our ideal candidates are likely to expect, and we tailor our offers within the range based on the selected candidate's experience, industry knowledge, technical and communication skills, and other factors that may prove relevant during the interview process. This is an important role supporting leaders across the newsroom and commercial functions, helping execute strategies for a fast-moving, high-profile media organization.
