You will partner closely with editorial, creative, product, analytics, and external partners to execute data-informed growth strategies across paid, owned, earned, and partnership channels. The ideal candidate combines performance marketing expertise, strong analytical capabilities, and cross-functional collaboration skills with a passion for media, audience growth, and consumer engagement. job.title: Senior Reporter, News Features
job.description: Job Description : The New York Post delivers the best in news, sports, entertainment and pop culture with wit, irreverence, and authority. Over the past 225+ years, The Post has evolved into a multi-platform media company spanning print, digital, video, audio, app, television and commerce. We are looking for a driven, fearless Senior Reporter to join our News Features team, focused on high-quality, high-impact investigations, exclusives and deep dives into current events. Our goal is to drive the news rather than just following what everyone else is doing — and to expose the unexpected sides of front-page hot topics. To excel in this role, you need a proven track record of producing in-depth, multi-source stories that have moved the cultural needle. We want someone bursting with inspired ideas. Responsibilities: Break exclusives, identifying and producing angles that others miss Turn around high quality investigative pieces on tight timelines when breaking news demands it. You should be equally comfortable chasing enterprise investigative projects and jumping into fast-breaking developments, always finding the sharpest angle and the most compelling way to tell the story Pitch fresh ideas multiple times a week — staying ahead of the curve and also creatively reacting to the news cycle Maintain the highest standards in reporting, ensuring accuracy and an understanding of journalistic ethics and legal standards (including source protection, verification and libel and defamation) This position involves some domestic travel Qualifications: 5+ years of newsroom experience, with a strong focus on features writing and breaking exclusives Ability to produce sparkling, thorough and accurate copy on deadline A tenacious attitude and hunger to land the big gets A deep curiosity about everything from true crime to Hollywood, tech to wealth, politics to education, including national affairs and only in New York stories — and the power players in all these worlds A bright, clean writing voice and nimble talent for picking up the signature Post attitude and style An instinctive knack for getting anyone to talk and the ability to verify what they say At least five years of writing experience at a publication, including long-form features and interviews Preferred Qualifications: An understanding of and ability to locate court filings and financial, business and real estate records to support exclusive reporting On-camera and/or social content creator experience Note: The New York Post adheres to an on-site work model (subject to change based on business needs). job.title: Senior Software Engineering Manager
job.description: Job Description : The New York Post is one of America’s most iconic and recognizable news brands — delivering bold headlines, unforgettable scoops, and sharp commentary since 1801. With a legacy built on fearless j ournalism and a distinctly New York attitude, The Post has evolved far beyond its print roots to become a modern media powerhouse. Today, the New York Post Digital Network is one of the most influential voices in the industry, reaching over 80 million unique users each month across our expansive, ever-growing portfolio. Anchored by NYPost.com, PageSix.com, and Decider.com, our digital brands deliver must-read breaking news, sports, entertainment, pop culture, and lifestyle coverage with the same wit, edge, and energy that define The Post. With innovation at our core, we’ve built a true multi-platform ecosystem — spanning web, mobile apps, video, audio, social, print, TV, and commerce. From viral headlines and exclusive stories to original series, podcasts, and live events, we’re engaging audiences where they are — and always on the pulse of what’s next. We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineering Manager to join our technology team and lead the systems that power The Post’s digital future. This is a hands-on engineering role with core responsibilities around infrastructure services, data pipelines, personalization systems, consumer AI, internal AI tooling, and custom APIs across AWS and GCP projects. You are a hands-on technical leader who builds robust high-performance services for websites. You will own the plumbing that enables our newsroom, data science, marketing, and product teams to deliver cutting-edge digital experiences at scale. You’ll work alongside technology leadership in a fast-paced newsroom. You will partner with editorial leaders, share architectural solutions with other business units in the US, UK, and Australia, and direct your engineering team with experienced tactics and thoughtful strategy. Please Note: Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States on a permanent basis. Sponsorship, including employment visa sponsorship or transfer, is not available for this position now or in the future. Key Responsibilities: Manage and support a small team of high-achieving agile software and data engineers. Design, build, and operate cloud-based APIs supporting specialized needs of our consumer websites, native mobile apps. Work daily with compute services, query services, storage services, and big data services with technologies like Vertex AI, Lambdas, DynamoDB, Cloud Functions, S3, Kubernetes, Glue, and BigQuery. Be able to personally troubleshoot an issue from Javascript in a browser down through DNS, networking, applications, containers and operating systems or serverless services, and into dependent service tiers. Own data ingestion pipelines for real-time and batch processing of large-scale content and event data. Understand how to implement and scale custom APIs to support editorial workflows, AI, personalization, analytics, and user-facing applications. Own the team’s codebases, pull requests, testing, maintenance and release process. Partner with product, editorial, and data science teams to deliver infrastructure and services that meet business needs. Monitor, optimize, and improve the reliability, security, and cost efficiency of cloud-based systems. Communicate and present a vision for both technical and non-technical audiences. Organize architecture discussions. Run and/or supervise agile sprint ceremonies. Qualifications: Must-Haves MS or BS in computer science, or related field. 10+ years of professional software engineering experience. 5+ years experience leading engineering teams. Agile best practices. Proficiency in modern programming languages and frameworks such as Python, Node.js, or Go. Solid familiarity of common AWS and/or GCP services . Robust experience with REST and GraphQL APIs, authentication/authorization, and API best practices. Firm grasp of the tools of the trade including AI tools, IDEs, Git, JIRA, and agile methodologies. Comfort with code reviews, unit tests, QA and UAT processes, and knowledge of end-to-end testing frameworks. Strong troubleshooting skills Attention to detail, thoroughness, a proactive approach to problem-solving, and a comfort in diving in and learning things from scratch. Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Great-to-Have Experience Familiarity with content-management systems, media, news, publishing, video technology, ad technology, or other high-traffic consumer-facing industries. Hands-on experience with generative-AI models, LLM prompting, and/or machine learning. Personalization and recommendation systems. Experience building and deploying data pipelines (e.g., Airflow, Dataflow, Glue, or similar tools) Comfort with Linux administration, shell scripting, ssh, crontabs, etc. Experience with monitoring, logging, dashboard, and alarming tools (e.g., CloudWatch, Datadog, Splunk, etc.) Knowledge of data warehouse technologies (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, etc.) Understanding of CI/CD workflows and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes a plus) Note: The New York Post follows a hybrid work model. This position would be expected to be in the office a minimum of 3 days per week (subject to change). job.title: Social Media Intern (Newsroom)
job.description: Job Description : The New York Post provides readers with the best in News, Sports, Pop Culture and Entertainment – with signature wit, irreverence and authority averaging 90 million unique viewers a month. Over the past 224 years, The Post has evolved into a multi-platform media company spanning print, digital, video, audio, app, television and commerce. From celebrity news to viral stories and breaking headlines, the New York Post is the place where news, culture, and entertainment collide. We are looking for a dynamic and creative Social Media Intern (24 hrs/week) to join our Audience Development team this summer. If you’re a content enthusiast who loves engaging with a massive audience, staying on top of trends, and making an impact across social platforms, this is your chance to gain hands-on experience with a world-class media brand! You’ll be working for one of the most influential news brands in the world, helping to drive engagement and grow our audience. Note: This internship is scheduled to run from February 2, 2026 - April 10, 2026 . Participants are expected to work part time hours and adhere to our on-site work schedule. Open to current juniors and seniors pursuing a BA, MA students, and recent graduates who completed their degree within the past year What You’ll Do: Assist in managing and creating content for the New York Post’s social media accounts across platforms like Instagram, Twitter, Facebook, and TikTok. Engage with our vibrant audience by responding to comments, sharing updates, and sparking conversations. Help discover and curate viral content to keep our feeds fresh, fun, and trending. Collaborate with the editorial team to highlight breaking news, top stories, and exclusive Post content. Analyze social media performance to help optimize strategies and increase engagement. Gain valuable experience in social media management, content creation, and audience growth. What We’re Looking For: A passionate, social media-savvy student or recent grad with experience in a news or newsroom setting A strong communicator with a creative flair who knows how to capture attention with a single post. Someone who’s up to date on social media trends, viral content, and pop culture—especially in the fast-paced world of news. A team player who can collaborate across departments, with a go-getter attitude and enthusiasm for learning. Previous social media experience is a plus, but a genuine passion for digital content and engagement is key. job.title: Washington Correspondent
job.description: Job Description : The New York Post provides readers with the best in News, Sports, Pop Culture, and Entertainment – with signature wit, irreverence, and authority, averaging 90 million unique monthly viewers. Over the past 225 years, The Post has evolved into a multi-platform media company spanning print, digital, video, audio, app, television, and commerce. Politics is core to who we are — and nobody covers it like The Post. We break big stories, stir the pot, and shine a light on what’s really going on in the nation’s capital. From policy drama and power grabs to scandals and backstabbing, we’re looking for someone who gets the whole DC circus and can help lead the way in breaking news. The New York Post is seeking an enterprising DC-based Washington Correspondent to join our growing DC team and cover the fast-moving world of Washington politics. This reporter will break exclusive stories, expose what’s happening behind the scenes in government, and bring readers sharp, authoritative coverage of how decisions in the capital shape the nation. Land interviews with power brokers in DC politics Cover legislative battles, policy shifts, elections, and key political figures. Break exclusive stories and find fresh angles on widely covered issues that others will chase Build and maintain a strong network of sources, from lawmakers and lobbyists to administration and campaign officials. job.title: Assistant Chief Engineer
job.description: FOX4 (WDAF-TV) is looking for a hands-on broadcast engineer to work alongside the Chief Engineer keeping our television plant on the air, and to help build what comes next. This is a television engineering job first. Our SDI plant, control rooms, and live newscasts are the product, and they have to work every single day. At the same time, the station is expanding into connected TV and streaming delivery, and whoever takes this role will have a real hand in shaping that side of the operation as it grows. We would rather hire someone who can trace a signal, read a rack, and stay steady during a live show, and then teach them the rest. Core Responsibilities Broadcast and Production Systems Troubleshoot, repair, and maintain studio, control room, and master control systems Trace and manage signal flow across a large SDI plant, including routing, conversion, monitoring, and audio distribution Support live news production, including Ross OverDrive automation, production switchers, graphics systems, and audio consoles Respond quickly and calmly when something breaks on the air Create and maintain clear documentation of how systems are wired and how they are repaired Information Technology and Networking Keep broadcast-attached servers, workstations, shared storage, and backups running in coordination with corporate IT Maintain switches, VLANs, and the networks our production and newsroom systems depend on Apply updates and follow the cybersecurity practices set by Nexstar corporate IT Please note: this is broadcast IT, not a help desk or enterprise system administration role. Corporate IT owns the enterprise side. What we need here is someone who understands how the network serves the plant. Streaming and Connected TV Help support and expand our connected TV and streaming encoding, distribution, and monitoring Work with the Chief Engineer to plan how new delivery paths fit alongside existing linear infrastructure Bring ideas about how the plant should evolve, not just keep the lights on No prior CTV or streaming experience is required. Curiosity and a willingness to learn matter more. Facilities and Operations Assist with generator, UPS, HVAC, power, and physical security systems Support readiness during severe weather and power events Assist with transmitter and tower site maintenance under the direction of the Chief Engineer Help maintain a safe, efficient, and reliable technical environment Project and Vendor Management Research and evaluate new technology for integration into station operations Request quotes, coordinate vendors and contractors, and oversee project timelines Track capital and special projects through planning, installation, and documentation Maintain accurate technical inventories and service records Leadership and Collaboration Serve as the senior technical contact when the Chief Engineer is off site or unavailable Provide practical guidance to maintenance engineers and operations staff Communicate clearly with newsroom, production, and corporate personnel Maintain a calm, professional demeanor under pressure and during live operations Qualifications What We Require: Hands-on broadcast or live production technical experience. You have personally traced signal, terminated cable, read a rack, and used test gear Three or more years in broadcast engineering, television technical operations, or live production technology Working comfort with Windows systems and basic networking, enough to be useful rather than expert level Composure during live television, and the judgment to know what to fix first Ability to lift up to 50 pounds and work safely in studios, racks, catwalks, and rooftop environments Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record Willingness to be on call and respond after hours during severe weather and power events Preferred but Not Required Experience with Ross Carbonite, or comparable production switchers Windows Server and Active Directory familiarity SBE certification or an FCC General Radiotelephone License An associate or bachelor’s degree in engineering, information technology, or a related field. Equivalent hands-on experience carries the same weight The Right Fit This position is designed for a well-rounded engineer who thrives at the intersection of broadcast and IT. You will be empowered to maintain, improve, and innovate across all technical systems while providing vital support to a fast-paced, live news environment. The ideal candidate is a steady hand, a creative problem solver, and a trusted partner ready to help lead one of Kansas City’s most dynamic media operations.

job.title: Multi-Platform Producer
job.description: Multi-Platform News Producer Summary: This role is responsible for creating news content across several news platforms including television, digital and social media. The ideal candidate will start with story ideas and tips, verify information and then write stories and create videos and graphics. This role originates content for television, streaming newscasts, our website and apps, social media, YouTube and other platforms. This is the perfect role for someone who loves pursuing a good story and presenting that news in a way that connects with users and viewers. This role may include working early mornings, nights and/or weekends. Essential Functions: Maintain working knowledge of current events, community issues and local news sources and resources. Monitor all forms of media, news tips and internal resources in order to be quick to report breaking news stories. Always be on the hunt for exclusive or trending content that will grow engagement and viewership. Curate and aggregate a steady stream of interesting content that is packaged and promoted in a way that generates engagement with users/viewers on television and digital and social media. Understand the needs of different platforms. Find opportunities to efficiently create content that works in multiple places and know when something unique is needed. Use great video, photographs, graphics and strong writing tailored to each medium. Knowledge of best practices to grow audience – on digital: attention-grabbing headlines, alerts, images and social content; on television: – teases, succinct and lively writing, use of video and graphics to showcase a report. Produce breaking news content including push alerts, on-air tickers, digital articles, television scripts and social graphics. Use analytics to review and learn from previous work and to guide future decisions. Edit and clip video content to be used across all platforms. Build positive working relationships with newsroom staff and management. Promote and distribute news content across all platforms. Demonstrate solid news judgement. Strong initiative and attention to detail. Flexibility to perform additional duties. Skill/Experience Requirements Two years experience in journalism – including television news and/or digital news content. Ability to be fast and first at breaking news; experience with severe weather coverage a plus. Strong news writing skills. Ability to write for both digital and broadcast. Strong multi-tasking abilities. Organized, technical problem-solver, ability to make reasoned and fast decisions Ability to quickly learn new things and adapt to change. Capable of researching, interviewing and writing original news stories for digital and television. Working knowledge of AP Style. Enjoys working on a shift team. Communicates clearly and quickly with team members. Schedule flexibility. Responds well to feedback. Understands measurement will be based in part on several key performance indicators. Proficiency in MS Office, WordPress, Adobe Premiere and Photoshop, AP ENPS are plusses. Education Requirements Bachelor’s degree Salary Range: $25-$28.50/hr. based on experience. To Apply : Please visit the Work for Us page at KDVR.com: https://kdvr.com/contact/jobs-at-fox31-denver-kwgn or at the Nexstar Website at: https://nexstar.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com/nexstar to complete the application process. To be considered for this job you must apply online . No Calls **** EOE/MINORITIES/FEMALES/VETERANS/DISABLED**** KDVR/KWGN is an equal opportunity employer that seeks diversity in our workforce. All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply. KDVR.KWGN values the contribution of its employees. We recognize their efforts by offering a competitive compensation plan and an array of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, 401(K), and more. We are committed to a drug and alcohol-free workplace. Any job offer is conditional upon satisfactorily completing a background and DMV check. job.title: Multimedia Journalist/Anchor
job.description: The MMJ/Anchor creates and presents original news and other interesting content across broadcast, streaming, digital, social, and emerging platforms in a manner that is clear, engaging, and meaningful to consumers. The successful candidate is an enterprising storyteller who can develop story ideas, report, write, shoot, edit, publish, and present content that connects with audiences wherever they consume information. This position combines strong on-air presentation skills with the ability to create compelling content that informs, engages, and serves the communities we cover. Responsibilities: • Creates original news, feature, lifestyle, consumer, and other interesting content through enterprise reporting, research, interviews, and community engagement. • Anchors live and recorded programming across broadcast and streaming platforms. • Develops original story ideas and content that inform, engage, and grow audiences across multiple platforms. • Produces original content for CW39+, including live streams, interviews, feature stories, special projects, and audience-focused programming. • Shoots, writes, edits, publishes, and presents content independently as assigned. • Creates content for digital and social platforms, including articles, videos, live streams, and audience engagement initiatives. • Identifies trends, issues, people, and stories that matter to local audiences and develops compelling content around them. • Collaborates with producers, reporters, photographers, and digital teams to create impactful multi-platform coverage. • Writes and delivers content in a clear, conversational, authentic, and audience-focused manner. • Conducts interviews with newsmakers, community leaders, subject matter experts, and members of the public. • Responds to breaking news and other urgent newsroom situations as required. • Participates in promotional activities, community events, and public appearances. • Engages with viewers and users through social media and other digital platforms. • Ensures that all content meets company standards for journalistic integrity, accuracy, and production quality. • Performs special projects and other duties as assigned. Requirements & Skills: • Bachelor's degree in Broadcast Journalism, Communications, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and work-related experience. • Fluency in English. • Excellent communication skills, both oral and written, with the ability to ad lib when required. • Minimum five years' experience in reporting, anchoring, multimedia journalism, or content creation for news and media platforms. • Superior on-air presence and live presentation skills. • Strong storytelling abilities across broadcast, streaming, digital, and social platforms. • Demonstrated ability to develop original story ideas and create enterprise content. • Experience shooting, writing, editing, and publishing content across multiple platforms. • News judgment with a strong understanding of current events, issues, and community interests. • Ability to create content that informs, engages, and connects with diverse audiences. • Strong social media and audience engagement skills. • Ability to work independently while managing multiple deadlines and priorities. • Ability to effectively listen, understand challenges, and collaborate with a team to shape solutions. • Proficiency with newsroom, editing, streaming, and digital publishing technologies. • Valid driver's license with a good driving record. • Flexibility to work any shift.

job.title: News Director
job.description: Rockford, Illinois Looking for a place where you can build a successful career and enjoy an active lifestyle? Rockford offers the perfect blend of opportunity, affordability, and adventure. Located just 90 minutes from Chicago and within easy reach of Milwaukee and Madison, Rockford combines the energy of a growing city with the comfort of a welcoming community. Set along the scenic Rock River and surrounded by beautiful parks, forests, and outdoor recreation, the region offers endless opportunities to explore. Whether you're hiking and biking miles of scenic trails, kayaking along the river, visiting world class gardens and museums, enjoying live entertainment, or discovering local restaurants and breweries, there's always something new to experience. Rockford delivers the amenities of a larger metro area while maintaining a lower cost of living and an exceptional quality of life. The Rockford Region is a community on the rise, offering room to grow professionally while enjoying more time for what matters most. It is a place where careers thrive, families put down roots, and adventure is never far away. Come see why more people are choosing to call Rockford home. Your next opportunity starts here. It's fun to work in a company where people truly believe in what they are doing! Our brand is Your Home Team. And we live it every day with the most tenured news team, Eyewitness News! We offer more news and locally produced programming than any other station in the market as well as unmatched digital delivery on https://www.mystateline.com/ . The News Director leads and supervises all aspects of news, digital, weather, and sports content across all platforms. • Leads, motivates, and develops the News Department, including content creation for broadcast, digital, social media, website, and streaming platforms. • Provides strategic direction for daily news coverage, breaking news, investigative reporting, special projects, and major event coverage across all distribution channels. • Drives a digital first content strategy with a strong focus on audience growth, engagement, and streaming. • Demonstrates a proven track record of successful digital execution and innovation. • Plans and manages departmental staffing, training, coaching, and performance evaluations. • Makes decisions regarding hiring, employee development, promotion, and termination. • Reviews and critiques newscasts and digital content daily to improve quality, storytelling, and overall presentation. • Assigns projects and ensures deadlines and strategic objectives are met. • Develops and executes strategies to achieve audience growth and ratings goals. • Evaluates operational and technology needs to ensure the production of high quality content. • Collaborates with station leadership to establish and achieve company goals and initiatives. • Performs other duties as assigned. Requirements & Skills: • Bachelor’s degree in Broadcast Journalism, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and work-related experience. • Fluency in English. • Excellent communication skills, both oral and written. • Minimum five years’ experience in news programming production, with at least two years’ experience in a leadership role. • Experience guiding, directing and motivating subordinates, including setting performance standards and monitoring performance. • Experience establishing long-range objectives and specifying the strategies and actions to achieve them. • Ability to identify the developmental needs of others and to coach, mentor or otherwise help others to improve their knowledge or skills. • Experience preparing and maintaining departmental budgets. • Proficiency with computers, telephones, copiers, scanners, fax machines and other office equipment. • Ability to meet deadlines, prioritize assignments and handle multiple tasks simultaneously. • Ability to effectively listen to fully understand employee needs and communicate with a team to shape a solution. COMPENSATION RANGE - $ 85K - $95K annualized Benefits: Our comprehensive benefits package includes, but not limited to, medical (with multiple plan options), dental, and vision insurance, paid time off, a 401(k) with company matching contributions, life insurance, Paid Parental Leave and more. Interested candidates should apply on our website: mystateline.com/About Us/Work for Us Nexstar Broadcasting is an equal opportunity employer #IL-Onsite

job.description: The Staff Accountant supports the Corporate Accounting Department in various tasks related to the monthly accounting close process including the analysis of financial performance of various TV stations, preparing monthly journal entries, complying with monthly internal SOX controls, and other accounting functions to assist with the monthly close process. Essential Duties & Responsibilities: Assist with the preparation of monthly accounting journal entries primarily depreciation journal entries and general ledger journal entries for approximately 30 to 40 markets Complete monthly construction in process (CIP) reconciliations for designated markets (approx. 30 to 40) along with working with Chief Engineers and Regional Business Managers (RBMs) to appropriately review the designated markets CIPs for (i) capitalization, and (ii) review for items to expense if needed based on review of the project and applying GAAP accounting rules Maintain Station Fixed Asset records for a set of TV stations that are assigned including preparation of the monthly journal entries for depreciation, fixed asset additions and disposals in the Fixed Asset system Perform annual (around 4th quarter) fixed asset inventories for designated markets Scan manual/paper copy journal entries on a rotating basis to pdf and save on the shared drive Mail approx. 50 to 100 hundred checks on a rotating basis twice a month twice each week Assist depositing manual checks received along with booking the corresponding journal entry Review station balance sheet reconciliations monthly Review and or analyze general ledger accounts Perform AP edit reviews of operating expenses and capital Review sales tax on invoices for accuracy and inclusion vs. exclusion Prepare quarterly / annual schedules (roll forwards/analysis) for the external auditors Various ad hoc accounting projects as assigned by the Functional Controller Assist with the daily communications between Corporate and the Chief Engineers Perform certain other functions as needed Requirements & Skills : Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and work-related experience. Excellent communication skills, both oral and written along with attention to detail. Minimum two years’ experience in corporate accounting or financial analysis, preferably in the broadcast industry and/or a public company environment.

job.title: Traffic Coordinator
job.description: Nexstar Media Group, Inc. has an immediate opening for a Traffic Coordinator! Do you have a knack for numbers? Are you a schedule follower? If keeping the largest television station ownership group in the country on-the-air and broadcasting around the clock could enhance your career journey, Nexstar Media Group invites you to be our next behind-the-scenes star. Help us broadcast and program commercials from coast to coast in Traffic operations hubs located in Salt Lake City! Nexstar owns America’s largest local broadcasting group comprised of top network affiliates, with 200 owned or partner stations in 117 U.S. markets reaching 220 million people. In addition to delivering exceptional content and service to our communities, Nexstar provides premium multiplatform and video-on-demand advertising opportunities at scale for businesses and brands seeking to leverage the strong consumer engagement of our compelling content offering. We are extremely proud of our collection of outstanding television stations, digital businesses and talented employees nationwide. Within Nexstar, we are investing and building for the future while forging a culture that promotes our entrepreneurial spirit, embraces bold thinking and challenges the conventional way. If you have curiosity, passion, are inclusive and collaborative, work with us and let’s continue to make a difference for all our stakeholders ~ our colleagues, our customers, our owners, and the communities in which we operate. What you’ll accomplish as a Traffic Coordinator (Essential Duties): · Multitasking with new orders and adjustments to existing logs · Daily interaction with television professions in markets across the country · Cross department collaboration with sales, engineering, master control, etc. · Processing of incoming orders and sales contract translation into the sales module · Daily generation of commercial and programming logs for 200 stations in 117 markets · Scheduling commercials and applying traffic instructions to every scheduled commercial · Inventory control, database library management, broadcast automation, logistical issues · So much more What you’ll need as a Traffic Coordinator (Preferred Qualifications): High school diploma English language skills Meticulous data-entry skills Excellent communication skills, both oral and written Knowledge of, and the ability to interpret, sales contracts Ability to comply with deadlines and perform under pressure Proficiency with computers and an ability to learn new software quickly At least 1 year of experience in clerical support or administrative assistance If this sounds like you, Nexstar Media Group could be your next home for thriving community involvement, omnichannel advertising innovation and supported career growth. Nexstar offers full-time employees a comprehensive benefits package to include medical, life and short-term disability insurance, worker’s compensation, and unemployment insurance, 401(k) retirement plan, paid holidays, paid vacation, paid sick time, employee assistance program, bereavement leave, jury duty service time off, military leave and medical/maternity and family leave. Nexstar is committed to attracting, developing, and retaining the industry’s top talent. job.title: Weekend Morning Anchor/Reporter
job.description: The WRIC Weekend Morning Anchor/Reporter serves as the primary presenter of weekend news stories and other content for all platforms in a manner that is clear, engaging and meaningful to news consumers. On non-weekend workdays, the Weekend Anchor/Reporter reports and collects, analyzes and presents facts about newsworthy events by interview, investigation or observation for all platforms in a manner that is clear, engaging and meaningful to news consumers. Equal Opportunity Employer/Minorities/Women/Veterans/Disabled. Minimum two years’ experience in news reporting Superior on-air presence Proficiency with computers, telephones, copiers, scanners, fax machines and other office equipment Ability to meet deadlines, prioritize assignments and handle multiple tasks simultaneously Valid driver’s license with a good driving record Flexibility to work any shift Physical Demands & Work Environment: Must be able to sit, conduct telephone conversations, use electronic mail, write letters and memos, conduct face-to-face discussions with individuals or groups, make decisions without supervision, make decisions that impact the results of co-workers, work near others, work outdoors occasionally in all weather conditions, and work indoors in environmentally controlled conditions. job.title: Associate, Hotels & Meetings (External Agency Staff)
job.description:
The NFL Live Events team is responsible for the planning and execution of the league’s tentpole events and International Games. The Associate position plays an integral role in supporting the Events team with the execution of all tentpole events and executive meetings with a focus on hotel management, meeting planning and execution.

This is a long-term hourly contract opportunity based onsite at the NFL League Office in New York, NY.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage the execution of 100+ hotel contracts for future Super Bowl and Draft bids and assist with onboarding process through our supplier portal.
  • Assist with the RFP process and hotel sourcing strategy for NFL International Games, which includes identifying and securing staff, vendor, and headquarters hotel accommodations while managing contract negotiations, and working with Finance on budget considerations.
  • Support the Super Bowl hotel assignment process by working closely with departments and partners assigning 20,000 rooms.
  • Manage hotel reservations for 800+ attendees at all tentpole events which include Super Bowl, Pro Bowl, Combine, Draft, Flag Championships, Hall of Fame, Kickoff, International games and meetings.
  • Execute Super Bowl headquarter hotel operations that include contract management, hotel reservations, meeting space logistics, food & beverage, signage, and vendor coordination.
  • Coordinate planning meetings across all tentpole events for current year and future. This entails sourcing hotels through our RFP platform and tracking proposals.
  • Lead effort for on-site event management for Owners Meetings and department meetings including room block management, client check-in, credential distribution, and registration.
  • Attend all planning meetings, as needed for current and future tentpole events and outline goals and objectives for each trip.
  • Work cross functionally with various internal departments on meetings throughout the year.
  • Reconcile budgets and invoices with finance team on for all tentpole events and meetings.
  • Support the team in various capacities including contract management, updating the special events calendar and tracking budgets.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Minimum 2 years of hotel with a focus on room management and function room operations
  • Adept at contract negotiations and proven experience working with hotel contracts
  • Hotel and venue management with a focus on room block build/management, attrition mitigation, function room costing and management
  • Ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment
  • Ability to lead others and collaborate with a variety of groups at different levels
  • Strong organizational and presentation skills
  • Strong writing and communications skills
  • Proactive self-starter who works well within a team, strong interpersonal skills

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with hotel contracts, negotiating, and meeting planning
  • Experience with Meeting Evolution, Cvent or other event registration sites
  • Strong Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills
  • C level/VIP management and service
  • Knowledge in RFP creation and process

Other Key Attributes / Talent Characteristics:

  • Team player with positive attitude
  • High energy
  • Entrepreneurial spirit
  • Strong work ethic

Physical Demands:

This is a Special Events hotel and VIP management role, at times may require physicality. This could involve lifting, long hours of standing and physical movement during an event and extensive travel requirements.

Travel:

Significant domestic and international travel required, including some weekends, up to 50%. Several weeks on the road during event delivery.

job.title: Associate, HR Operations
job.description:
Overview:

We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented HR Operations Coordinator to join our Shared Services team. This role is helping to enhance the NFL employee experience and scale our HR capabilities. You will have an immediate impact on the overall NFL employee experience as the first point of contact for many employees, ensuring timely and accurate support throughout the employee lifecycle. You will manage HR tickets, process transactions in Oracle HCM. In this highly collaborative role, you will maintain strong working relationships with cross-functional teams, including HR, Payroll, Finance, Compliance, Security, and IT.

Responsibilities:

  • Case Management:
    Manage and resolve tier-1 HR inquiries through ServiceNow, ensuring timely, accurate, and professional responses all questions and issues regarding HR related policies, procedures, and systems, including but not limited to Onboarding, Benefits, Compensation, Learning, Performance, and Offboarding.
  • Process HR transactions including new hires, rehires, transfers, leaves of absence, terminations, personal data changes, and other complicated system transactions
  • Support the talent acquisition processes by posting job requisitions, managing the candidate experience, extending offers, and facilitating onboarding activities.
  • HR Systems Support:
    Enter and maintain employee data in Oracle HCM Cloud, ServiceNow, and UGK, supporting lifecycle transactions and identifying opportunities to streamline or automate recurring processes.
  • Maintain positive working relationships with cross-functional teams as necessary, including Payroll, Finance, Compliance, Security, and IT.

Required Qualifications:

  • Experience:
    2–4+ years in HR Operations, Shared Services, HRIS, or an HR support role. Experience with ServiceNow (or similar ticketing system), Oracle HCM Cloud and UGK preferred.
  • Soft Skills:
    • Positive attitude and strong work ethic.
    • Customer-first mindset with a pleasant, team-oriented demeanor.
    • Eagerness to learn and grow in both HR operations and analytics.
    • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
    • Clear and concise communication skills to collaborate across functions.

Other Key Attributes / Talent Characteristics:

You are driven to improve processes, deliver excellent employee support, and ensure data accuracy. You thrive in collaborative, cross-functional environments and are excited to shape the future of HR Shared Services.

You'll be part of a growing HR Operations team that's focused on efficiency, innovation, and elevating the employee experience. This is a great opportunity for someone early in their HR career who wants to grow in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

job.title: Digital Content Associate (External Agency Staff)
job.description:
NFL Media is seeking a Digital Content Associate, who is tasked with assisting the senior manager of Club Content Relations in all phases of content collection, management, and distribution for cross-platform production teams. This role supports production teams with content clearances, booking, video clipping/links for social and digital distribution, and tentpole content collection and logistics.

Responsibilities

  • Potential candidates must meet the following criteria and perform the following duties:
  • Must be able to follow instructions and work well with others in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to multi-task and prioritize daily assignments
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Demonstrate strong communication skills both verbally and written
  • Ability to meet deadlines under pressure situations
  • Strong football knowledge and awareness of NFL events and stories, ability to quickly identify players and coaches
  • Ability to develop and foster relationships within the NFL and club ecosystem
  • Ability to work closely with content assistants and NFL.com editorial staff to gather and distribute content to NFL Digital Media properties
  • Familiarity with utilizing social media for content gathering
  • Familiarity with sports media landscape and platforms
  • Previous work with an NFL or other professional sports organization a plus
  • Knowledge of Premiere or Adobe a plus
  • Knowledge of Tagboard a plus

job.title: Director, Communications - Flag Football
job.description:
The NFL is seeking a Director, Communications – Flag Football to lead strategic communications for one of the fastest growing areas of the sport. This role will help grow awareness, credibility, and participation in flag football in the U.S. and internationally, while supporting the NFL’s leadership through NFL FLAG and the broader flag football ecosystem.

The Director will shape the narrative for flag football by elevating stories around access, inclusion, athlete pathways, youth and scholastic participation, community impact, and elite competition. This leader will develop integrated media, content, executive visibility, and thought-leadership strategies tied to major growth moments, including NFL tentpole events, flag-specific events, international activations, and the LA28 Olympic Games.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute a multi-year communications strategy that advances flag football growth across youth, scholastic, community, elite, and international levels.
  • Lead storytelling, media relations, executive visibility, and issues preparedness tied to LA28, Brisbane 2032, and long-term Olympic inclusion.
  • Create communications and advocacy materials that support NFHS and state association sanctioning efforts, including stakeholder messaging, announcement plans, and media materials.
  • Drive proactive press strategy across national, local, youth/scholastic, community, lifestyle, sports business, and international media.
  • Partner with Football Operations, International, Marketing, Social, Player Engagement, Legends, Clubs, and external partners across the flag football ecosystem.
  • Lead communications planning and on-site media operations for flag-specific showcases, championships, clinics, activations, and relevant NFL tentpole events.
  • Develop message guides, press materials, briefing documents, FAQs, social/content inputs, and partner-facing assets aligned with league style and terminology.
  • Establish communications KPIs, track performance, report progress, and maintain talking points, holding statements, Q&As, and response plans for flag-related issues.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in communications, Public Relations, Journalism, Marketing, or a related field.
  • Minimum 10 years of experience in communications, public relations, media relations, corporate communications, brand communications, or sports communications.
  • Proven success in developing communications strategies that drive awareness, engagement, participation, reputation, or business outcomes.
  • Strong media relationships and experience with narrative development, message development, executive communications, and spokesperson preparation.
  • Experience leading communications planning, press operations, and on-site media execution at major events.
  • Ability to translate research, participation trends, insights, and performance metrics into clear, compelling stories.
  • Sound judgment, discretion, and composure in fast-paced, high-visibility environments.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in sports, youth/scholastic programming, community impact, grassroots participation, international communications, or major events.
  • Familiarity with schools, state associations, community organizations, clubs, leagues, federations, or governing bodies.
  • Passion for growing youth sports participation and expanding access, inclusion, and pathways for athletes.

Other Key Attributes / Talent Characteristics:

  • Builds trusted relationships and collaborates effectively across teams, partners, and senior stakeholders.
  • Communicates with clarity, confidence, and composure in high-pressure situations.
  • Solves problems, removes barriers, and keeps workstreams moving.
  • Motivates teams and partners to innovate and deliver measurable impact.
  • Supports the growth and development of colleagues, agencies, and partners.

Travel:

  • On-site presence and travel as needed for NFL tentpole events, flag-specific events, and activations throughout the season.

job.title: Director, Fan Engagement Marketing – International Club CRM & Performance Marketing
job.description:
The National Football League (NFL) is seeking an experienced international marketing leader to play a key role in operating and scaling its International 1:1 Club Managed Services function.

This role leads day-to-day execution and operational delivery of a centralized, internal agency model that enables all 32 Clubs to execute compliant, high-quality, localized 1:1 fan engagement across more than 20 international markets.

The Director ensures Clubs receive reliable, scalable support across email, SMS, mobile app, web, and emerging channels by operationalizing league data, platforms, and best practices. Success is measured by execution quality, operational reliability, campaign performance, regulatory adherence, and Club satisfaction, while enabling sustained international fan development.

Responsibilities:

  • International Club Managed Services Execution
    • Support the Senior Director in operating the International 1:1 Club Managed Services model as an internal agency serving all 32 Clubs.
    • Execute against the defined service offering, engagement model, SLAs, intake processes, and prioritization frameworks.
    • Ensure consistent, high-quality delivery across markets, time zones, and languages.
  • Global Operations & Workforce Enablement
    • Manage day-to-day operations of a distributed global workforce (including contingent associates across multiple regions).
    • Implement operating rhythms, workflows, training standards, and QA processes to support high-volume international execution.
    • Support capacity planning and workload balancing to meet Club demand while maintaining quality and compliance.
  • International 1:1 Marketing Delivery
    • Oversee execution of Club-led, league-enabled 1:1 campaigns across email, SMS, push, in-app, and web.
    • Ensure campaigns appropriately leverage behavioral, transactional, and engagement signals within market-specific constraints.
    • Apply testing frameworks and performance insights to drive continuous improvement at scale.
  • Data Privacy, Governance & Compliance Support
    • Execute established data governance and compliance standards for international fan data and PII usage.
    • Partner closely with Legal, Data & Analytics, and MarTech teams to ensure campaign execution aligns with GDPR and local market regulations.
    • Translate regulatory requirements into clear, executable guidelines for managed service teams and Clubs.
  • Club Enablement & Relationship Support
    • Act as a primary operational point of contact for Clubs on international 1:1 campaign execution and best practices.
    • Support Club adoption by delivering reliable service, clear communication, and timely issue resolution.
    • Escalate risks, constraints, and opportunities to the Senior Director with recommended solutions.
  • Cross-Functional Coordination & Reporting
    • Partner with International, Marketing, Data & Analytics, and MarTech teams to align execution with league priorities.
    • Support quarterly planning cycles by translating demand forecasts into execution plans.
    • Contribute to performance reporting, operational insights, and recommendations for scaling impact.

Required Qualifications:

  • 8-10+ years' of experience in CRM, lifecycle marketing, or performance-driven engagement, with international exposure
  • Experience operating within managed services, agency, or shared-services models, ideally in global environments
  • Working knowledge of international data privacy and marketing regulations and their executional implications
  • Demonstrated experience managing distributed teams or partners across regions and time zones
  • Strong executional fluency with MarTech platforms (CDPs, journey orchestration, messaging platforms)
  • Ability to manage high-volume, deadline-driven workflows with consistency and accuracy
  • Background in sports, entertainment, or global consumer brands

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience supporting or scaling internal agency or managed services models in complex organizations
  • Strong operational instincts with the ability to translate strategy into repeatable execution
  • Comfortable working in matrixed environments with multiple stakeholders and dependencies
  • Experience partnering with Legal, Data, and Technology teams in regulated markets
  • Global mindset with sensitivity to cultural and regional differences in fan engagement

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics:

  • Execution-focused operator who takes pride in reliable delivery and operational excellence
  • Service-oriented mindset with a strong commitment to supporting Clubs as internal clients
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple concurrent workstreams
  • Clear, proactive communicator who escalates issues early and constructively
  • Comfortable operating under pressure in high-volume, time-sensitive environments
  • Influence-driven collaborator who builds trust without relying on formal authority
  • Curious, adaptable, and motivated to continuously improve processes, tools, and outcomes
  • Passion for sports – and the NFL in particular – with an appreciation for the role Clubs play in global fan growth

Travel:

  • Up to 25% domestic and international travel required

  • NFL employees are expected to work 40 hours per week, with flexibility to support global operations across international time zones
  • This role requires availability outside of standard business hours, including early mornings, evenings, and occasional weekends, to support international markets and Club needs
  • Due to the global nature of the role, the position carries an on-call responsibility to address time-sensitive issues, campaign execution, or operational needs as they arise across regions

job.title: Director, Professional & Adult Competitive Flag Football
job.description:
The NFL is accelerating the growth of flag football as one of the world's fastest-growing sports and a cornerstone of the future of football. With flag football set to debut at the Los Angeles 2028 Olympic Games, expanding international competition through the International Federation of American Football (IFAF), and the launch of a new professional flag football league in partnership with TMRW Sports, the NFL is making unprecedented investments in the sport's competitive ecosystem worldwide.

The Director, Professional & Adult Competitive Flag Football will help lead the NFL's efforts to strengthen and expand the global competitive flag football landscape. This role will be responsible for managing strategic relationships, developing competition-focused initiatives, and supporting the growth of domestic and international flag football across professional, national team, club, tournament, and recreational environments.

The ideal candidate combines a deep understanding of the competitive flag football ecosystem with strong business acumen, stakeholder management capabilities, and experience operating within complex sports environments. This individual will serve as a key leader in building relationships and aligning stakeholders across leagues, federations, governing bodies, tournament operators, clubs, and other partners to support the long-term growth of flag football globally.

Responsibilities

Competitive Ecosystem Strategy

  • Support the development and execution of the NFL's strategy to strengthen and expand competitive flag football globally.
  • Maintain a comprehensive understanding of the flag football ecosystem, including professional leagues, clubs, tournaments, governing bodies, athletes, coaches, officials, and administrators.
  • Monitor industry trends, competitive structures, and emerging opportunities across domestic and international markets.
  • Develop and manage a national database and intelligence platform tracking participation trends, organizations, competitions, and key stakeholders.
  • Identify opportunities to improve alignment, collaboration, and growth across key stakeholders within the sport.

Professional League & Competition Development

  • Serve as a primary NFL relationship manager with TMRW Sports, the Professional Flag League.
  • Support initiatives that strengthen the professional flag football ecosystem and elevate awareness, participation, and long-term sustainability.
  • Collaborate on strategic initiatives related to league operations, competition development, athlete engagement, and market growth.
  • Identify opportunities to connect professional flag football with broader participation and competition objectives.

International Federations & National Team Engagement

  • Serve as a key NFL liaison to IFAF, national federations, and national team stakeholders worldwide.
  • Support initiatives that strengthen the global national team ecosystem and advance international competition.
  • Support initiatives that advance competitive standards, governance best practices, and competition quality across the global flag football ecosystem.
  • Collaborate with federations and governing bodies to promote alignment on competition structures, calendars, officiating frameworks, and strategic growth initiatives.
  • Support the continued development and quality of IFAF-sanctioned competitions, including World Championships, Continental Championships, Olympic qualification events, and other international tournaments.

Olympic & International Competition Strategy

  • Support the NFL's strategic engagement with the Olympic flag football ecosystem, including LA28 stakeholders, IFAF, National Olympic Committees, and National Governing Bodies.
  • Monitor developments related to Olympic qualification, international competition structures, and future Olympic cycles.
  • Help align NFL priorities with the continued growth and success of flag football within the Olympic movement.

Competition & Event Development

  • Support the growth and visibility of competitive opportunities for both men's and women's flag football across domestic and international markets.
  • Support the growth and enhancement of competitive flag football opportunities across professional, amateur, and international levels.
  • Develop relationships with tournament operators, league operators, clubs, and event organizers.
  • Evaluate opportunities to expand competition offerings and improve the participant and fan experience.
  • Assist in the development of new events, competitions, and initiatives that support growth objectives.

Adult Participation & Recreational Growth

  • Support initiatives that drive participation and engagement in adult recreational flag football.
  • Collaborate with leagues, operators, and partners to identify opportunities to expand adult play opportunities.
  • Develop relationships with organizations that support recreational and amateur competition.
  • Help align adult participation strategies with broader NFL flag football growth objectives.

Strategic Partnerships & Stakeholder Management

  • Collaborate across NFL departments to align competition priorities with broader participation, international, football operations, marketing, and commercial objectives.
  • Identify new business, competition, and partnership opportunities that accelerate the growth of flag football globally.
  • Identify partnership opportunities that advance the NFL's strategic goals in flag football.
  • Support cross-functional initiatives involving internal and external stakeholders.

Industry Leadership & Representation

  • Serve as a subject matter expert on the competitive flag football landscape and stakeholder ecosystem.
  • Deliver strategic recommendations and presentations to NFL leadership and external partners.
  • Support thought leadership initiatives that position the NFL as a leader in the growth of flag football globally.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree required.
  • Minimum 10-12 years of experience in sports business, football operations, league operations, competition management, international sports, partnership management, or related fields.
  • Demonstrated experience managing strategic partnerships and stakeholder relationships across complex sports environments.
  • Strong understanding of the competitive flag football ecosystem, including leagues, tournaments, governing bodies, clubs, and national teams.
  • Experience working with professional sports leagues, national governing bodies, international federations, event operators, or comparable organizations preferred.
  • Proven ability to develop and execute strategic initiatives across multiple stakeholders.
  • Exceptional relationship-building, influencing, and communication skills.
  • Strong project management, organizational, and negotiation skills.
  • Experience managing cross-functional teams and external partners.
  • Public speaking and executive presentation experience required.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Experience working within international sports ecosystems, national team programs, or governing bodies.
  • Familiarity with IFAF, Olympic competition structures, and international sports governance.
  • Experience working with professional sports leagues and emerging sports properties.
  • Global sports experience and demonstrated ability to work across diverse cultural and geographic markets.
  • Knowledge of adult participation and recreational sports programming.

The NFL expects to hire for this position near the middle of the range.   • This position will frequently require evenings, weekends, and international travel to support competitions, events, and stakeholder engagements.

Travel

  • Requires significant domestic and international travel (40%).
  • Frequent attendance at international competitions, stakeholder meetings, and major events.
  • Flexibility to work nights, weekends, and non-traditional hours as business needs require.

job.title: Director, Stadium Network Architecture
job.description:
The National Football League (NFL) is looking for a Director, Stadium Network Architecture with a strong background in network design, engineering, architecture and operations as well as experience with Wireless Design & Spectrum Analysis to join an innovative team of solutions engineers and architects. The Senior Network Architect will be responsible for developing network architecture diagrams, defining technical requirements, and serving as the technical lead for football technology network infrastructure. We are looking for a candidate who can drive the implementation and maintenance of complex and specialized network services, ensuring the highest levels of reliability, performance, and uptime.

This hands-on senior stadium network architect will act as a leader of technical engineering for the Infrastructure Engineering Team across a wide range of areas including the production Football Technology Network, NFL temporary Fan Event Setups, sideline wireless technology and more.

This onsite role can be based out of our Manhattan or Mount Laurel, NJ offices, and requires 30% to 50% travel domestically and internationally.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the design and architecture of Football Technology network services considering performance, redundancy, scalability, and security.
    • Document standards and guidelines for best practice stadium network and wireless architecture as they align to industry standards and best practices.
    • Develop and present comprehensive network design proposals to stakeholders, addressing business requirements and technical specifications.
    • Assist in the research, design and documentation for upgrades and adoption of new network technologies.
    • Provide hands on configuration and escalation support for all stadium network technologies.
  • Responsible for the installation, operation, administration, and maintenance of wired and wireless networks at stadiums and corporate offices.
    • Provide dedicated support for on-site stadium network and Wi-Fi technicians during NFL game days throughout the NFL season.
    • Responsible for managing and maintaining network diagrams, configurations, support, and training documentation.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including operations, security, Events, and others to align network strategies with business goals.
    • Responds to technical escalations for wired and wireless service issues, working with product support teams, IT staff and business groups to ensure resolution.
    • Provide reports for network KPIs to show service levels, capacity analysis, performance, troubleshooting, and areas for improvement in network infrastructure.
    • Provide technical support to various activities and internal infrastructure within the Football Technology segment.
    • Responsible for effectively engaging with IT project management and reporting project status.
    • Establish and adhere to set project plans and release dates.
  • Mentor and provide guidance to junior network engineers, sharing expertise and knowledge.
  • Remain on the cutting edge by studying state-of-the-art network technologies, participating in educational opportunities; reading professional publications; maintaining personal networks; participating in professional organizations
  • Maintain and publish Football Stadium DAS and Wi-Fi Guidelines
    • Review and plan DAS and Wi-Fi updates for NFL Tentpole Events.
    • Lead audits of Cellular and DAS Performance around NFL stadiums to adhere to NFL guidelines.
    • Collaborate with Cellular Vendors on stadium enhancements, and testing.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, or related field preferred, with 10+ years of experience or equivalent military service.
  • Extensive hands-on experience exceeding 10 years in network implementation, troubleshooting, and lifecycle maintenance.
  • Demonstrated leadership with over 5 years in network architecture roles.
  • 5+ years’ experience in wireless design, implementation, and support for large networks, including spectrum analysis and stadium DAS design.
  • Proficient in network administration, particularly Cisco products, with expertise in controllers, access points, routers, and switches.
  • Advanced knowledge of networking protocols (TCP/IP, UDP, DHCP, DNS, STP, NAT, IPSEC, GRE, VPC/VSS, etc.)
  • Advanced understanding of networking concepts and principles, including but not limited to routing static/dynamic (RIP, EIGRP, OSPF, & BGP) and multi-layer switching (standard and private VLANs, VTP, Spanning Tree, etc.)

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Strong grasp of network best practices, security principles, design architecture, and analysis with use of tools such as Wireshark, etc.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to analyze and troubleshoot complex network issues.
  • Experience in troubleshooting networking device drivers and client system issues.
  • Experience in troubleshooting video and voice performance over wired and wireless networks.
  • Capability to research and evaluate new network technologies.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Skilled in creating and updating detailed infrastructure topologies using MS Visio, Excel, and Word.
  • CCNP, CCIE, JNCIP, or equivalent
  • Familiarity with Cisco Identity Services Engine and DNA.

Travel

30% - 50%, domestic and international.

job.title: Manager, Corporate Partnerships
job.description:
Reporting to the Head of Commercial Corporate Partnerships for NFL Canada, the Manager, Corporate Partnerships is accountable to support and enable each of our corporate sponsors’ activations in a given season.

Towards our goal of being our sponsors most strategic partner in Canada, this role requires superior relationship management capabilities for both external and internal stakeholders, combined with a solid strategic foundation and functional understanding, of all elements of the marketing mix. Candidate will demonstrate a strong working knowledge of the Canadian sponsorship industry and strategic planning process.

This is a full-time, 18-month fixed-term contract position (40 hours per week), with the possibility of renewal.

Responsibilities:

  • Accountable, in collaboration with our partners, for the successful development, approval, activation and where appropriate, analysis, of each of our NFL Canada partner activations on and off season.
  • Through a deep understanding of each of our partner contracts, will ensure that their programs can and will be approved internally, consistent with their contractual rights.
  • Work with partners to develop NFL centric content that meets partner and league objectives
  • Work with player relations to identify and recommend players for partner executions (content, virtual, in-person)
  • Work with partners on measures of success and track throughout the season
  • Develop digital media campaigns for league partners to maximize partner investments
  • Work with our corporate partners, at a strategic business level, to identify key challenges and opportunities that the NFL can support on, to meet their business needs. This will be done in collaboration with other functional teams (marketing, fan centric marketing, consumer products, etc.)
  • Accountable for identifying incremental revenue opportunities across each partner, and working to provide them with new ideas, that will deliver net new revenue to NFL Canada. content, assets, media.
  • Work with legal and other relevant NFL stakeholders to develop and manage contracts for new partners
  • Work with NFL Canada marketing team to identify opportunities to collaborate with partners on initiatives that support business objectives in the market
  • Identify and lead, required research projects, to help deliver short and long term goals.
  • Accountable for evaluating our annual performance with our partners, using an agreed upon methodology and metrics.
  • Responsible for managing digital inventory across all NFL Canada corporate partners, including trafficking ads with our digital agency
  • Responsible for providing monthly reporting and analysis of our NFL owned and operated media executions
  • Responsible for leading our NFL Canada events including NFL Road Trips, annual Corporate Partner Summit and Partner Gifting program
  • Responsible for supporting our event calendar initiatives tied to our tentpole events: Kickoff, Super Bowl, Pro Bowl and Draft

Required Education and Experience:

  • University or equivalent college diploma – marketing or business administration degree an asset
  • Experience with Account Management an asset
  • Experience working in sponsorship, either on client, agency or property side
  • Working with a sports property and or sports betting operator an asset
  • A minimum of 5-7 years of progressively expanding experience in sponsorship/partnership activation or client account management in the marketing function is preferred

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics:

  • Digital media planning or buying experience an asset
  • Experience developing and executing digital content an asset
  • Highly organized with the ability to manage the needs of multiple partners simultaneously
  • Strong inter-personal and effective communication skills
  • Creative problem solver with an optimistic approach to business challenges
  • Consistently pushes for better results for the team and partners
  • Effective knowledge and use of Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel and research tools
  • Self-starter with the ability to network within NFL International and Domestic offices to conduct day to day business

Travel:

  • Position requires some flexibility of travel during the NFL season (approximately 10% of the year). Valid Passport for international travel required.

Requirements:

  • NFL Canada offers a hybrid work schedule consisting of a four day in office presence (Toronto) with one day work from home
  • This is a full-time, 18-month fixed-term contract position (40 hours per week), with the possibility of renewal.

job.title: Manager, Digital Strategy and Business Development
job.description:
The Manager, Digital Strategy and Business Development plays a critical role in the development of NFL Digital Media platforms short- and long-term strategic approach. The role will require a deep understanding of user data, competitive analysis, and the NFL ecosystem to create actionable strategic direction for the broader organization. The role will also directly support partnership strategy across sourcing, deal negotiation, and operational execution.

Responsibilities

  • Define near- and long-term strategy for the NFL’s digital media business, creating vision and prioritization framework to drive growth across NFL+, NFL App, and NFL.com experiences
  • Independently identify, evaluate, and recommend new growth opportunities across product features, promotional strategies, distribution models, and strategic partnerships through financial modeling, market analysis, and unlocking insights from unstructured data sets
  • Lead cross-functional strategic initiatives from concept through execution, partnering with Product, Marketing, Growth, Content, Finance, Legal, Sponsorship, and Ad Sales to align stakeholders and deliver business outcomes
  • Develops strategic evaluations and decision frameworks that enable leadership to assess, prioritize, and make informed decisions on business initiatives.
  • Source, negotiate, and manage strategic partnerships that expand audience reach, drive incremental revenue, and advance NFL’s digital media strategy
  • Create executive-level communications and strategic planning materials to support decision-making by NFL senior leadership
  • Presents data-driven findings and strategic recommendations to executive leadership, influencing key business decisions and organizational priorities.
  • Serve as a strategic thought partner to NFL Media leadership, providing analytical rigor and executive support on high-priority initiatives and business-critical decisions.

Required Qualifications

  • A four-year undergraduate degree from an accredited college or university is required.
  • 5-7+ years of work experience in strategy, consulting, business development, or related fields -- experience in sports, media, or digital products preferred
  • Strong understanding of digital media ecosystems, including streaming platforms, distribution models, and direct-to-consumer (DTC) business models
  • Advanced analytical and quantitative skills, including financial modeling, scenario analysis, and business case development
  • Demonstrated experience developing strategic frameworks and translating data and market insights into actionable business recommendations
  • Exercises a high degree of discretion, judgment, and professionalism in handling highly confidential, sensitive, and business-critical information. Experience working cross-functionally and influencing stakeholders across product, marketing, finance, and other business units
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with ability to distill complex concepts into clear, easy-to-understand presentations

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Ability to manage multiple simultaneous projects with several deliverables under tight deadlines
  • High level of integrity, work ethic, and deep intellectual curiosity
