job.title: Senior Manager, Commercial Accounts (France)
job.description:
The Senior Manager, Commercial Accounts will be responsible for successfully managing all partners who have sponsorship rights in France to meet annual revenue targets.

The role will require someone who possesses strong leadership skills with experience of working cross functionally and championing partner programs internally. Results will be measured against team performance, sponsorship revenue, activation, and satisfaction, along with increased and improved fan engagement metrics.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

Exceptional Partnership Management:

  • Develop relationships with existing NFL partners and be adept at resolving partner issues, thinking creatively and efficiently to reach solutions.
  • Identify and contact key decision makers at C-suite level.
  • Lead on local renewals process for Partners and support the team on upsells to meet revenue targets, collaborating closely with the global team to capitalize on available activation funds.

Support Revenue Growth through New Business

  • Support Global New Business by providing market perspectives, identifying relevant local targets / contacts, and recommending / prioritizing white space opportunities.
  • Collaborate closely with NFL Marketing and Consumer Products teams to develop integrated partnership solutions that align sponsor objectives with NFL fan growth and engagement priorities.
  • Proactively identify opportunities and revenue streams including exploitation of traditional inventory and digital opportunities
  • Analyze opportunities for growth in new areas to drive profitability and conduct regular analysis to mitigate any potential risks.
  • Provide support using key sponsorship and valuation metrics during contractual discussions.
  • Build innovative and tailored propositions that attract and convince potential sponsors to partner with the NFL.
  • Manage local sales agencies ensuring they execute their scope of work and provide support as needed.
  • Adopt a proactive approach to secure incremental revenue, working closely with the international team as well as Marketing and Consumer Products department.

Flawless In-Market Activation Execution

  • Work with the Global Sponsorship Team, to ensure a consistent look and feel is achieved and a joined-up approach, where relevant is adopted.
  • Manage local activation agencies to ensure they execute their respective scopes and provide support as needed.
  • Lead and oversee the activation and asset development of key League priorities including International Games, and in-market tentpole activations (e.g., Kickoff Watch Parties, Super Bowl watch parties)
  • Support Club Business Development with team activity and new partnerships, advising on local guidance based on local partner rights.

Serve as an In-Market Leader

  • Oversee the partnership delivery program to ensure assets are available and inventory is being carefully managed.
  • Actively provide feedback for continuous improvement based on market knowledge and executional requirements.
  • Maintain strong marketplace knowledge about industry trends and company spend in sponsorship/ marketing.
  • Act as a local expert on French consumer behavior, sports marketing trends, sponsorship innovation, and emerging fan engagement opportunities.
  • Champion a marketing-first approach to partnership development by identifying opportunities where brand storytelling, content, and experiences can drive greater commercial impact.

Collaborate with and Manage Internal Stakeholders

  • Provide updates to Country Manager, France, and US Global Sponsorship Team on day-to-day partner management matters, including efficient pipeline and status reporting.
  • Successfully navigate through a complex matrix business with poise and maturity, whilst ensuring the best interests of the team and commercial partners are protected.
  • Responsible for the discretionary commercial budget and reporting into, Country Manager, France, NFL Finance team and US Global Sponsorship Team regularly.
  • Align with the reporting process internationally to ensure that all internal departments are engaged with NFL Partners and provide the necessary support to deliver against Partner objectives, with constant communication and collaboration.
  • Foster the best possible professional relationships with Partners, agencies, internal stakeholders, and colleagues.
  • Collaborate with other departments, including finance, legal, public relations, and marketing, to ensure the successful contracting and sign-off of any new program.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 7 years’ experience in commercial, sales, partnerships or with agency
  • 3 years management experience
  • Fluent in French and English

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Sports background
  • Experience working within sports marketing, brand partnerships, consumer marketing, advertising agencies, media companies, or entertainment organizations
  • League or Club experience
  • Client management experience
  • Sales/Revenue generation
  • Additional language proficiency preferred.

Other Key Attributes / Talent Characteristics:

  • Commercial marketer, with strong business acumen who understands how to connect fan passion, brand objectives, and revenue generation
  • Communicates clearly and inspires the team through action
  • Excellent organizational skills, multi-tasker, and confident presenter
  • Proven evidence of planning, forecasting, and decision making
  • Adept with research, evaluation and industry analysis tools and methodologies
  • Self-reliant and able to work well unsupervised and demonstrate initiative, yet equally a team player who can follow instruction and support others
  • Effective management and delegation
  • Ability to develop direct reports’ skillsets and create career development paths.
  • Understanding of a multi-faceted business operation
  • Has a flexible and 'hands-on' approach
  • Ethical and diligent with a strong personal commitment to deliver at pace.
  • Works well under pressure adapting to tight deadlines and differing demands.
  • Possess good judgement and behavioral maturity.
  • Ambitious and hungry for opportunity

Physical Demands:

  • Event execution

Travel:

  • Up to 25% (within country/market & international)

  • NFL employees are required to work 40 hours per week.
  • Some weekend/global travel work for hosting clients.

job.title: Senior Manager, Customer Engagement Analytics
job.description:
Fan Engagement Data Science turns fan behavior into the strategies that shape how millions of fans experience the NFL. In this role, you'll sit at the center of that work, partnering with our NYC team and stakeholders across Marketing, DTC, and Consumer Insights, while leading a distributed offshore delivery team to turn ambiguous ideas into sharp, high-impact analytics. You’ll work end-to-end, from framing the right question to presenting the answer to Director- and VP-level leaders, on a fast-moving team delivering against one of the NFL's biggest fan engagement programs.

Responsibilities

  • Translate ambiguous business questions from Marketing, DTC, and Consumer Insights stakeholders into scoped, high-impact analytical work.
  • Lead and coach a distributed offshore delivery team, keeping quality, pace, and prioritization on track across a compressed daily overlap window.
  • Own your work end-to-end — from framing a hypothesis to presenting recommendations directly to Director- and VP-level stakeholders.
  • Build strong partnerships across marketing, technology, BI, and data engineering as a trusted analytics voice in the room.
  • Design segmentation, predictive models, and experiments (A/B tests) that convert fan behavior into targeted, actionable marketing strategies.
  • Apply GenAI/LLM-assisted analytics tools, within governed workflows, to move faster from data to insight.
  • Define and manage KPIs for fan engagement, partnering with the BI Center of Excellence to expand access to insight across the org.
  • Champion data quality and integrity across every initiative you touch

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years in customer or fan data analytics, with a strong track record of translating data into marketing strategy.
  • Experience turning ambiguous business questions into scoped, delivery-ready analytical work.
  • Experience leading or closely partnering with distributed or offshore teams.
  • A confident, clear communicator — comfortable presenting directly to senior stakeholders.
  • Advanced SQL and Python; working knowledge of ML frameworks and GenAI/LLM-based analytics tools.

job.title: Senior Manager, Cybersecurity Operations
job.description:
The NFL Cybersecurity Operations team is responsible for safeguarding the organization's digital assets by ensuring the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of critical data, systems, and services. Through continuous monitoring, rapid incident response, and proactive threat management, the team defends the enterprise against an evolving cyber threat landscape.

We are seeking a Senior Manager, Cybersecurity Operations to lead the NFL's Cybersecurity Operations Center (CSOC). This leader will oversee the Cybersecurity Operations program and drive the continued evolution of our 24x7x365 security operations capability, transforming it from a primarily reactive, alert-driven function into a proactive, intelligence-led, and highly automated cyber defense program.

Reporting as a key leader within the cybersecurity organization, this individual will help define and execute the strategic vision for the "CSOC of the Future,” where they will shape the operating model, technology strategy, and roadmap by leveraging automation, orchestration, agentic AI, advanced analytics, and emerging security capabilities to strengthen cyber resilience, enhance threat detection and response, and improve operational effectiveness across the enterprise.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the day-to-day operations and strategic direction of the 24/7/365 Cybersecurity Operations Center (CSOC).
  • Lead incident response activities for high-priority cybersecurity events and oversee post-incident reviews and continuous improvement.
  • Expand proactive threat hunting using threat intelligence, behavioral analytics, and AI-assisted investigations.
  • Working closely with IT infrastructure, cloud, engineering, risk, and business leaders, this individual will help to define and deliver the future state of cybersecurity operations, ensuring the organization can rapidly detect, investigate, and respond to threats while maximizing productivity and reducing operational complexity.
  • Collaborate with third-party security providers and managed security service providers (MSSP)s to optimize service delivery and operational effectiveness.
  • Support major business events and critical operations by ensuring continuous monitoring and rapid incident response capabilities.

Lead the SOC of the Future

  • Develop and execute the strategic roadmap for a modern Cybersecurity Operations Center built on automation, orchestration, AI, and agentic AI.
  • Define the future operating model for security operations, balancing human expertise with autonomous security capabilities.
  • Champion continuous modernization initiatives that improve resilience, scalability, and analyst effectiveness.

AI, Automation & Orchestration Strategy

  • Develop and execute the roadmap for a modern, AI-enabled SOC focused on automation, orchestration, and continuous operational improvement.
  • Develop playbooks and orchestrated workflows using SOAR technologies to improve consistency, speed, and scalability.
  • Leverage agentic AI and machine learning to automate repetitive analyst tasks, improve triage accuracy, alert enrichment, response actions, accelerate investigations, and enable autonomous response where appropriate.
  • Identify opportunities to eliminate operational inefficiencies through intelligent automation and workflow optimization.
  • Sponsor development of automation playbooks and integrations across the cybersecurity technology stack.

Operational Excellence

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing cybersecurity operations team while fostering innovation and continuous learning.
  • Lead Security Operations, Detection Engineering, Incident Response, Threat Hunting, and Security Automation teams.
  • Establish KPIs that measure operational maturity, automation effectiveness, analyst productivity, detection quality, and response performance.
  • Drive continuous improvement in Mean Time to Detect (MTTD), Mean Time to Respond (MTTR), alert fidelity, and analyst capacity through technology optimization.

Security Technology Strategy

  • Drive integration and optimization of SIEM, SOAR, XDR, EDR, Threat Intelligence, Vulnerability Management, Identity Security, Cloud Security, Email Security, and Network Security
  • Build detection engineering capabilities that continuously improves visibility across the enterprise including cloud, endpoints, network, email, and SaaS environments.
  • Evaluate emerging cybersecurity technologies and recommend investments that improve operational capability and efficiency.

Strategic and Technical Leadership

  • Present cybersecurity operational maturity, modernization progress, and risk metrics to executive leadership through dashboards and operational reporting communicating cyber risk, operational performance, and program maturity.
  • Partner with cybersecurity architecture, security engineering and IT teams to operationalize new security technologies and maximize value through integration and automation.
    Work with Information Security Office leadership team and other stakeholders to develop multi-year investment strategies for cybersecurity operations technologies and workforce transformation.
  • Partner with business leaders to align cybersecurity operations with organizational objectives and enterprise resilience.

Talent Development

  • Build and mentor a high-performing cybersecurity operations organization capable of operating an AI-enabled SOC.
  • Develop new skills within the team around automation engineering, AI-assisted investigations, detection engineering, and advanced threat hunting.
  • Foster a culture of innovation, continuous learning, and operational excellence.

Required Qualifications:

  • 8-10+ years professional experience in cybersecurity, network engineering or large-scale enterprise IT operations
  • At least 3-5+ years in a dedicated management or leadership role.
  • Hands-on background in incident response, risk management, security architecture, and Security Operations Center (SOC) optimization
  • Direct supervisory responsibilities of contract employees and/or managed security services
  • Bachelor's degree (B.S. or B.A.) in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or similar required
  • Master’s degree (M.S. in Cybersecurity, Information Security, or an MBA with an IT/Security concentration) is strongly preferred

Technical Skills:

  • Technical expertise in cybersecurity tools, technologies, and security strategies.
  • Cybersecurity Operations Tooling: Advanced knowledge of AI, SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, and Next-Gen Firewalls.
  • Must possess advanced technical skills that can shift from daily hands-on to architecture design, technical and defensive engineering.
  • Cyber Threat Management & Hunting using advanced threat intelligence frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK and threat intelligence integrations.
  • Strong understanding of network and systems both hybrid-cloud security (AWS, Azure,) and on-premises infrastructure.
  • Forensic understanding to guide analysts and preserve strict chains of custody for legal teams.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Confident, self-motivated, with strong interpersonal skills and ability to interface with, and gain the respect of, stakeholders at all levels of NFL.
  • Continuously prove and demonstrate good judgment and commitment to high standards of ethics, regulatory compliance, customer service and business integrity.
  • Excellent verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with the IT organization, project and application development teams, management, and business personnel.
  • Strong decision-making capabilities. Calm under pressure during high-stress cyber events.
  • An understanding of business needs and commitment to delivering high-quality, prompt, and efficient service to the business.
  • An understanding of organizational mission, values and goals and consistent application of this knowledge.

Professional Certifications (Preferred; not required)
CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional)
CISM (Certified Information Security Manager)
GSOM (GIAC Security Operations Manager)

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

Travel domestically and internationally is required for this position. While frequency and duration of travel will vary throughout the year, applicants should anticipate approximately 15%-20% travel.

The NFL expects to hire for this position near the middle of the range. job.title: Senior Manager, Event Operations, UK (External Agency Position)
job.description:
The NFL Event Operations team is seeking an experienced and highly organized Senior Manager of Event Operations to lead the planning, overlay and delivery of NFL International Games across the UK and Europe.

Reporting to the Director of Event Operations, this role will provide senior operational leadership from initial planning and stadium overlay through to Gameday delivery and post-event assessment. The role will lead an event operations team and work closely with stadium and city partners, NFL clubs, vendors and a broad range of stakeholders to deliver world-class NFL games in Europe. The successful candidate will bring a strong understanding of complex live-event environments, exceptional project management skills and the ability to lead confidently in a high-pressure, fast-paced environment. The role will be primarily based at the NFL UK offices in London, with relocation to host stadiums during game weeks. Frequent international travel, as well as evening and weekend work will be required.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a dynamic and growing team, with responsibility for high-profile International Games in Europe and opportunities to contribute to the wider portfolio of NFL League events.

This job posting is for a position with one of the NFL’s third-party agency partners that provides services to the NFL. The individual selected for this role will be an employee of that third-party agency and not the NFL. All compensation, benefits, and other terms and conditions of employment are handled by the agency. The assignment to provide services to the NFL will be limited in duration but may be extended for an additional period by agreement between the NFL and the agency.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Serve as a senior operational lead on site, providing direction and making real-time decisions throughout planning, event build, Gameday and load out.
  • Lead the development and delivery of comprehensive operational overlay plans for NFL International Games at host stadiums.
  • Lead stadium transformation, construction and conversion planning, ensuring all requirements are delivered safely, efficiently and to the required NFL standard.
  • Develop and manage detailed operational plans, master schedules, construction timelines and event readiness documentation.
  • Lead coordination across all internal and external stakeholders, including stadium and city partners, Ticketing, Broadcast, Football Operations, Game Presentation, Security, Marketing, Partnerships and other relevant functions.
  • Lead the management and delivery of third-party vendors, including contract deliverables, operational requirements and on-site performance.
  • Manage the stadium operations budget, including forecasting, cost control, purchase orders and payments.
  • Provide clear operational leadership and decision-making throughout game week, proactively identifying and resolving issues and escalating critical matters where appropriate.
  • Support the planning and delivery of sponsor and partner activations within the wider event environment.
  • Ensure appropriate health, safety and operational compliance standards are maintained throughout planning, build and event delivery.
  • Work closely with relevant stakeholders to develop and implement contingency and risk-management plans.
  • Lead post-event debriefs, assessments and reporting, identifying lessons learned and opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Contribute to the development of operational best practices, processes and standards for future International Games and wider NFL events.

Experience & Qualifications

  • Extensive knowledge and proven experience planning and delivering complex, large-scale live events.
  • Educated to degree or equivalent professional experience.
  • 8+ years' experience working within a stadium, venue, live events or comparable operational environment.
  • Demonstrated experience within professional sports, entertainment, major events or complex project planning and delivery.
  • Strong project and program management skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams, stakeholders and competing priorities.
  • Proven experience leading and developing an operational delivery team.
  • Experience managing external vendors, contractors and commercial partners.
  • Strong understanding of stadium operations, event overlay, event infrastructure and live-event logistics.
  • Experience operating in an international or multi-market environment is desirable.
  • Knowledge or understanding of American Football and the NFL is desirable.

Leadership Attributes

The successful candidate will demonstrate:

  • Exceptional organization and time management, with the ability to prioritize effectively and consistently deliver against critical deadlines.
  • Strong judgment and problem-solving skills, with the ability to anticipate issues, develop solutions and make confident decisions in high-pressure environments.
  • The ability to manage upwards, provide clear recommendations and communicate effectively with senior leaders.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build alignment and drive collaboration across multiple teams and functions.
  • Strong presentation skills, with the confidence to communicate operational plans, risks and key decisions to large audiences and senior stakeholders.
  • Adaptability and resilience, with the ability to remain calm, focused and solutions-oriented in a constantly changing live-event environment.
  • Exceptional stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence, negotiate and build trusted relationships with internal colleagues, stadium and city partners, vendors and other external stakeholders.
  • A collaborative leadership style, with the ability to motivate teams, create accountability and bring people together around a common goal.
  • High levels of integrity, professionalism and personal accountability.
  • An enthusiastic, proactive and positive approach, with a genuine commitment to delivering the highest standards of operational excellence.

People Management

  • Proven experience managing and leading a team of at least three direct reports or equivalent operational resources.
  • Ability to provide clear direction, priorities and communication throughout complex event planning and delivery.
  • Demonstrated track record of coaching, developing and supporting team members to achieve their full potential.
  • Ability to build a high-performing team culture based on accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement.

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • Requires extensive travel to host stadiums and other event locations across the UK and Europe.
  • Requires flexibility to work evenings, weekends and holidays, particularly during event and game weeks.

This role will contribute to event planning, operational execution, and fan engagement initiatives, helping deliver high-quality experiences that align with broader business, commercial, marketing, and international market objectives.

Event Management

  • Proven experience supporting the planning and delivery of both large and small-scale events across the U.S. and internationally
  • Operational experience across sport and fan/public events
  • Working knowledge of key event components, including security operations, health and safety, local authority coordination, programming, community engagement, scheduling, branding/creative, and procurement
  • Ability to create reporting to relevant stakeholders, including post mortems

Fan Event Delivery

  • Assist in delivering gameday and non-gameday fan experiences, kickoff events, watch parties, local market activations internationally, NFL club activations, community initiatives, partner integration, and lead generation activities

job.title: Senior Manager, Global Sponsorship & New Business Development (UK - External Agency Position)
job.description:
The Senior Manager, Global Sponsorship & New Business Development is a key member of the NFL's Global Sponsorship Business Development team, responsible for driving revenue through the development and sale of integrated global marketing partnerships.

Working across the NFL's international business, this role will identify, develop, and secure strategic partnerships that support the league's key growth priorities, including NFL FLAG, international expansion, game innovation, and audience growth among youth, multicultural, and women’s audiences. The successful candidate will play a critical role in identifying new business opportunities, cultivating senior-level relationships, and delivering innovative partnership solutions that create value for both the NFL and its partners.

This position is with a third-party agency that provides services to the NFL. The selected candidate will be employed by the agency, not the NFL, and will be based at the NFL’s office in London, UK. The agency will be responsible for all compensation, benefits, and other terms and conditions of employment. The assignment supporting the NFL will be for a defined period and may be extended by mutual agreement between the NFL and the agency.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Build and manage a strong pipeline of prospective global and regional partners to achieve sponsorship revenue targets.
  • Identify and qualify new business opportunities through market research, category analysis, and strategic prospecting, with a particular focus on international markets where dedicated sales resources do not exist.
  • Develop and maintain relationships with senior marketing executives, Fortune 500 decision-makers, agency leaders, and other key influencers across the sports marketing landscape.
  • Lead the full sales process—from prospecting and outreach through pitch development, negotiation, and contract execution.
  • Collaborate across the NFL to develop creative, integrated partnership opportunities that align with prospective partners' business objectives while supporting the league's strategic priorities.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams, including Media, Technology, Football Operations, Social Responsibility, and other business units, to create customized sponsorship platforms that maximize commercial value.
  • Develop compelling sales presentations, proposals, and partnership strategies tailored to individual prospects.
  • Maintain accurate sales pipeline data, forecasts, and reporting while ensuring opportunities progress efficiently through the sales cycle.
  • Partner with the Director to support and manage the Sponsorship Business Development Coordinator and contribute to the team's overall success.
  • Contribute new ideas and commercial thinking that help unlock incremental sponsorship opportunities and drive long-term revenue growth.

Qualifications & Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Finance, Communications, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Minimum of seven years of relevant professional experience within a sports league, team, rights holder, agency, media company, or global brand, including experience in areas such as partnership activation, account management, sponsorship, or business development.
  • Demonstrated sponsorship sales and new business development experience, including prospecting, pitching, negotiation, and closing commercial partnerships.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with senior stakeholders.
  • Strong relationship-building and influencing skills, both internally and externally.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, and Word.
  • Highly organized, with excellent project management, prioritization, and time management skills.
  • Valid passport and willingness to travel internationally as required.

Key Attributes:

  • Commercially driven, proactive, and motivated by opportunities to connect leading global brands with one of the world's most recognized sports properties.
  • Deep understanding of sponsorship, sports marketing, and partnership landscape.
  • Experience in prospecting, market research, outreach, pitch development, and strategic proposal creation.
  • Confident storyteller with the ability to translate insights into compelling commercial narratives.
  • Collaborative team player who thrives in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment and builds credibility with stakeholders at all levels.
  • Well-connected within the marketing and sponsorship industry, with experience developing relationships with senior marketing and brand leaders.

job.title: Senior Manager, New Business Development & Emerging Markets, Australia
job.description:
The Senior Manager, New Business Development & Emerging Markets, is a key part of the global consumer products team, responsible for identifying Consumer Products opportunities, setting the strategy for NFL emerging markets and accelerating revenue growth across international CP. This role will work closely with the international strategy team, local GMs, and cross functions across the organization to identify new market opportunities and drive long term brand expansion and fandom in key emerging regions around the world. The ideal candidate brings deep international licensing experience, strong commercial acumen, and a passion for growing sport globally.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute NFL’s international licensing strategy across emerging markets, including, APAC and Middle East.
  • Build licensing agency strategy for key emerging markets. Identify best in class agency partners and manage these relationships.
  • Lead relationship with licensing agencies on record on expansion into key regions.
  • Identify, negotiate, and manage new licensing agreements with regional and local partners across apparel, accessories, and lifestyle products; partner with licensing agency where relevant.
  • Collaborate with international marketing teams to build programs and campaigns that drive revenue and support fan growth.
  • Analyze market trends, consumer behavior, and competitive landscape to inform licensing strategy and product portfolio.
  • Build locally relevant programs and story telling relevant to each market/region.
  • Partner with Events team on any local in-market fan events, developing event-based retail presence and execution.
  • Manage ongoing relationships with licensees, including business reviews, product approvals, assortment planning, etc.
  • Develop and manage key retailer relationships within each market/region.
  • Develop annual consumer products business plan for each region and update quarterly.
  • Partner with Sponsorship on identifying and executing joint commercial opportunities.
  • Own local city or stakeholder relationship from a licensing perspective.
  • Track KPIs, forecast revenue, and provide regular business reporting to senior leadership.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree required, MBA preferred
  • 8+ years experience in sports licensing, with a strong emphasis on international expansion
  • Proven track record of negotiating and managing complex partner agreements across multiple regions, specifically APAC and MENA
  • Experience with licensing agency selection and management
  • Deep understanding of APAC and MENA retail landscapes, sports product distribution models, and building market entry strategies, including branded retail
  • Experience working with global sports brands
  • Experience executing experiential event retail at large scale tentpole events
  • Strong knowledge of American Football, specifically youth programs
  • Strong financial acumen, including forecasting, budgeting, and royalty modelling
  • Exceptional negotiation, communication, and partner management skills
  • Ability to operate in a fast paced, matrixed, global organization

Other Key Attributes / Talent Characteristics:

  • Familiarity with APAC, MENA market dynamics
  • Strategic thinker with a hands-on mindset
  • Multilingual a plus

Travel:

50% - international travel

To learn more about our comprehensive benefits offerings, please visit: NFL BENEFITS

job.title: Vice President, Corporate Strategy
job.description:
The Vice President, Corporate Strategy will play a central role in developing and shaping the League’s long-term strategy and evaluating the opportunities, risks, and structural changes that may affect its future growth, competitive position, and long-term value creation.

Reporting to the Senior Vice President, Corporate Strategy and Strategic Investments, the Vice President will manage and drive the League’s long-range planning process and lead strategic work on the NFL’s most important long-term business questions. The role will develop perspectives on the future of sports, media, technology, consumer behavior, and adjacent industries; translate those insights into implications for the League; and help senior leadership make informed choices regarding enterprise priorities, growth opportunities, and resource allocation.

The Vice President will also serve as an internal strategy advisor to business units and operating groups, leading selected engagements focused on complex business challenges and high-priority growth opportunities. The role will work closely with senior leadership, business unit leaders, Financial Planning & Analysis, Corporate Finance, and the 32 Equity strategic investments team.

Responsibilities

  • Manage and drive the League’s long-range planning process, working with the Senior Vice President, senior leadership, and business unit leaders to develop and refine enterprise priorities and strategic objectives.
  • Lead forward-looking analysis on the opportunities, risks, and structural changes that may affect the League over the medium and long term.
  • Assess trends across sports, media, technology, AI, consumer behavior, and adjacent industries, and translate them into clear strategic implications for the NFL.
  • Identify and evaluate new growth platforms, business models, strategic partnerships, market opportunities, and other sources of long-term value creation.
  • Develop scenarios, strategic frameworks, and decision materials that help senior leadership evaluate choices under uncertainty.
  • Synthesize business unit strategies, financial plans, market developments, and enterprise priorities into a coherent long-range plan.
  • Translate strategic direction into clear priorities, recommendations, and actionable plans.
  • Prepare executive-ready presentations and recommendations for senior leadership and, as appropriate, ownership-facing audiences.
  • Partner with Financial Planning & Analysis and Corporate Finance to connect strategic priorities with financial planning, investment decisions, and resource allocation.
  • Establish approaches for assessing progress against enterprise priorities and major strategic initiatives.
  • Serve as a trusted strategic advisor to senior leadership and business unit leaders on high-priority business questions and enterprise challenges.
  • Lead selected internal strategy engagements and cross-functional initiatives, structuring ambiguous problems, directing analysis, and developing practical recommendations.
  • Evaluate new business opportunities, partnerships, growth platforms, and operating models, including the development of business cases and market assessments.
  • Provide an independent enterprise perspective and help ensure that major initiatives and investments align with broader League priorities.
  • Work closely with the 32 Equity team to identify and evaluate investment themes, market developments, and strategic opportunities relevant to the League.
  • Manage, mentor, and develop a team of corporate strategy professionals, setting clear standards for analytical rigor, business judgment, and executive communication.
  • Continuously improve the effectiveness, analytical rigor, and stakeholder engagement of the League’s long-range planning and corporate strategy processes.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree with MBA preferred and 12+ years of relevant experience in corporate strategy, strategic planning, management consulting, corporate development, finance, or a related field.
  • Significant experience developing enterprise strategy, leading long-range planning, or addressing major growth and transformation questions within a complex organization.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop a long-term strategic perspective and translate it into clear priorities, decisions, and actionable recommendations.
  • Strong understanding of how market, competitive, technological, financial, and consumer developments affect enterprise strategy and long-term value creation.
  • Exceptional strategic, analytical, and financial problem-solving skills, including the ability to identify the critical issues within complex and ambiguous situations.
  • Experience advising senior executives and developing materials for executive leadership, boards, ownership groups, or other governance bodies.
  • Proven ability to lead complex planning processes and cross-functional initiatives involving senior stakeholders and competing priorities.
  • Strong intellectual curiosity and the ability to translate external trends and emerging developments into differentiated strategic insights.
  • Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate complex ideas clearly and persuasively.
  • Strong relationship-building and influencing skills across functions, business units, and senior stakeholder groups.
  • Experience managing and developing high-performing professionals.
  • Unwavering commitment to ethical conduct, professionalism, and integrity.

Other Key Attributes and Characteristics

  • Forward-looking strategic thinker with strong business judgment
  • Financially and analytically rigorous
  • Intellectually curious and externally oriented
  • Executive presence and credibility
  • Exceptional communication and storytelling skills
  • High-impact, low-ego collaborator
  • Comfortable challenging assumptions and offering independent perspectives
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity and competing priorities
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail
  • Commitment to valuing and respecting diversity in the workplace

Travel

  • Travel required, including weekends and holidays, as needed.

Terms and Expected Hours of Work

  • NFL employees are required to work 40 hours per week.
  • FLSA exempt.

job.title: VP, Product & Design
job.description:
The VP (Vice President), Product & Design will lead product experience and roadmap development across the NFL’s portfolio of digital products and platforms, translating vision and strategy into scalable execution. As a key member of the Global Digital Fan Engagement leadership team, this executive will lead Product and Design functions responsible for creating world-class fan experiences across web, mobile, connected television (CTV), identity, subscription, and viewing platforms.

Working in close partnership with Strategy & Growth, Technology, Content, Marketing, Business Operations, and other key departments across the NFL, the VP, Product & Design will translate business priorities into product roadmaps and deliver experiences that deepen fan engagement, improve experience quality, and support the NFL's long-term strategic priorities.

This role requires an experienced and dynamic product executive capable of leading organizational evolution, establishing product management excellence, and building a high-performing team within a complex and highly visible media ecosystem.

Responsibilities:

Product Vision & Roadmap Leadership

  • Own the product roadmap for the NFL’s fan-facing product portfolio across web, app, CTV, identity, and subscription experiences
  • Partner with Strategy & Growth to translate enterprise priorities and agreed business objectives into product roadmap decisions, prioritization, sequencing, and execution plans
  • Lead short-term, seasonal, and multi-year product roadmap planning and sequencing, aligned to the broader long-range business plan and agreed investment priorities
  • Establish product management practices that improve prioritization, execution quality, and organizational alignment

Product Delivery & Performance

  • Hold end-to-end accountability for product roadmap execution, sequencing, delivery excellence, experience quality, product operating cadence, and post-launch value optimization across the digital portfolio
  • Translate agreed strategic priorities into delivered product outcomes that support business goals
  • Partner with Strategy & Growth to define KPI frameworks, measurement processes, and post-launch evaluation methodologies
  • Drive a culture of continuous improvement through experimentation, learning, and iteration

Fan Experience & Design Leadership

  • Lead the Product and Design organizations responsible for creating engaging and intuitive fan experiences
  • Establish experience standards and design principles across content discovery, viewing, personalization, subscription, and engagement journeys
  • Ensure consistency and quality across all fan-facing experiences

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner with Technology to align product roadmaps with technical feasibility, platform architecture, capacity management, and release planning
  • Partner with Strategy & Growth to translate agreed business objectives, priority fan segments, value propositions, and desired outcomes into product experiences
  • Partner with Content and Marketing to ensure product experiences, content value, and marketing execution reinforce the broader strategy
  • Build strong executive partnerships that improve decision making and organizational coordination
  • Communicate tradeoffs, risks, dependencies, and recommendations to senior leadership

Organizational Leadership

  • Lead and develop a high-performing Product and Design organization
  • Build team capabilities through coaching, succession planning, and talent development
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and product excellence

Required Qualifications:

  • 15+ years of product management experience, including leadership roles in digital media, streaming, sports, technology, or subscription-based businesses
  • Experience leading product organizations responsible for large-scale consumer digital platforms
  • Demonstrated success delivering complex product roadmaps that drive measurable business outcomes
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams within highly matrixed environments
  • Strong understanding of digital consumer experiences, content ecosystems, subscription products, and engagement platforms
  • Experience leading Product, UX/UI, Design, or adjacent digital experience functions

Leadership Profile:

  • Proven track record collaboratively shaping and delivering product roadmaps that drive business outcomes across large-scale consumer digital platforms
  • Demonstrated success delivering product roadmaps that support acquisition, engagement, retention, and monetization objectives within DTC or subscription-led businesses
  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to collaborate effectively with Strategy leaders on revenue, customer value, and growth opportunities
  • Strong experience operating in complex organizations and aligning cross-functional teams to deliver solutions that meet both business objectives and fan needs
  • Executive communicator capable of translating priorities, risks, tradeoffs, and performance into clear narratives tied to business goals
  • Strong product judgment, creative instincts, and operational discipline, with a passion for delivering exceptional consumer experiences

Travel:

This position will require travel to key NFL meetings and events, including occasional nights and weekends, especially during the NFL season.

Terms/Expected Hours of Work:

NFL employees are required to work a minimum of 40 hours per week in the office.

job.title: Deputy Managing Editor, Evenings
job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide.

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Intro to Position

Working primarily out of either our Washington D.C. headquarters or our office at NPR West in Culver City, CA, this role will serve as the network’s editorial lead during the evening hours, 3pm - 11pm eastern.

You’ll manage the newsroom during the evening, 3pm - 11pm eastern, with focus on breaking news, Morning Edition/UpFirst, Newscast and the early morning news report across all digital platforms. You will drive collaboration across newsgathering and show teams and help build a more integrated newsroom. You will lead editorial meetings as needed, edit copy and broadcast stories as necessary.

This is an NPR editorial role covered under the terms of the NPR Ethics Handbook. All editorial staff are bound by this guidance. Editorial staff is defined as staff members who play a role in shaping the journalistic or creative direction of NPR's content, including events.

Responsibilities

  • Partners with other news leaders across NPR’s desks, shows and digital operations.
  • Supervises assignments and provides editorial guidance to staff, stations, freelance reporters and production staff.
  • Manages evening news-gathering teams, overseeing overall performance and editorial direction.
  • Works with desks to identify original and distinctive coverage areas to produce a robust morning report across platforms.
  • Incorporates data into decision-making.
  • Identify targets for short- and long-term collaboration projects.
  • Ensures that work produced by NPR News complies with NPR and professional standards for balance, fairness and accuracy.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications

  • At least 8+ years experience managing in news or programming organizations (in a union environment is a plus).
  • Experience maintaining high journalistic standards under deadline pressure, including standards of objectivity, balance and fairness.
  • Demonstrated ability to generate and execute complex creative ideas and to assimilate and organize large amounts of information.
  • Proven ability to consistently work well with others.
  • Experience working in/closely with digital operations.
  • Ability and willingness to relocate.
  • Demonstrated experience in leading ambitious and distinctive coverage.

Required Critical Competencies for Success

  • Positive approach to embracing change.
  • Well-developed interpersonal skills, ability to get along with diverse personalities.
  • Results-oriented with the ability to balance other business considerations.
  • Adept at communicating effectively across all levels of leadership while inspiring confidence.
  • Ability to respect input but ultimately be confident enough to take decisive action and take responsibility for said action.

Education Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Work Location & Requirements

  • On-site: This is an on-site role based in Washington, D.C. or Culver City, CA

Job Type

  • This is a full-time, exempt position.

Compensation

Salary Range: The U.S.-based anticipated salary range for this opportunity is $160,000 -$175,000 plus benefits. The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum salaries NPR expects to provide for new hires for the position across all US locations.

NPR Benefits: NPR provides comprehensive benefits for employees and dependents. Regular, full-time employees scheduled to work 30 hours or more per week are eligible to enroll in NPR’s benefits options. Benefits include access to health and wellness, paid time off, and financial well-being. Plan options include medical, dental, vision, life/ accidental death and dismemberment, long-term disability, short-term disability, and voluntary retirement savings to all eligible NPR employees.

job.title: Director, Digital Insights
job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide.

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Intro to Position

The Director of Digital Insights serves as the strategic compass for our digital ecosystem, establishing the insight engine that drives long-term portfolio growth and audience engagement. Sitting at the intersection of complex behavioral data, primary research, and executive decision-making, this high-visibility leadership role is tasked with elevating how our organization measures value and understands our audience across every digital touchpoint.

While shaping the long-term vision for the domain, you will immediately steer two key transformational initiatives: the launch of a new flagship mobile application, and guiding a foundational re-thinking of our digital video strategy. Leading a multi-tiered insights team, you will ensure technical data integrity, redefine monetization metrics, and translate product performance into executive-level strategic directives that continuously evolve our platform ecosystem. Reports to Vice President of Audience Insights.

Responsibilities

  • Flagship App launch strategy: Partner with app leadership, Product and Engineering to architect the measurement framework, behavioral tracking, and lifecycle KPIs for the new centerpiece mobile application.
  • Team leadership & capability building: Build, mentor, and cultivate a high-performing insights team. Provide tailored coaching across varying levels of leadership and skill, fostering technical excellence (advanced SQL techniques, database design principles, and query optimization), strategic thinking, and influence.
  • Video playbook reinvention: Build a modern, cross-platform video insights strategy that tracks engagement, consumption, and loyalty across web, app, and third-party video ecosystems.
  • Primary research specification: Identify critical gaps where behavioral data fails to explain user intent. Design, scope, and write complex methodologies for qualitative and quantitative primary consumer research to validate the new business model.
  • Technical oversight & governance: Guard data integrity across the pipeline. Ensure the analytics team maintains rigorous tagging standards and comprehensive quality control (QC) procedures during rapid product iterations.
  • Narrative-driven Influence & storytelling: Transform complex, multi-dimensional data into compelling, visually intuitive stories. Champion the "so what?” and “now what?" behind the numbers, translating technical behavioral data into clear, persuasive narratives for executive leadership that turn metrics into actionable business strategies.
  • Cross-functional alignment & mediation: Serve as the primary strategic bridge and connective tissue between deeply technical analytics, developers, and content creator business units. Proactively navigate and resolve conflicting priorities, differing data interpretations, and cross-functional friction, aligning diverse stakeholders around a unified, data-backed product vision.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Required Skills/Competencies

  • Web & cross-platform measurement strategy: 8+ years of experience leading digital analytics strategy, with proven expertise in architecting web measurement frameworks, site optimization analytics, and tracking cross-platform user journeys across web, mobile, and video ecosystems.
  • Complex stakeholder management: Demonstrated ability to navigate matrixed organizations, build alignment across disparate departments (Product, Engineering, Editorial/Content, Development), and translate complex data insights into clear, actionable executive directives.
  • Mobile app &video domain expertise: Hands-on leadership in mobile app analytics—specifically defining measurement frameworks and lifecycle KPIs for new app launches—alongside modern digital video measurement across owned platforms and third-party video networks.
  • Mixed-methods insights leadership: Expertise in bridging quantitative behavioral data with quantitative and qualitative primary research methodologies to explain user intent, validate new digital business models, and identify portfolio growth opportunities.
  • Technical analytics governance: Deep familiarity with modern data pipelines, tag management systems, product analytics tools (e.g., GA4, Amplitude, Mixpanel, Segment), and establishing strict QC/data integrity protocols across fast-paced development cycles.
  • SQL expertise and literacy: Direct, strategic experience using SQL to manipulate complex datasets to produce analysis of user journeys and behavioral segments. Ability to evaluate analyst code for efficiency, accuracy, and full utilisation of available data.
  • Multi-tiered people management: Proven track record of building and leading insights teams, with specific experience coaching both individual contributor managers and developing first-time supervisory managers while mentoring junior analysts.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Media, public media or subscription/membership Experience: Background working within a public media ecosystem, premium streaming audio/video service, or a subscription-driven digital media publisher.
  • Data re-architecture: Direct experience guiding an organization through a migration from legacy web tracking architectures to unified, omni-channel customer data layers.
  • Advanced degree: Master’s degree or equivalent experience in Data Science, Behavioral Economics, Market Research, or Statistics.

Education Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Analytics, Market Research, Statistics, or a related field (Master's preferred or equivalent experience).

Work Location & Requirements

  • NPR Hybrid Permitted: This is a hybrid permitted role. Some aspects of this role require duties better performed at an NPR facility. The employee will be required to be in the office at the Washington, D.C. location at least 3 days a week. The employee must also reside in an NPR-supported location based on the number of on-site days they choose.

Job Type

  • This is a full-time, exempt position.

Compensation

Salary Range: The U.S.-based anticipated salary range for this opportunity is $166,000-$180,000 plus benefits. The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum salaries NPR expects to provide for new hires for the position across all US locations.

NPR Benefits: NPR provides comprehensive benefits for employees and dependents. Regular, full-time employees scheduled to work 30 hours or more per week are eligible to enroll in NPR’s benefits options. Benefits include access to health and wellness, paid time off, and financial well-being. Plan options include medical, dental, vision, life/ accidental death and dismemberment, long-term disability, short-term disability, and voluntary retirement savings to all eligible NPR employees.

job.title: IT Network Manager
job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide.

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Intro to Position

As our IT Network Manager, you will bridge the gap between traditional enterprise networking and the cutting edge of broadcast technology. We are looking for a Cisco-certified leader to oversee the lifecycle of our network infrastructure, specifically optimizing for real-time media transport. Beyond technical mastery, you will act as a collaborative partner to our IT and production teams, fostering a culture of high availability and proactive security. If you thrive in 'always-on' environments and have a passion for seamless media delivery, this is your next challenge

Responsibilities

  • Manage and support enterprise network infrastructure including Cisco ACI, Catalyst and Nexus switches, Firepower (FTD), SD-WAN, Routers and Meraki platforms.
  • Manage and lead a team of network and voice engineers, effective network and telecom project management, performance management, and professional development.
  • Provide expertise in Storage Area Networking (SAN), including Fibre Channel (FC) and FCoE, with hands-on experience in VSAN design, zoning, and integration with Cisco Nexus and MDS platforms.
  • Collaborate with broadcast engineering teams on implementing and maintaining a high-availability IP broadcast network that carries low-latency, real-time audio and video traffic for NPR’s daily content production and live transmission.
  • Oversee design, implementation, and optimization of LAN/WAN and wireless networks.
  • Configure and maintain routing protocols (BGP, EIGRP).
  • Lead network operations, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis for complex issues.
  • Utilize monitoring and analytics tools such as SolarWinds and Cisco Nexus Dashboard
  • Use advanced network visibility tools to analyze performance across internet paths.
  • Ensure network reliability, performance, scalability, and security across the organization.
  • Develop and maintain network architecture documentation, diagrams, and operational procedures.
  • Collaborate with Security, DevOps, Systems, and Enterprise application teams to support enterprise services.
  • Communicate effectively with senior leadership, providing clear documentation, analysis, and insights on network performance, risks, incidents and strategic initiatives.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in enterprise networking.
  • 3+ years in a network leadership or management role.
  • Strong hands-on experience with:
    • Cisco ACI
    • Cisco Nexus
    • Cisco Firepower (FTD)
    • Cisco SD-WAN
    • Cisco Meraki
    • Enterprise Wireless Networks
  • Strong expertise in routing and switching (BGP, EIGRP).
  • Experience with SolarWinds, Cisco Nexus Dashboard, Cisco Intersight.
  • Experience with ThousandEyes.
  • Working knowledge of PTP, SMPTE ST 2110, multicast, and QoS.
  • Strong troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical teams through critical production outages and high-pressure incident response, ensuring fast service recovery and minimizing business disruption.
  • Ability to translate complex broadcast requirements into scalable Network architectures, overseeing robust business continuity planning, and fostering a culture of technical excellence.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Cisco CCNP (Enterprise or Data Center).
  • Cisco CCIE certification.
  • Experience with high-quality, real-time audio and video over IP networks, such as SMPTE ST 2110 and NDI, particularly in a IP broadcast environment.
  • Experience with large-scale or multi-site enterprise environments.
  • Experience with network automation / Infrastructure as Code.
  • Experience with managing on-prem and hosted Telephony and AV systems.
  • Experience supporting audio/video transmission or production workflow.

Work Location & Requirements

  • Hybrid Permitted: This is a hybrid permitted role. The employee will be required to be in the office at the Washington, D.C. location at least 2 days a week. The employee must also reside in Washington, D.C. / Maryland / Virginia Metro Area.

Job Type

  • This is a full-time, exempt position.

Compensation

Salary Range: The U.S. based anticipated salary range for this opportunity is $158,500 - $180,000 plus benefits. The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum salaries NPR expects to provide for new hires for the position across all US locations.

Benefits include access to health and wellness, paid time off, and financial well-being. Plan options include medical, dental, vision, life/ accidental death and dismemberment, long-term disability, short-term disability, and voluntary retirement savings to all eligible NPR employees.

job.title: Lead Data Scientist, AI Labs
job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide.

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Intro to Position

As the Lead Data Scientist for the AI Labs team, you will serve as the technical and ethical anchor for NPR's artificial intelligence initiatives. You will lead data science expertise for a content metadata overhaul to power new audience-focused personalization engines. Rather than building models from scratch, you will focus on fine-tuning, evaluating, and scaling existing foundational models, as well as deploying machine learning algorithms for public media.. You will collaborate extensively across the organization to align architectures, ensure secure cloud deployments, and protect intellectual property. This position demands a high focus on accuracy, journalistic ethics, data privacy, and responsible scaling.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the selection, fine-tuning, and optimization of open-source and proprietary LLMs tailored to NPR’s unique content voice.
  • Design and architect automated machine learning pipelines to transform decades of unstructured audio, transcripts, and text to support automated semantic metadata generation.
  • Collaborate with the product, design and engineering teammates to translate user needs into production-ready data science workflows.
  • Architect recommendation frameworks that leverage enriched metadata to drive deep, style-based audience personalization while preserving editorial curation.
  • Partner with Data Products to construct clean, self-service data pipelines and audience analytics models inside BigQuery.
  • Support newsroom research through the prototyping, validation, and development of API-driven tooling and secure database search models.
  • Establish strict evaluation, testing, and benchmarking frameworks to guarantee model outputs meet NPR’s standards for factual accuracy and neutrality.
  • Proactively identify, audit, and mitigate algorithmic bias in metadata generation and audience discovery systems.
  • Ensure all AI applications scale securely and cost-effectively, balancing computational efficiency with rigorous data privacy guardrails.
  • Collaborate with growth and data platforms to leverage content metadata for user lifecycle retention and smart audience segmentation.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description is subject to change at any time.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of professional experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, or Natural Language Processing (NLP) shipping production-grade systems.
  • Proven track record of applying, fine-tuning, and evaluating Large Language Models (LLMs) and foundational architectures.
  • Experience with Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR), diarization, and audio preprocessing pipelines.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and maintaining large-scale data architectures, vector databases, and semantic search pipelines.
  • Hands-on experience designing, deploying, and optimizing production-grade recommendation engines or personalization systems at scale.
  • Practical, hands-on experience building machine learning workflows within major cloud environments (Azure, AWS or GCP).
  • Experience successfully navigating matrixed, cross-disciplinary collaboration between technical engineering teams and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to identify common AI pitfalls, such as hallucinations or formatting errors, and design robust algorithmic workarounds.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with large volumes of unstructured multimedia, digital audio processing, or automated speech-to-text workflows.
  • Prior experience working within a media organization, digital newsroom, or public service institution.
  • Experience integrating automated LLM evaluation gates and regression testing directly into CI/CD deployment pipelines

Required Skills/Competencies

  • Deep technical expertise in Python, ML and agentic engineering frameworks, vector search engines and two-stage retrieval architectures.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and cloud data warehouse ecosystems (such as BigQuery or Snowflake).
  • Deep understanding of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) patterns and semantic search tools.
  • Professional-level familiarity with model evaluation methodologies, prompt engineering techniques, and API integration workflows.
  • Strong commitment to algorithmic ethics, data privacy compliance, and methods for identifying or mitigating bias.

Education Requirements

  • Advanced degree (PhD preferred) in Computer Science, Data Science or Machine Learning
  • Advanced academic research in relevant fields

Work Location & Requirements

  • Hybrid Permitted:
    • This is a hybrid permitted role. Some aspects of this role require duties better performed at an NPR facility. The employee will be required to be in the office at the [Washington, D.C. or New York City] location at least two to three days per week.

Job Type

  • This is a full-time, exempt position.

Intro to Position

Do you want to play a major role in the future of public media? Do you have a passion for mobile technology, open-source software, and serving the public?

As our Mobile Software Engineering Manager on the Audience Technology team, you will lead a highly collaborative team of mobile software engineers building, testing, and delivering award-winning features for NPR's flagship mobile applications. You will partner closely with our Product, Design, Data, and Editorial teams to identify priorities, architect new features, and continuously improve existing applications. In this role, you will act as a primary champion of team health, career progression, and technical excellence.

Responsibilities

  • People Leadership & Coaching: Manage, mentor, and coach a team of Mobile Software Engineers, actively investing in their career growth, professional development, and psychological safety.
  • Talent Acquisition & Onboarding: Lead recruitment and hiring efforts for software engineering vacancies on your team, and manage the structured onboarding and training of new engineering staff.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with product managers, UX designers, data analysts, and editorial partners across all stages of the product development lifecycle.
  • Agile Delivery Management: Lead the technical planning, scoping, and execution of future software projects, facilitating Agile ceremonies (stand-ups, backlog refinements, sprint planning, and retrospectives) as needed.
  • Technical Quality & Code Review: Conduct thorough software design and code reviews, providing constructive and substantive feedback to maintain code health, architectural integrity, and security standards.
  • Continuous Process Improvement: Analyze, propose, and implement engineering workflow improvements to enhance the speed, safety, and quality of software delivery.
  • Developer Experience Automation: Identify common engineering blockers and pain points, writing helper tools or automation scripts to optimize team developer experience (DX).
  • Incident & Production Support: Oversee and coordinate the team's response to critical mobile production bugs or infrastructure incidents.
  • Vendor & Contributor Management: Coordinate workflows, code standards, and deliverables for external contributors and specialized development vendors.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience directly managing, mentoring, or leading mobile software engineers within an agile organization.
  • Prior experience as an individual contributor in engineering, testing, and shipping robust code for at least one large-scale mobile application.
  • Hands-on proficiency in modern mobile platform languages, specifically Swift/Objective-C (iOS) or Kotlin/Java (Android).
  • Strong working knowledge of native mobile release infrastructures (such as Apple App Store Connect/provisioning profiles or Google Play Console/staged rollouts).
  • Hands-on experience working with modern version control systems (primarily Git).
  • Demonstrated experience collaborating within cross-functional Agile/Scrum product teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Professional experience managing both internal employees and external agency vendors/contractors.
  • Experience with native mobile media streaming frameworks (such as AVKit/AVFoundation for iOS, or Media3/ExoPlayer for Android).
  • Familiarity with modern responsive design architectures (SwiftUI/Combine or Jetpack Compose/Coroutines), design patterns (MVVM), and automotive platforms (CarPlay/Android Auto).

Required Skills/Competencies

  • Technical Design & Communication: Ability to translate complex technical concepts, system architectures, and engineering trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Inclusive Leadership: Demonstrated competency in fostering an equitable, supportive, and inclusive team culture.
  • Systemic Problem Solving: Strong analytical skill set with an "automation-first" mindset for resolving manual bottlenecks and production issues.
  • User-Centric Empathy: A strong focus on quality and empathy for end-users, ensuring highly performant, accessible mobile application experiences.

job.title: Petra Mayer Memorial Fellowship
job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide.

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Intro To Position

NPR's Society & Culture Desk offers news, discovery and analysis of arts and culture to curious audiences on digital, radio, podcasts, social platforms and video. We also cover the many elements of culture—from television, film, music, books, the arts and the internet — to the moments when people come together for shared experiences large and small. We uplift voices and perspectives that enrich and deepen our understanding of today’s cultural conversations. We provide original reporting, insight, context and signature curation initiatives that set NPR apart as a relevant journalism and cultural institution.

The Petra Mayer Memorial Fellowship was established in memory of beloved NPR Books Editor Petra Mayer, by her parents, to support fellowships with NPR’s Culture News Team.

The Petra Mayer Memorial Fellow will play a vital role in every aspect of our work, while also learning the core tenets of public service journalism, media ethics and multi-platform reporting and producing. Working alongside top professionals in the field, fellows are given real-world, hands-on responsibilities.

The fellow will focus their term on Books We Love and the Book of the Day podcast, signature NPR products founded by Mayer. They will also assist reporters with research on critical stories, both long-term projects and breaking news. They will also learn the basics of production by researching and pulling tape, securing rights and excellent audio quality, and by learning to mix pieces featuring varied soundscapes. We will also look to our fellows for assistance in digital production, basic headline writing, creative selection of art and social media promotion.

Applications close on Monday, August 31st at 11:59 pm ET.

Responsibilities

  • Production, diversity tracking and research for Books We Love, NPR's annual interactive reading guide
  • Researching and pulling tape for reporters as well as laying up audio stories and pieces
  • Producing digital pages for our stories and reviews
  • Conducting research for critical projects

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Basic research
  • Basic reporting and writing
  • Voracious appetite for books and pop culture

Preferred Skills

  • Basic radio production (ability to edit would be a bonus)
  • Intermediate level of social media proficiency
  • Strong time management

Education Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent in work experience

Work Location & Requirements

  • Cover Letter - we encourage you to showcase your appetite for books and pop culture!

job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide.

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success.
