job.title: VP, Financial Controller - SESAC (Nashville)
job.description: SESAC is seeking a VP, Financial Controller to join our team in Nashville. In this position you will be responsible for overseeing all aspects of the company’s accounting and financial reporting. This includes managing a multi-entity general ledger, overseeing the monthly close and management reporting, quarterly and annual financial statements, monitoring cash flow, and overseeing revenues, royalties and payroll processes. The role also involves developing and maintaining internal controls, supporting budgeting and forecasting, and ensuring compliance with relevant accounting standards, tax regulations, and company policies. As the Controller you will collaborate closely with leadership and operations teams to analyze financial performance, provide decision-support reporting, and recommend process improvements that enhance transparency and efficiency. This position includes supervising and mentoring accounting staff, coordinating with external auditors, and helping drive disciplined financial management across the organization. You will also serve as a tactical and operational partner to department leadership. What You Will Be Doing: Overseeing the SESAC accounting team and ensuring accurate and timely dissemination of financial management reports including, but not limited to, internal and external monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements and annual audits/budgets. Establishing, maintaining and enhancing financial systems and controls that verify the integrity of all procedures, processes and data, including balance-sheet reconciliations, accrual completeness, variance analysis, etc. Overseeing revenue and royalty accounting, including revenue accruals, accounts receivable (aging, billings and cash application), bad debt, prepaid royalties, etc. Delivering management reports and analytics to Department Leadership and acting as a strategic partner by, responding to requests with accurate, timely work. Supporting the drafting and review of the annual financial statements, including oversight of group reporting packages from subsidiary finance teams for consolidation, intercompany settlements, etc. under US GAAP. Providing inspirational people leadership. Setting clear goals, delivering honest and constructive feedback, and taking an active role in developing talent at every level. Leading with empathy and high standards — holding the team accountable while championing their growth, well-being, and long-term success. Actively modeling and reinforcing a respectful, collaborative, and congenial workplace culture. Assuming positive intent, and holding yourself and the team to a standard of professional courtesy and mutual respect across all interactions. Evaluating the accounting team structure and existing processes for continual improvement in efficiency and effectiveness. Partnering with FP&A and business leadership on the annual budget and periodic forecast cycles, providing accounting input on assumptions, accruals, and variance drivers. Reviewing technical accounting memos, concluding on accounting positions, proposing the resulting journal entries, and presenting and defending conclusions with the external auditors. Assessing and leading adoption of new accounting standards as needed. Integrating and standardizing finance functions of entities acquired in a business combination. Owning and managing the relationship with the external auditors. What Makes You Qualified: Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, business administration or equivalent experience. CPA required; MBA preferred. 5+ years' public accounting experience. 3+ years’ experience leading a team as a Financial Controller or Assistant Controller (or equivalent), including multi-entity and/or international consolidation experience. Strong experience of financial accounting, reporting, and general ledger management, consolidation of foreign entities, the differences between US GAAP and International GAAP (IFRS / local GAAP), and accounting for holding companies and multi-entity structures. Deep knowledge of financial statements under the US GAAP, including experience with revenue under ASC 606, complex debt accounting, business combination, leases, divestitures, etc. Experience with financial statements drafting preferred. Brings a global mindset and the interpersonal range to lead effectively across diverse teams, locations, cultures, and stakeholders. Ability to design, implement, and maintain effective internal controls, policies, and procedures for safeguarding company assets. Working knowledge of tax withholding compliance, regulatory reporting, and coordination with external auditors and financial institutions. Strong soft skills to lead and develop the finance team and collaborate cross functionally, with strong interpersonal skills and an ability to build relationships with colleagues at all levels. Self-starter with excellent verbal and written communication skills, and a problem solver who anticipates next steps and questions. Strong quantitative skillset and expert Excel user; hands-on with close and reporting systems (Oracle, ADP, Tipalti, Bill.com). Ability to establish priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment. Strong ethical conduct and an ability to maintain confidentiality. Demonstrated ability to quickly learn, adapt to, and embrace new technologies, with a track record of applying emerging tools and platforms to improve efficiency and drive results. Analytical thinker who thrives in a team environment, balancing independent problem-solving with a collaborative approach to reach effective outcomes. This is a hybrid role that will require you to commute to our Nashville office a minimum of three days a week.

job.title: Campaign Strategist
job.description: The Campaign Strategist supports the successful execution of linear and digital advertising campaigns across Sinclair's portfolio. This role serves as a key operational partner to Sales, Planning, Account Management, Traffic, Finance, and Marketing teams, ensuring campaigns are launched accurately, delivered successfully, and managed efficiently from order entry through completion. The ideal candidate is organized, detail-oriented, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced media environment. Key Responsibilities: Campaign Execution & Management Support post-sale campaign execution across linear, digital, social, podcast, and owned-and-operated platforms. Coordinate campaign setup, trafficking, flighting, inventory allocation, and fulfillment activities. Monitor campaign delivery, pacing, and performance, proactively identifying and resolving issues. Maintain accurate campaign, advertiser, inventory, and order information across company systems. Support make-goods, liability management, inventory adjustments, and campaign documentation. Sales Support & Account Coordination Serve as a primary operational resource for Account Executives, Planners, Account Managers, and internal stakeholders. Provide timely campaign updates, status reporting, and issue resolution. Respond to campaign-related inquiries and support client service efforts through proactive communication and follow-through. Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Planning, Traffic, Finance, Marketing, and Operations teams to ensure campaign success. Support discrepancy resolution, billing validation, and monthly reporting processes. Assist with inventory management, revenue tracking, and quarterly readiness activities. Help ensure campaign commitments, reporting, and documentation are accurate and complete. Prepare and deliver post-campaign MSA reporting packages, ensuring accuracy and timely distribution to internal teams and clients. Qualifications Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience preferred. 2–4 years of experience in advertising operations, campaign management, media planning, sales support, traffic, account management, or a related field. Understanding of linear and digital advertising workflows and campaign execution. Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail. Proficiency in Excel and experience working with reporting, inventory management, and campaign tracking. Experience with advertising and workflow platforms such as GAM, Broadway, JIRA, Teams, Megaphone, Sprout, Smartsheet, or similar tools preferred. Excellent communication skills and ability to manage multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environment. The base hourly compensation range for this role is $22.60 to $26.57 per hour. job.title: Chief Engineer
job.description: Sinclair's content technology is central to operational excellence and to connecting audiences with trusted news across broadcast, cable, streaming, and digital platforms. TNND is seeking an experienced, technology-focused Chief Engineer to lead engineering for its national news production operation. This role owns the reliability, performance, scalability, and lifecycle of TNND's live-production and media systems. The Chief Engineer leads the engineering team and turns operational needs into dependable workflows in partnership with editorial, production, operations, and Corporate technology teams. Networking, enterprise monitoring, cybersecurity, and shared-infrastructure decisions are Corporate-led; the Chief Engineer supplies broadcast requirements, supports implementation, and keeps TNND systems aligned with those standards. The successful candidate combines hands-on engineering depth with calm incident leadership, disciplined planning, and a service-oriented approach to daily live news. Key Responsibilities Engineering Leadership and Operational Ownership • Own the end-to-end technical health and operational readiness of TNND's production environment, with direct accountability for reliable daily live output across an extended and variable schedule. • Lead, develop, schedule, and set priorities for engineering staff and technical support coverage; establish clear escalation paths and ensure appropriate on-call response for critical operations. • Serve as TNND's senior engineering subject-matter expert and incident leader, coordinating rapid restoration, clear stakeholder communication, and follow-through during high-pressure production events. • Partner with editorial, production, operations, Corporate IT, digital, cybersecurity, facilities, and distribution teams to align technical systems with newsroom priorities; serve as TNND's broadcast liaison for Corporate-led networking, monitoring, security, and shared infrastructure. • Translate business and production requirements into documented architectures, standards, operating procedures, project plans, lifecycle roadmaps, and budget recommendations. Live Production and Control-Room Systems • Engineer, maintain, and support the integrated control-room ecosystem, including cameras and robotics, production switchers, automated production control, real-time graphics, studio displays, audio consoles and processing, intercom/IFB, teleprompters, tally, routing, multiviewers, sync/reference, video servers, record/playback, encoders/decoders, and contribution/distribution interfaces. • Administer and optimize Ross OverDrive automated production control for live news, including show and template configuration, rundown execution, device control, graphics/audio/robotics coordination, NRCS/MOS integration, operator workflows, recalls/macros, and tested manual fallback procedures. • Support Ross XPression Tessera/Tessera One and related XPression workflows for pixel-accurate, synchronized content across studio displays and video walls, including region mapping, real-time graphics and data, external video inputs, signal timing, playout control, and recovery procedures. • Validate software, firmware, control, graphics, and workflow changes in a test or rehearsal process before air; maintain approved configuration baselines and rollback plans. • Work directly with directors, producers, operators, editors, and graphics teams to improve repeatability while preserving the flexibility required for breaking news and late rundown changes. Newsroom, Media, and Distribution Workflows • Maintain dependable integrations among the newsroom computer system (NRCS), MOS-connected tools, ingest, editing, media asset management, shared storage, archive, graphics, playout, and distribution systems. • Support live feeds, file-based media, remote contributors, streaming, and broadcast contribution/distribution workflows, including metadata, timing, caption/data paths, and SCTE signaling where applicable. • Partner with content and operations teams to strengthen editing, live-production, field-gathering, remote-production, and multi-platform publishing workflows without compromising on-air reliability. Broadcast Systems and Corporate Technology Integration • Serve as the broadcast liaison to Corporate-managed technology services: define operational requirements and support implementation and troubleshooting of LAN/WAN connectivity, VLANs, QoS, multicast, routing, DNS/DHCP, secure remote access, identity, and time synchronization under Corporate architecture and policy. • Support TNND's current baseband SDI and compressed-IP media workflows, maintaining practical knowledge of applicable contribution, distribution, audio-over-IP, and production protocols such as NDI, SRT/RIST, and AES67/Dante where deployed. • Administer broadcast-specific Windows, macOS, and Linux systems and applications, coordinating shared-infrastructure changes involving virtualization, storage, databases, cloud services where applicable, patching, backups, access control, endpoint protection, and security hardening with Corporate IT and cybersecurity. • Create and maintain accurate signal-flow drawings, network diagrams, rack elevations, system inventories, configuration records, credentials-handling procedures, and support documentation. Monitoring, Reliability, Redundancy, and Disaster Recovery • Maintain broadcast-facing monitoring and use Corporate-approved enterprise monitoring, telemetry, logging, alarming, and reporting tools so engineering and operations have appropriate visibility into system health, quality, and service status. • Design and maintain redundancy for critical workflows; define recovery priorities with stakeholders; document and regularly test failover, backup, restore, and disaster-recovery procedures. • Lead incident, problem, and change management for production technology, including root-cause analysis, corrective actions, maintenance windows, risk communication, and post-incident learning. • Manage preventive maintenance, lifecycle replacement, spares, warranties, software support, service contracts, and vendor escalation to reduce avoidable outages and technical debt. Projects, Vendors, Budget, and Team Development • Assess business needs, evaluate solutions and vendors, develop technical requirements, and lead design, procurement, installation, commissioning, documentation, acceptance testing, and operational handoff for capital and workflow projects. • Develop and manage engineering budgets, forecasts, purchase planning, and expense tracking; present clear options, risks, and lifecycle implications to leadership. • Build strong vendor and corporate-technology relationships, manage escalations, and ensure that work performed by integrators and contractors meets TNND's technical and operational standards. • Coach engineers and technical users, create cross-training and coverage plans, and promote consistent troubleshooting, documentation, safety, and change-control practices. Required Qualifications • Five or more years of progressive experience in television news engineering, broadcast production technology, or an equivalent live-media environment, including demonstrated technical leadership. • Hands-on experience administering or supporting Ross OverDrive automated production control in a live-news environment, including rundown/NRCS integration, device control, show configuration, and troubleshooting under air-critical conditions. • Working expertise with Ross XPression Tessera or Tessera One and XPression-based graphics/display workflows, including multi-display playout, synchronization, signal flow, and operational recovery. • Broad control-room engineering experience with cameras, audio and video systems, production switchers, graphics, routing, multiviewers, intercom, playback/record systems, encoders/decoders, monitoring, and computing infrastructure. • Strong knowledge of broadcast signal flow, baseband and compressed-IP media, shared storage, media workflows, and structured troubleshooting, plus sufficient networking and monitoring knowledge to support TNND workflows and collaborate with Corporate technology teams. • Proficiency supporting Windows, macOS, and Linux platforms and diagnosing hardware, software, network, and workflow failures. • Demonstrated ability to analyze complex operational problems, make sound decisions under pressure, communicate clearly with technical and nontechnical stakeholders, and carry corrective work through completion. • Associate degree or higher in information technology, electronics, computer science, broadcast engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and directly relevant experience. • A collaborative, service-oriented leadership style and a consistent commitment to quality, reliability, documentation, and continuous improvement. Preferred Qualifications • Experience with additional Ross platforms such as XPression, DashBoard/CustomPanels, Carbonite or Acuity production switchers, Ultrix/Ultriscape routing and multiviewing, openGear, or Ross Platform Manager. • Experience with MOS/NRCS integrations, Avid editing and media workflows, media asset management, shared storage, newsroom playout, and multi-platform distribution. • Experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS) and other cloud-native services supporting all-cloud broadcast or media workflows. • Experience partnering with Corporate IT and cybersecurity on access, patching, centralized monitoring, endpoint protection, and secure vendor access for broadcast systems. • Familiarity with applicable FCC requirements, video streaming protocols, SCTE signaling, caption/data workflows, and emerging broadcast standards. • Relevant Avid (including ACSR), SBE, or comparable broadcast-technology certification. Work Expectations • Ability to work a flexible schedule and participate in on-call support, including early mornings, evenings, weekends, holidays, and breaking-news coverage as operational needs require. • Ability to work in control rooms, studios, equipment rooms, offices, and other technical spaces and to safely lift and move computers and equipment generally weighing less than 50 pounds, with reasonable accommodation as applicable. The base salary compensation range for this role is $130,000 to $150,000. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors such as a candidates’ relevant work experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location. Full time positions are eligible for benefits that include participation in a retirement plan, life and disability insurance, health, dental and vision plans, flexible spending accounts, sick leave, vacation time, personal time, parental leave and employee stock purchase plan. job.title: Content Creator
job.description: We’re a fast-moving, idea-sparking, deadline-crushing content team embedded inside one of the most dynamic entertainment companies in the country. On the Agile Content Creation Engagement Team (ACCET), we develop branded content, commercial creative, and social-first video that connects — emotionally and instantly. We are looking for a Content Creator to join our group! Our mission? Bring bold ideas to life across every screen. Whether we’re building campaigns for clients, developing killer creative for digital platforms, or producing memorable branded moments, our content doesn’t just fill space — it makes noise. WHAT YOU’LL DO: As a Content Creator, you’ll concept, write, shoot, and edit creative that stops thumbs, turns heads, and drives action. You’ll collaborate with a passionate crew of makers who understand that great storytelling is part emotion, part strategy, and all hustle. YOUR DAILY PLAYLIST: • Produce scroll-stopping, channel-agnostic content for TV, social, web, and wherever audiences are paying attention. • Partner with digital strategists and creative leads to develop work that aligns with brand goals and audience needs. • Write scripts, shoot footage, and edit everything from fast-turn social reels to longer-form branded videos. • Work directly with internal teams and external clients to bring visions to life. • Manage asset distribution across the network and track deliverables through Adobe Workfront. WHAT YOU BRING TO THE STAGE: • A passion for visual storytelling with a marketing mindset. • Mastery of Adobe Creative Cloud — especially Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop, and Illustrator. • Camera skills and lighting savvy that make your footage shine. • A collaborative spirit with the confidence to lead a concept or run a solo shoot. • A portfolio that proves you can do the job — and push it further. job.title: Content Producer/Editor, Criminally Obsessed
job.description: About Criminally Obsessed: With 1,400 reporters spread across the country, Criminally Obsessed is first on the scene, uniting armchair detectives in their quest to crack the case. From short videos to long-form documentaries, our team of content producers and editors reaches millions daily across all our social media and digital platforms. Job Summary: You’ll pitch, research, script, edit, and produce compelling true crime content while working with reporters, researchers, newsrooms, and original sources to uncover the details that make a case truly captivating. As someone who’s obsessed with true crime, you’ll help create original, multi-platform true crime programming — from quick-turn and short-form videos to creator-led features, visual storytelling, and recurring franchises — with a focus on strong hooks, distinctive storytelling, and content audiences want to watch and share. This role requires a strong journalism background, expertise in video production, graphic design, and an innate ability to connect with true crime audiences across platforms. Travel may be required for content gathering, breaking news coverage, and professional development. CORE RESPONSIBILITIES Original Content & Brand Franchises Attend Content Strategy Sessions to pitch and develop original, social-first true crime content, including short- and mid-form narrative stories and ideas that strengthen Criminally Obsessed content buckets and recurring franchises. Review assigned Sinclair markets, outside news sources, broadcasts, digital stories, raw footage, court coverage, social media and other relevant material to identify compelling stories and content opportunities. Monitor breaking crime events, press conferences, hearings, trials, livestreams and other major developments to identify timely coverage opportunities. Stay current on true crime trends, conversations and releases by regularly consuming relevant documentaries, series, podcasts, books, news coverage and social content, and bring those insights into pitches and content development. Lead reviews and coverage of true crime streaming content, including documentaries, series and other relevant releases, bringing a strong editorial perspective to Criminally Obsessed audiences. Serve as on-camera talent for breaking true crime news and major developments as needed, delivering timely, credible and engaging coverage across Criminally Obsessed platforms. Support Criminally Obsessed programming as backup on-camera talent for Anne and other hosts or franchises as assigned. Research, Reporting & Asset Gathering Research and report stories using public records and reporting tools, including court documents, PACER, FOIA requests, archival materials, reputable outside media sources and direct outreach. Actively pursue story leads, verify facts and gather the video, documents, images, interviews, social media posts and other assets needed to complete assigned content. Manage permissions and clearances for third-party video, images, social media content and other assets while coordinating with Sinclair news teams and outside organizations. Proactively communicate reporting needs, asset limitations, clearance issues, production delays, deadline risks and other potential blockers. Content Production & Platform Execution Pitch, script, shoot, present and edit original video content, and create supporting visual assets for YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and other Criminally Obsessed platforms. Produce mid-form narrative and creator-led content while contributing quick-turn, short-form and daily news coverage based on editorial priorities. Create platform-specific videos, social graphics, thumbnails and promotional assets that follow Criminally Obsessed brand guidelines. Take ownership of assigned content from approval through completion, meeting editorial and production deadlines and ensuring all required publishing elements are prepared for delivery. Content Performance Review social and digital performance metrics and use audience insights to improve story selection, topics, hooks, formats, pacing, presentation and overall content performance. Apply performance insights to refine recurring content buckets and franchises, strengthen successful formats and identify new content opportunities for Criminally Obsessed audiences. KEY DELIVERABLES Review assigned Sinclair markets and relevant outside sources each morning. Submit 3-5 developed story pitches by 9:30 a.m. EST each day, identifying the proposed content bucket, audience hook/CO angle, available assets, key details, latest developments and recommended treatment. Produce 3–5 quick-turn or short-form in-feed videos and 2 mid-form narrative videos each week, with an emphasis on creator-led and on-camera storytelling. Complete a minimum of 5 videos per week. Maintain an active pipeline of original mid-form, on-camera and franchise ideas rather than relying solely on assigned content. Meet all assigned deadlines and communicate proactively when reporting, assets, clearances or other issues could put a deadline at risk. Once immediate assignments are delivered, proactively identify additional stories, pursue leads, gather assets, review upcoming coverage dates and deadlines, and prepare future productions. ADDITIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES Perform other job-related duties as assigned by the manager. Assigned schedule is generally 8:30 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. EST, including a one-hour meal break and two 15-minute breaks. Hours may flex based on business needs, including occasional after-hours or weekend coverage when warranted. Overtime must be approved in advance by a manager. Occasional travel, approximately 10–20%, may be required for conferences, training, content gathering, breaking news or on-site coverage. job.title: Director, YouTube Strategy and Operations
job.description: Sinclair is seeking an experienced YouTube Platform Lead to help own the strategy, performance, and operational excellence of our YouTube presence across podcasts, news stations, and social-first brands. This is a specialized platform leadership role, not a general social production position. The ideal candidate brings deep, hands-on expertise in how YouTube works as a distribution, discovery, and monetization engine. They understand content ID, copyright management, audience development, packaging, analytics, and revenue optimization at a level that allows them to shape strategy and improve performance across a broad portfolio of channels and brands. This person will help define how Sinclair uses YouTube to grow audiences, extend brand reach and generate revenue across news, sports and entertainment content. Key Responsibilities Serve as Sinclair’s internal subject matter expert on YouTube and help oversee YouTube strategy across podcasts, news stations, and social verticals, including channel architecture, programming, and publishing strategy. Build platform-specific growth strategies for each brand and content type, balancing reach, retention, frequency, and monetization. Partner closely with sales, editorial, production, social, legal, and product leadership to ensure YouTube is integrated into Sinclair’s broader digital strategy. Analyze KPIs such as views, watch time, CTR, retention, subscriber growth, RPM, revenue, and other key metrics to guide overall YouTube strategy. Translate platform changes, policy updates, and algorithmic shifts into actionable guidance for teams across the organization. Develop monetization strategies that maximize revenue while protecting brand safety, content rights, and long-term channel health. Create repeatable operating processes and training that help producers, editors, and channel managers build content that performs well on YouTube. Represent Sinclair in conversations with vendors, partners, creators, and internal stakeholders as the lead subject matter expert on YouTube. Qualifications 5+ years of experience working directly with YouTube in a strategy, operations, programming, growth, or monetization role. Deep understanding of YouTube ecosystem, including content ID, rights management, monetization rules, policy enforcement, and audience growth. Demonstrated success improving channel performance through better packaging, publishing strategy, analytics, and content optimization. Strong fluency with YouTube Analytics and related performance dashboards, with the ability to turn platform data into clear strategy and operating guidance. Experience working across editorial, legal, business, sales, and technical teams in a matrixed environment. Strong judgment, attention to detail, and comfort making decisions in a fast-moving, high-volume content operation. Ability to operate both strategically and tactically, with the discipline to build process and the flexibility to respond to platform changes quickly. Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills. Experience managing a portfolio of YouTube channels at scale. Experience in news, podcasts, entertainment or sports environments a plus. Success in this role means Sinclair’s YouTube ecosystem becomes more intentional, more scalable, and more profitable. The YouTube Platform Lead will help us grow the right audiences, improve content performance and build a smarter operating model for one of our important distribution channels. job.description: Human Resources Intern – Fall 2026 Step into the future of work this fall. We’re looking for a driven, curious, and detail-oriented Human Resources Intern to join our team and gain hands-on experience supporting the systems, programs, and processes that help our employees thrive. This isn’t a “shadow and observe” internship. You’ll contribute to meaningful projects across employee benefits, HR technology, data, and HR operations, while partnering with teams across Human Resources and the business. If you’re interested in how technology, data, and employee programs come together to create a great workplace, this is an opportunity to build practical HR experience and develop skills that matter in 2026 and beyond. You’ll gain hands-on experience across Benefits, HRIS, and HR Operations, including: Benefits Administration: Support day-to-day benefits activities, employee communications, enrollment-related processes, and benefits documentation HRIS & Employee Data: Gain experience working within HR systems, assisting with employee data maintenance, audits, reporting, and data accuracy Cross-Functional HR Support: Collaborate with teams across Benefits, HRIS, HR Operations, and other HR functions to support shared processes and initiatives Reporting & Analysis: Help organize, review, and analyze HR and benefits data to identify trends, discrepancies, and opportunities for improvement Process Improvement: Assist with documenting workflows and identifying ways to make HR processes more efficient, accurate, and employee-friendly Employee Experience: Help ensure employees have access to clear, accurate information and a positive experience when interacting with HR programs and systems Projects That Matter: Partner with HR professionals on real projects that support our employees, strengthen HR operations, and improve how we work What You’ll Gain This is more than an internship—it’s an opportunity to see how modern HR operates behind the scenes. Practical, resume-building experience in Benefits, HRIS, and HR Operations Exposure to HR technology, employee data, reporting, and benefits administration Experience collaborating across multiple HR functions and business teams An understanding of how HR systems and processes connect throughout the employee lifecycle Mentorship from experienced HR professionals invested in your growth Opportunities to expand your professional network A stronger foundation for careers in Human Resources, Benefits, HRIS, People Operations, or HR Analytics Who You Are Currently pursuing (or recently completed) an undergraduate or graduate degree At least a sophomore at an accredited college or university Interested in Human Resources, employee benefits, HR technology, data, or business operations Detail-oriented and comfortable working with data, systems, and processes Organized, proactive, and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment Curious, collaborative, and eager to understand how different HR functions work together Comfortable working with confidential information and exercising appropriate discretion Eligible to work in the U.S. Available approximately 15 hours per week for 10 weeks during Fall 2026, with flexibility in scheduling. job.title: Media Manager (Input)
job.description: Are you a strategic operations leader who thrives in fast-paced, high-volume environments? Do you enjoy turning complex workflows into clear, efficient systems—and helping teams perform at their best through change? The Agile Creative Content Engagement Team (ACCET) is seeking an experienced Media Manager (Input) to lead and continuously improve centralized input operations across multiple markets. This is a highly visible leadership role responsible not only for daily execution, but for setting the operational direction that improves efficiency, consistency, capacity, and service across the organization. As Media Manager (Input), you will lead Senior Log Coordinators and Log Coordinators responsible for contracts, traffic, copy, reporting, and daily log execution. You will serve as the strategic operational connection between leadership, stations, output teams, and production partners—ensuring the work is prioritized, resources are used effectively, issues are resolved quickly, and processes evolve as the business grows. The ideal candidate is equal parts people leader, process strategist, and problem-solver: someone who can manage today’s operational needs while building smarter, more scalable ways of working for tomorrow. What You Will Do: Lead day-to-day execution for centralized input and log coordination teams across multiple markets, ensuring quality, accuracy, and on-time delivery. Establish clear priorities, operating rhythms, escalation paths, and accountability standards that keep work moving effectively in a fast-paced environment. Lead, coach, and develop Senior Log Coordinators and Log Coordinators, creating a high-performing team grounded in collaboration, ownership, and continuous improvement. Own staffing allocation, workload balancing, capacity planning, and coverage strategies to ensure the team can meet changing business needs. Oversee contracts, traffic, copy, reporting, inventory-related workflows, and other input functions to maintain operational continuity and accuracy. Analyze workflows, performance metrics, recurring issues, and team capacity to identify bottlenecks and implement practical, measurable improvements. Design and refine standardized processes, documentation, and best practices that reduce unnecessary variation and improve consistency across markets. Partner closely with ACCET leadership, Output teams, production, station stakeholders, and cross-functional partners to align workflows with broader business priorities. Translate operational needs into clear process solutions, helping shape system enhancements, automation opportunities, and future workflow modernization. Lead resolution of complex operational issues, balancing urgency with thoughtful decision-making and clear communication. Support major initiatives, new workflows, and organizational changes by developing scalable implementation plans and guiding teams through adoption. Build a culture of continuous improvement where team members are encouraged to identify opportunities, share knowledge, and help strengthen the operation. This Role is for you if: You are a strategic, hands-on leader who can see both the daily operational details and the larger business opportunity. You have a strong track record of improving workflows, building structure, and leading teams through change. You are comfortable making decisions, setting priorities, and resolving escalations in a high-volume, deadline-driven environment. You know how to use data, metrics, and team feedback to identify inefficiencies and improve performance. You are an effective coach who sets clear expectations, develops talent, and creates accountability without losing the human side of leadership. You communicate clearly and confidently with team members, senior leaders, and cross-functional partners. You are highly organized, adaptable, and able to manage multiple priorities without losing sight of quality or customer service. You are energized by building scalable systems and finding better ways to get work done. Experience with OSI, broadcast traffic systems, media operations, or multi-market workflows is strongly preferred. Broadcast television, media operations, traffic, or related operational leadership experience is preferred. Why You’ll Love It Here: Lead a growing centralized operation with the opportunity to directly shape how work is done across the organization. Drive meaningful improvements that make teams more efficient, consistent, and prepared to scale. Partner with a collaborative leadership team focused on innovation, operational excellence, and shared success. Build systems and processes that have a visible, organization-wide impact. Grow your leadership career in a dynamic, evolving multi-market media environment. Schedule: Monday–Friday | Standard Business Hours Ready to lead smarter, more efficient media operations? Apply now and help shape the future of ACCET Operations. job.title: Product Manager
job.description: The Product Manager owns the strategy, roadmap, prioritization, and lifecycle management for a portfolio of enterprise applications that includes both custom-developed solutions and third-party SaaS or packaged products. This role partners with business stakeholders, engineering teams, vendors, and support teams to deliver measurable business value, maintain reliable operations, and evolve products in line with user needs and enterprise priorities. Key Responsibilities Product Strategy and Roadmap: Define and maintain product vision, roadmaps, and outcome-based priorities for assigned applications. Balance new capabilities, technical debt, operational stability, compliance, and user experience. Stakeholder Partnership and Discovery: Engage business users and leaders to understand workflows, pain points, opportunities, and success measures. Translate insights into clear, actionable requirements and product decisions. Portfolio and Backlog Management: Own and prioritize the product backlog using business value, risk, effort, dependencies, and strategic alignment. Ensure planned work is sufficiently refined for delivery teams and stakeholders have transparent visibility into priorities. Custom Application Delivery: Work closely with internal development, QA, architecture, and delivery teams throughout discovery, design, development, testing, release, and adoption. Provide timely decisions and clarifications during Agile ceremonies. Third-Party Application Management: Lead the business and product relationship for third-party applications, including vendor coordination, release-impact assessment, roadmap alignment, support escalation, and evaluation of configuration or enhancement opportunities. Requirements and Product Artifacts: Create and maintain product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, user experience mock-ups, release communications, and other artifacts needed to align delivery and business teams. Operational Ownership: Partner with production support and vendors to monitor service health, triage issues, communicate business impact, and prioritize corrective work. Help ensure a disciplined transition from delivery to sustainable support. Validation and Adoption: Plan and coordinate user acceptance testing, gather feedback, validate outcomes, and support rollout readiness, training, and adoption activities. Measurement and Continuous Improvement: Define and use product, operational, and adoption metrics to assess performance, identify trends, and drive continuous improvement. Required Experience and Skills Bachelor’s degree in information technology, business, computer science, or a related field; equivalent experience will be considered. Five or more years of product management, product ownership, business analysis, or comparable experience supporting enterprise applications. Experience managing a mix of custom-developed applications, integrations and third-party SaaS or packaged software. Strong ability to turn business needs into well-structured requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and product documentation. Demonstrated ability to prioritize competing demands using data, business value, risk, and operational impact. Working knowledge of Agile delivery practices, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives. Comfort working with software vendors on product roadmaps, support escalations, releases, and enhancement requests. Strong analytical, communication, facilitation, and stakeholder-management skills; able to lead through influence rather than formal authority. Ability to understand and troubleshoot complex software workflows and communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences. A customer-focused, curious, adaptable approach and commitment to continuous learning and improvement. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting enterprise business systems in a complex, multi-stakeholder organization. Experience with product analytics, service management, or application lifecycle management tools (Azure DevOps experience preferred). Experience coordinating Tier 2 support activities and working across internal delivery teams and external vendors. Other duties as assigned. This position is on site in Hunt Valley, MD. Candidates must be local or willing to commute. Please note that this position is not eligible for visa sponsorship, including employer sponsorship for an H-1B visa, OPT-STEM employment, etc. Sinclair is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and a drug free workplace. job.title: Regional Sales Assistant
job.description: KRCG has an exciting opportunity for a Regional National Sales Assistant. If you would like to work in the exciting business of television sales, this could be the job for you! Responsibilities include: Primary function is data entry of national sales orders from national advertisers Daily entry of National Sales orders into the traffic system with accuracy and complying to order contract, inventory, and scheduling constraints. Daily maintenance and research on national sales orders to troubleshoot and resolve order-related issues and discrepancies Regular communication and collaboration with both internal and external contacts to ensure campaign success. Develop a strong understanding and adherence to the National sales process and nuances, systems, and SOPs Consistent independent prioritizing and organizing of workload with a sense of urgency and balance. Completion of assigned tasks within the given deadline. Regular generation, manipulation, and maintenance of reports both from internal systems and Excel spreadsheets. Daily use of Windows PC including Office programs such as Outlook, Teams, Excel, and Word. Other duties as assigned Skills and Qualifications: At least 1-2 years’ experience of administrative support preferred A high level of organizational skills and the ability to prioritize and multi-task Strong attention to detail and the ability to handle multiple tasks under a deadline Ability to work independently as well as part of a team Consistently comply with organizational directives and national standard operating procedures. Excellent interpersonal skills for effective interaction with internal and external team members Proficient in Microsoft Outlook, Teams, Word, and Excel Broadcast Sales, media buying, or agency experience is a plus Maintain a positive demeanor and customer service focus EEO AND INCLUSIVITY: Sinclair is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and a drug free workplace. job.title: Sales and Marketing Assistant
job.description: This Job Description May Cause Extreme Excitement and Career Growth At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we believe a great workplace isn't just something we say — it's something you can feel when you join the team. Here, it's all about great collabs, ambition, and results but most importantly, we grow here, and we enjoy here. We're searching for that special someone — a driven, talented individual to join our innovative media sales and marketing solutions team. In this role, you'll engage with new and existing clients and show them how our innovative media solutions can amplify their brands and deliver measurable success. If you're energized by building relationships, closing deals, and making an impact, we'd love to hear from you. Sound like the right fit? Check out the checklist below and if it sounds like you, hit "Apply Now" and let's chat. Your Day-to-Day (aka the Playbook) o Help Us Thrive: Amplify our media sales efforts by supporting our sales operations. Your success is our success, and we believe in celebrating wins! o Unleash Your Potential: Dive headfirst into the exciting world of media sales, where every interaction is an opportunity to make a lasting impression! o Build Relationships: Connect with internal and external clients, understanding their needs to provide support. o Innovate and Inspire: We value creativity at all levels of our organization and encourage you to think outside the box to find new ways to support our business and elevate our brand. o Collaborate and Grow: Work closely with our focused media sales teams to ensure a top-notch customer experience. Together, we'll amplify our impact and achieve remarkable results! o Stay Ahead of the Curve: Keep your finger on the pulse of industry trends and competitive strategies to ensure we're always a step ahead in the marketplace. What We're Looking For o Proven Business Support Ability (or an Unstoppable Desire to Learn): Whether you're a seasoned administrative or business support specialist or just getting started, we value your drive, energy, and passion for achieving results. o Strong Communication Skills: You're a natural at building relationships and communicating effectively. Proficiency with digital tools and applications is a must. o A Passion for Helping Others: You are committed to understanding our teams' needs, providing top-notch administrative and business support, and making a difference. o A Willingness to Grow: Do you thrive in environments where you're always learning something new? Excellent, you'll fit right in! The media world is constantly evolving, and the ability to learn, adapt, and embrace challenges in a fast-paced, digital-first environment is key. Why Join AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions? / The Reasons You Should Hit "Apply Now" o Serious Work, Seriously Cool People: Be part of a dynamic team that values creativity, collaboration, and fun! We are all for work that is rewarding. o Attractive Rewards: Enjoy competitive compensation that rewards your hard work. Our people love our benefits package. o We Make a Real Difference (Not Just Talk About It): At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we help local businesses thrive through advertising strategies that create tangible impacts. Our media sales team isn't just selling ads; they're the boots on the ground, making a real difference where it counts. (And yes, it feels pretty good.) o Career Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in you. That's why you'll have access to training, mentorship, and career advancement opportunities to help you thrive. We are a leader in our industry, flexing our local charm and national muscle, to provide you with options to amplify your career in your local market or join one of our AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions teams in another city. o Comprehensive Media Education (We Are Your Power Source!): New to the industry? We've got you covered with training programs that turn curiosity into expertise. AMP is us. It's you. It isn't just a name; it's a mission. A promise to amplify our reach, amplify our innovation, and most importantly, amplify you . If you're ready to grow your career and help businesses achieve their goals, we'd love to hear from you. The base hourly compensation range for this role is $20.00 to $21.31. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors such as a candidates’ relevant work experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location. Full time positions are eligible for benefits that include participation in a retirement plan, life and disability insurance, health, dental and vision plans, flexible spending accounts, sick leave, vacation time, personal time, parental leave and employee stock purchase plan. EEO AND INCLUSIVITY Sinclair is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and a drug free workplace. job.title: Sales and Marketing Specialist
job.description: This Job Description May Cause Extreme Excitement and Career Growth At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we believe a great workplace isn't just something we say — it's something you can feel when you join the team. Here, it's all about great collabs, ambition, and results but most importantly, we grow here, and we enjoy here. We're searching for that special someone — a driven, talented individual to join our innovative media sales team. In this role, you'll engage with new and existing clients and show them how our innovative media solutions can amplify their brands and deliver measurable success. If you're energized by building relationships, closing deals, and making an impact, we'd love to hear from you. Sound like the right fit? Check out the checklist below and if it sounds like you, hit "Apply Now" and let's chat. Your Day-to-Day (aka the Playbook) Help Brands Thrive: Join our media sales team and play a pivotal role in helping brands and companies grow. By identifying new opportunities, building strong client relationships, and delivering impactful solutions, you'll showcase how our multi-media content platforms and digital assets can drive meaningful results for our partners. Your focus will be on helping clients achieve their goals, ensuring that every campaign is a success. When our clients win, we win—and we believe in celebrating those victories together! Make Connections: Embrace your powers of persuasion and make every handshake and meeting count! Every interaction is a chance to build a genuine connection and show clients how we can help them succeed. You're not just selling; you're building partnerships. You're helping businesses find the right audience in the right place at the right time. When we say One Partner, Endless Possibilities, we mean it! Be A Trusted Guide: In this role, you'll connect with clients on a human level, understand their unique needs, and craft tailored sales and marketing solutions that deliver results. As their trusted advisor, you'll help them navigate the ever-evolving marketing landscape, ensuring every step of the journey is planned with care and precision. Shake Things Up: Bring your creativity and fresh ideas to the table! We're looking for someone who challenges the status quo, embraces innovation, and finds new ways to connect with our audience. Your contributions will help elevate our brand and drive meaningful results for your clients. Join us and Conquer the Media Landscape: You'll be part of a dedicated team of A1 media sales professionals, committed to achieving market leadership. Together, we amplify our impact, deliver exceptional outcomes, and help our clients succeed in ways that truly matter. Identify Emerging Opportunities: It's about being able to see what others can't, anticipating market shifts, analyzing data and predicting the next big thing. Your insights will position our clients and AMP for long-term success. What We're Looking For Proven Sales Ability (or an Unstoppable Desire to Learn) Whether you're a seasoned sales professional or just getting started, we value your drive, energy, and passion for achieving results. Strong Communication Skills: You're a natural at building relationships and communicating effectively. Proficiency with digital tools and applications is a must. A Passion for helping Others: You're committed to understanding clients' needs, providing top-notch customer service and making a difference. You're not just selling a product; you're providing a solution. A Competitive Spirit: Do you get a little boost when you achieve a goal (especially if it was a tough one)? We love that for you (and us)! We want someone who's driven to excel but also knows how to celebrate the victories (big and small) with their team. That drive makes you a valuable part of our organization. A Willingness to Grow: Do you thrive in environments where you're always learning something new? Excellent, you'll fit right in! The media world is constantly evolving, and the ability to learn, adapt, and embrace challenges in a fast-paced, digital-first environment is key. The Practical Stuff A valid driver's license, up-to-date insurance, and reliable transportation are necessary for connecting with clients in your community. Why Join AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions? / The Reasons You Should Hit "Apply Now" Serious Work, Seriously Cool People: Be part of a dynamic team that values creativity, collaboration, and fun! We are all for work that is rewarding. The Compensation Package: We offer a base salary, commission structure, and benefits package designed to support your success and well-being. Happy employees don't stage rebellions! ;) We Make a Real Difference (Not Just Talk About It): At AMP, we help local businesses thrive through advertising strategies that create tangible impacts. Our media sales specialist isn't just selling ads; they're the boots on the ground, making a real difference where it counts. (And yes, it feels pretty good.) Top-Notch Training and Support: We're not the kind of company that hires you and then disappears into the corporate abyss. We carefully select candidates for a cohort-based training program, where you'll join a group of sales professionals from all over the country. From onboarding to ongoing mentorship, we invest in your success with training programs that set you up for long-term growth. Career Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in you. That's why you'll have access to training, mentorship, and career advancement opportunities to help you thrive. We are a leader in our industry, flexing our local charm and national muscle, providing you with options to amplify your career in your local market or join one of our AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions teams in another city. Comprehensive Media Education (We Are Your Power Source!): New to the industry? We've got you covered with training programs that turn curiosity into expertise. AMP is us. It's you. It isn't just a name; it's a mission. A promise to amplify our reach, amplify our innovation, and most importantly, amplify you. If you're ready to grow your career and help businesses achieve their goals, we'd love to hear from you. EEO AND INCLUSIVITY Sinclair is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and a drug free workplace. Employment practices will not be inﬂuenced or aﬀected by virtue of an applicant's or employee's race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

job.title: Senior Content Creator
job.description: Are you an experienced creative storyteller who can lead high-quality production from idea through final delivery? Do you strive for “Excellence in Everything” while helping shape stronger creative, support teammates, and keep production moving? Join Sinclair, Inc. and the Agile Creative Content Engagement Team (ACCET) as a Senior Content Creator based in our Providence, RI TV station group. This senior hands-on production role is focused on writing, producing, shooting, editing, and delivering high-impact creative content across multiple markets and platforms. As a Senior Content Creator, you will own complex client, market, regional, and national creative projects while helping guide creative execution, strengthen production quality, and support the development of other Content Creators. This role is ideal for someone with strong production judgment, advanced hands-on skills, and the ability to lead by example without losing connection to the work. This is a senior creative role for someone who can step into the most important projects, shape scripts and concepts, produce shoots, solve edits, protect quality standards, and help bring priority work across the finish line. WHAT YOU'LL DO: As an ACCET Senior Content Creator, you will create and help lead commercial, branded, digital, promotional, and multi-platform content for assigned markets while supporting strong creative quality, clear communication, and reliable delivery. Lead High-Quality Creative Production Write, produce, shoot, edit, and deliver commercial spots, branded content, digital campaigns, promotional creative, and other client deliverables. Own high-profile, complex, or priority projects from concept through final delivery, including scripting, pre-production, field production, editing, graphics, audio, revisions, approvals, and exports. Develop creative that is clear, compelling, strategically aligned, and appropriate for the audience, platform, client, and market need. Maintain high standards for storytelling, visual quality, brand consistency, pacing, sound, graphics, and overall production value. Use strong creative judgment to solve production challenges, improve creative outcomes, and protect the quality of the final product. Support Market, Regional, and National Production Needs Produce creative work for multiple assigned markets while balancing deadlines, priorities, revisions, and client expectations. Support high-profile, priority, multi-market, regional, or national productions as business needs require. Coordinate production details with Client Services Managers, Strategists, Project Managers, Sales teams, clients, and market stakeholders. Help keep production moving during urgent deadlines, high-volume periods, priority campaigns, or complex client deliverables. Adapt quickly to changing production needs, shifting priorities, production constraints, and time-sensitive requests. Provide Creative Leadership and Team Support Serve as a senior creative resource for Content Creators, helping support quality, clarity, creative direction, and production problem-solving. Provide constructive feedback, practical guidance, and creative support to help teammates strengthen scripts, shoots, edits, graphics, audio, and final delivery. Mentor and support Content Creators through knowledge sharing, production best practices, and feedback that helps raise the overall quality of the team. Help translate client, Sales, and market needs into clear creative direction that can be executed effectively. Model strong professionalism, accountability, collaboration, and creative ownership across ACCET. Collaborate Across Teams and Maintain Workflow Standards Partner with Sales, Client Services, Brand, Digital, Project Managers, and market leadership to understand goals and expectations. Participate in creative discussions, campaign planning, production conversations, and feedback exchanges as needed. Communicate clearly about project status, creative needs, production challenges, asset requirements, and delivery timelines. Use Adobe Workfront and other Sinclair systems to track assignments, respond to requests, update project status, and support workflow accuracy. Follow ACCET production standards, file management expectations, brand guidelines, quality-control steps, and approval processes. WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE SPECIAL: A senior hands-on creative role with impact across multiple television markets. Opportunity to lead and produce high-profile commercial, branded, digital, and promotional content. A chance to support local, regional, and national creative work inside ACCET. A role that combines advanced production skill with mentorship, creative judgment, and team support. A fast-moving environment where storytelling, craft, collaboration, problem-solving, and creative ownership matter. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR: Advanced writing, producing, shooting, editing, storytelling, communication, and organizational skills. 3+ years of experience in commercial production, broadcast television, creative services, video production, post-production, digital content, agency work, or a related field preferred. Ability to independently lead polished commercial, branded, digital, or promotional content from concept through delivery. Strong understanding of video production workflows, including concept development, scripting, shooting, editing, graphics, audio, client approvals, revisions, and final export. Proficiency with Adobe Creative Cloud, including Premiere Pro; experience with After Effects, Photoshop, Illustrator, Audition, or similar tools is a plus. Familiarity with digital video, social media content, OTT/CTV advertising, branded content, and multi-platform campaign production preferred. Experience providing creative feedback, mentoring teammates, or helping guide production quality is preferred. Comfort working in project management systems; Adobe Workfront experience is a plus. Ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, stakeholders, and priorities in a fast-paced environment. Ability to lift, carry, and move production equipment as needed; valid driver license and good driving record may be required for production-related needs. A proactive mindset focused on creativity, collaboration, accountability, quality, efficiency, and continuous improvement. YOU SHOULD APPLY IF: You are an experienced creator who wants to lead by example while still staying hands-on in the work. You can write, shoot, produce, edit, shape creative, and solve production challenges at a high level. You enjoy helping teammates grow while maintaining strong standards for creative quality and delivery. You can manage several projects at once while keeping priorities clear, quality high, and deadlines on track. You communicate clearly, take feedback well, and work effectively with creative, Sales, client, and leadership partners. You want to help ACCET deliver meaningful, high-quality creative work across multiple markets and platforms. WORKING HOURS AND TRAVEL: Typical schedule is Monday to Friday during standard business hours. Schedule flexibility may be required based on production needs, client deliverables, station events, regional or national productions, or other time-sensitive projects. Some longer days, nights, weekends, or holidays may be required based on business needs. Travel may be required but is expected to be infrequent. If you are ready to lead high-quality creative execution, stay hands-on in the production process, support a strong creative team, and help ACCET deliver impactful work across multiple markets, we want to hear from you. Sinclair is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and a drug free workplace. Employment practices will not be influenced or affected by virtue of an applicant's or employee's race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law. About Sinclair Sinclair, Inc. (Nasdaq: SBGI) is a diversified media company and a leading provider of local news and sports. The Company owns, operates and/or provides services to 177 television stations in 79 markets affiliated with all major broadcast networks; owns Tennis Channel, the premium destination for tennis enthusiasts; and multicast networks CHARGE, Comet, ROAR and The Nest. Sinclair’s AMP Media produces a growing portfolio of digital content and original podcasts. Additional information about Sinclair can be found at www.sbgi.net . About the Team The life-blood of our organization is our people. We have a compelling story, a goal-oriented culture, and we take really good care of people. How good? Here is a glimpse: great benefits, open-door policy, upward mobility and a strong desire to see you succeed. Ready to be part of a winning team? Let’s talk.

job.title: Senior Creative Producer, Original Content
job.description: AMP Sports is quickly emerging as one of the leading sports media companies producing highly engaging content across podcasts, YouTube, and social platforms. Home to some of the top sports podcasts, including “Cousins with Vince Carter and Tracy McGrady,” “The Triple Option with Urban Meyer, Mark Ingram II, and Rob Stone,” “Unfiltered Soccer with Landon Donovan and Tim Howard,” “Post Moves with Candace Parker and Aliyah Boston,” and “Style of Play with Julie Ertz and Kealia Watt” as well as a network of team-focused podcasts, with more shows slated for 2026 and beyond. With a rapidly expanding digital footprint and a reach spanning 180+ broadcast stations and tens of millions of followers, AMP Sports continues to build scalable content ecosystems that drive audience growth, engagement, and revenue. We are seeking a Senior Creative Producer, Original Content to develop, produce, and launch original, audience-first video and social franchises across the AMP Sports portfolio that expand our shows beyond the core podcast, drive audience growth, and increase the long-term value of our talent and show IP. Partnering closely with leadership, content, social, production, and marketing, this role will proactively identify programming opportunities, pitch new concepts, and own approved projects from idea through delivery. They will also work with individual show teams to develop more creative, visual, and repeatable in-show formats designed to perform across YouTube, social, and the broader digital ecosystem. The ideal candidate is a highly creative video-first producer and director with exceptional original content instincts and the production experience to turn ambitious ideas into finished programming. They are a creator and storyteller, and understand how talent-led digital brands grow across YouTube and social platforms. They should be equally comfortable developing a franchise, directing talent in the field, managing a production budget and external crew, or helping a show producer build a stronger recurring segment. Strong hands-on video production skills are required. What You’ll Do Proactively develop, pitch, and produce premium original video franchises, recurring series, tentpole concepts, and shoulder programming built around AMP Sports shows and talent designed to drive audience growth. Own creative process from concept through delivery, including development, ideation, pre-production through post-production, and final delivery. Partner with show producers to level up existing programming through creative concepts designed to improve audience growth, retention, and engagement. Extend the AMP Sports talent and show IP beyond the core podcast, with a particular focus on premium YouTube video, repeatable franchises, and original concepts. Own the entire production process of original video content in, studio, field, and remote environments, maintaining a high standard of creative and technical execution. Direct on-camera talent, athletes, and creators in studio and on location, with the ability to shape story, conversation, performance, and creative execution. Lead post-production process, partner with editors and post-production teams to shape narrative through the edit, providing creative direction on larger projects. Ideate original programming built for discovery, distribution, and growth across YouTube and social platforms; use audience and performance insights to inform creative decisions. Work with show leads to develop and maintain a pipeline of programming ideas and opportunities; consult on new show launches and talent development when appropriate. Serve as a flexible senior creative resource across the portfolio, with the ability to step into lead producer responsibilities when needed. Assist developing and managing project budgets, and hire and oversee freelance production teams, vendors, and other external resources to execute approved concepts. Other duties as assigned. Who You Are 7+ years producing premium original digital video for a media or production company, sports or entertainment brand, agency, creator-led business, or similar. A highly creative developer and storyteller, with a proven track record of originating compelling programming, video concepts, recurring franchises, or similar and bringing them from concept through execution across YouTube, long-form video, social, and other digital platforms. A portfolio that demonstrates exceptional creative instincts and format development skills across premium digital content. Expertise producing, shooting, and editing content in both field and studio environments across a variety of formats. Exceptional storytelling skills and editorial instincts, with the ability to identify compelling narratives and turn those into high value content that connects with audiences. Experience directing on-camera talent, creators, athletes, and high-profile personalities, maximizing their skillsets. Proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite (or similar), as well as hands-on production skills with cameras, lighting, microphones, etc. in field, studio, and remote settings. Strong understanding of social and YouTube best practices, audience retention, content packaging, SEO, and how content is consumed by audience across platforms. A self-starter, highly collaborative, and able to lead and work across multiple teams while also working independently without oversight. Someone who has a strong passion for creating digital-first content that cuts through the noise and drives significant audience growth. Experience developing and managing production budgets, and onboarding and managing freelancers, vendors, and other external resources is a plus. Highly organized and communicative, ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while ensuring all projects stay on timeline and all key stakeholders are involved. Ability to travel and work nights, weekends, or holidays as projects call for. The base salary compensation range for this role is $100,000 to $130,000. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors such as a candidates’ relevant work experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location. Full time positions are eligible for benefits that include participation in a retirement plan, life and disability insurance, health, dental and vision plans, flexible spending accounts, sick leave,vacation time, personal time, parental leave and employee stock purchase plan.
