job.title: Senior Manager, Integrated and Experiential Marketing
job.description: Sinclair is seeking a highly organized, solutions-oriented Senior Manager, Integrated and Experiential Marketing to lead the planning and execution of live events, experiential activations, brand experiences and campaigns, as well as hospitality programs for our podcast division. Reporting to the AVP, Marketing, this role will serve as the operational and marketing lead responsible for bringing activations and campaigns from concept to execution. The Senior Manager will oversee event logistics, production, vendors, venues, budgets, timelines, staffing, talent requirements, campaign management and on-site operations while partnering closely with Marketing, Creative, Content, Sales, podcast talent, and external production partners. The ideal candidate thrives in fast-moving live environments and combines strong event production and campaign experience with exceptional project management, financial discipline, and attention to detail. This individual is equally comfortable building a production timeline, managing vendors and budgets, troubleshooting on site, coordinating talent and VIP experiences, and collaborating with marketing teams to ensure each activation delivers against brand, audience, and business objectives. This role requires hands-on involvement and travel for events and activations as needed. Responsibilities Live Event & Experiential Operations Lead end-to-end operational planning and execution for live podcast events, experiential activations, consumer experiences, hospitality programs, partner events, and other priority brand moments. Translate event concepts into detailed operational and production plans, including timelines, staffing plans, production schedules, run-of-show documents, budgets, vendor requirements, and on-site execution plans. Manage venue sourcing and coordination, including site visits, contracts, production requirements, load-in/load-out schedules, venue rules, security, access, catering, parking, and other logistical needs. Coordinate technical and production requirements including audio, lighting, staging, video, scenic, signage, power, internet, livestreaming, recording, and other event infrastructure. Oversee event vendors and production partners from sourcing and bidding through contracting, execution, invoicing, and reconciliation. Develop and maintain comprehensive event timelines, production schedules, contact sheets, run-of-show documents, floor plans, credentialing plans, and other operational materials. Lead on-site event operations, serving as a primary point of contact for internal stakeholders, talent, vendors, venues, production teams, and partners. Anticipate operational risks and develop contingency plans to address production, talent, venue, weather, technology, staffing, and other potential event challenges. Coordinate event staffing, security, registration, guest management, hospitality, transportation, catering, and other event services as required. Partner with appropriate internal and external stakeholders to ensure events meet applicable safety, accessibility, permitting, insurance, and venue requirements. Podcast Talent & Guest Experience Partner with podcast teams and talent representatives to understand and execute talent requirements for live events and appearances. Coordinate talent schedules, green rooms, transportation, credentials, hospitality, rehearsals, backstage operations, and other on-site needs. Support the development and delivery of high-quality audience, talent, client, partner, and VIP experiences. Maintain discretion and professionalism when working with high-profile talent, clients, executives, and external partners. Experiential & Brand Activations Partner with Marketing, Creative, Content, Social, Sales, and podcast teams to operationalize experiential concepts and bring brand experiences to life. Help evaluate concepts for operational feasibility, production requirements, timing, budget, scalability, and audience experience. Ensure physical activations accurately and consistently reflect brand strategy, creative direction, sponsorship commitments, and program objectives. Identify opportunities to enhance the attendee experience through thoughtful programming, production, hospitality, technology, content capture, and physical environment. Lead campaigns from initial strategy and concept development through execution, optimization, and post-campaign analysis. Develop clear campaign objectives, audience strategies, messaging, channel plans, timelines, and KPIs. Collaborate with Marketing and Content teams to support opportunities to extend live experiences through social, digital, video, audio, and other channels. Client & Partner Activations Partner with Sales and Marketing teams on sponsored experiences, client activations, custom events, and integrated partnership programs. Translate sold concepts and sponsorship commitments into clear operational deliverables and production requirements. Participate in client and partner meetings when appropriate to communicate event plans, production considerations, timelines, and execution details. Track sponsorship and partner deliverables to ensure contractual event elements are executed accurately. Build strong working relationships with clients, agencies, venues, production companies, fabricators, experiential agencies, and other external partners. Budget & Vendor Management Develop and manage project-level event and activation budgets in partnership with Marketing leadership and Finance. Solicit and evaluate vendor bids, negotiate costs and scopes of work, and identify opportunities to maximize production value while maintaining financial discipline. Manage purchase orders, contracts, invoices, deposits, vendor payments, expense tracking, forecasts, and post-event reconciliation. Maintain accurate budget trackers and communicate financial risks, changes, and opportunities throughout the lifecycle of each event. Project Management & Cross-Functional Collaboration Serve as the operational owner for multiple simultaneous events, campaigns and activations, establishing clear timelines, responsibilities, dependencies, and deliverables. Lead regular production and planning meetings with internal stakeholders and external partners. Proactively identify roadblocks, resolve issues, and communicate changes that could impact scope, budget, timing, or execution. Maintain organized event documentation, vendor records, production materials, budgets, contracts, and post-event reporting. Conduct post-event debriefs and document key learnings, operational improvements, and recommendations for future programs. Contribute to broader Marketing and podcast division initiatives, special projects, and live-event strategy as needed. Requirements 5–7 years of experience in live event production, integrated marketing, experiential marketing, event operations, entertainment production, or a related field. Demonstrated experience managing complex live events and experiential activations from initial planning through on-site execution and post-event reconciliation. Strong knowledge of event production and operations, including venues, AV, staging, lighting, audio, scenic, staffing, hospitality, transportation, security, and event logistics. Proven ability to manage multiple vendors, production partners, venues, and workstreams simultaneously. Strong project management skills with experience developing production timelines, run-of-show documents, budgets, staffing plans, and detailed operational plans. Experience managing event budgets, vendor estimates, purchase orders, invoices, forecasts, and financial reconciliation. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to remain composed and make sound decisions in fast-paced live-event environments. Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills. Exceptional organization and attention to detail with a strong sense of ownership and follow-through. Ability to collaborate effectively across Marketing, Creative, Content, Sales, Production, Finance, talent teams, and external partners. Ability and willingness to travel and work evenings, weekends, and nontraditional hours as required by event schedules. Experience working with talent, creators, athletes, celebrities, executives, clients, or VIP guests is preferred. Experience in podcasts, media, entertainment, sports, experiential marketing, or live events is strongly preferred. Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Event Management, Production, Business, or a related field preferred. The base salary compensationrange for this roleis $110,000 to $130,000. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors such as a candidates’ relevant work experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location. Full time positions are eligible for benefits that include participation in a retirement plan, life and disability insurance, health, dental and vision plans, flexible spending accounts, sick leave, vacation time, personal time, parental leave and employee stock purchase plan. Sinclair is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and a drug free workplace. Employment practices will not be influenced or affected by virtue of an applicant's or employee's race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law. The Company owns, operates and/or provides services to 177 television stations in 79 markets affiliated with all major broadcast networks; owns Tennis Channel, the premium destination for tennis enthusiasts; and multicast networks CHARGE, Comet, ROAR and The Nest. Sinclair’s AMP Media produces a growing portfolio of digital content and original podcasts. Additional information about Sinclair can be found at www.sbgi.net. job.title: Senior Social Producer, Branded Content
job.description: AMP Sports is quickly emerging as one of the leading sports media companies producing highly engaging content across podcasts, YouTube, and social platforms. Home to some of the top sports podcasts, including “Cousins with Vince Carter and Tracy McGrady,” “The Triple Option with Urban Meyer, Mark Ingram II, and Rob Stone,” “Unfiltered Soccer with Landon Donovan and Tim Howard,” “Post Moves with Candace Parker and Aliyah Boston,” and “Style of Play with Julie Ertz and Kealia Watt” as well as a network of team-focused podcasts, with more shows slated for 2026 and beyond. With a rapidly expanding digital footprint and a reach spanning 180+ broadcast stations and tens of millions of followers, AMP Sports continues to build scalable content ecosystems that drive audience growth, engagement, and revenue. We are seeking a Senior Social Producer, Branded Content to develop and produce original, audience-first, premium short-form social content and digital franchises across the AMP Sports portfolio that support brand partnerships and revenue growth. Partnering closely with leadership, social, production, sales, and marketing, this person will identify new content opportunities, develop creative concepts, and own execution from idea through delivery. They will translate advertiser briefs into content that delivers brand messaging while still feeling organic, entertaining, and valuable to our audiences. The ideal candidate is a highly versatile social-first digital producer and editor with strong creative instincts and deep understanding of audience growth, platform strategy, and original short-form content development. They can turn brand objectives, platform and audience insights, and show strategy into compelling social programming, and can oversee ideas from concept through production and publishing. Hands-on production and editing skills, and an understanding of production workflows will be necessary. What You’ll Do Partner with content, sales, marketing, and leadership to proactively develop a pipeline of branded social franchises, sponsored concepts, and social-first extensions designed to grow audiences and create revenue opportunities. Oversee end-to-end execution of a variety of highly engaging branded social franchises and sponsored content, from static posts and short-form video to on location and activation productions. Work with sales to translate advertiser briefs, objectives, and brand guidelines into creative concepts that feel authentic to our programming, channels, and audiences. Partner with individual show content and social teams to ensure alignment with broader programming and audience strategies, while independently managing publishing and optimization of branded content. Own assigned projects from concept through delivery. Manage pre-sale through post-production workflow, ensuring all teams are aligned expectations, timelines, and deliverables. Oversee production and post-production of social content, with the ability to edit, shoot, and/or direct when appropriate, particularly for fast-turnaround social work. Leverage strong understanding of platform algorithms and content strategies across YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Threads, and Facebook to optimize publishing and distribution for maximize audience growth. Publish content according to strategies set. Identify opportunities to extend larger productions into compelling short-form and social assets rather than simply creating cutdowns. Work across multiple AMP Sports shows while maintaining each show’s distinct voice, audience strategy, and creative identity. Evaluate campaign performances, use audience data and platform analytics, and keep up with latest trends to identify content opportunities and inform creative and distribution decisions. Produce and direct on-camera talent, athletes, and creators remotely, in studio, and on location when necessary. Serve as a flexible senior social resource across the portfolio, with the ability to step into lead channel strategy responsibilities when needed. Other duties as assigned. Who You Are 5+ years producing premium digital and short-form social content for a media company, sports brand, agency, or digital first brand. A digital producer first, with strong experience developing original ideas and bringing them from concept through execution, particularly across social and short-form video for brands. Proven experience developing social programming or content strategies while integrating partner objectives that have driven measurable audience growth, engagement, or viewership. Highly proficient in Adobe Creative Suite, with the ability to independently edit engaging, polished short-form social content. Experience receiving a brand brief and independently overseeing execution of campaign requirements across social, from ideation to publishing. Deeply fluent in YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and Threads channel strategies, including how content, distribution, and publishing should be adapted for each platform. Working fluency with production equipment (cameras, lighting, microphones) with an ability to independently shoot and produce high-quality content. Experienced working directly with and coaching on-camera talent, athletes, creators, or other high-profile personalities. Strong organizational skills, ability to align multiple teams and manage ongoing productions across several shows simultaneously. Highly collaborative, proactive, resourceful, and comfortable operating with significant creative ownership while maintaining alignment with key stakeholders. Passionate about sports content across digital channels, keeping up with latest news, trends, and best practices. Experience sourcing and manage freelance crews, vendors, and other production resources for larger projects is a plus. Ability to travel, and work nights, weekends, and holidays as projects call for. The base salary compensation range for thisrole is $100,000 to $120,000. Final compensation for this role will be determinedby various factors such as a candidates’relevant work experience, skills, certifications,and geographic location. job.title: Solutions Marketing Associate
job.description: The Solutions Marketing Associate helps Sales create more quality client conversations while delivering fast, polished support for everyday opportunities. This role sits closest to the front end of the sales funnel: helping sellers identify the right accounts, do their homework, personalize outreach, and turn established marketing materials into relevant client-facing presentations. For standard and smaller opportunities, typically $100K or less, the Associate uses existing positioning, narratives, templates, research, case studies, and proof points to efficiently build tailored sales materials without recreating strategy from scratch. At the prospecting stage, the Associate gives sellers the account intelligence and lead development support they need to earn more meetings. This role builds the intelligence and inputs behind outreach but does not conduct cold calling, prospecting outreach, or appointment setting. The north star is twofold: help Sales get into more of the right conversations, and help them show up to those conversations prepared. What You’ll Do Prospecting & Meeting Generation Support Identify and research target accounts that fit priority audiences, verticals, solutions, or seller territories. Build and maintain actionable lead and account lists with the context sellers need to prioritize outreach. Research target companies, key contacts, recent business developments, marketing activity, competitive context, and relevant signals that can create a reason to engage. Prepare concise account briefs and outreach inputs that help sellers personalize emails, calls, and meeting requests. Connect prospect needs and business signals to relevant Digital Remedy capabilities, proof points, content, and conversation starters. Partner with Sales on focused prospecting initiatives and campaigns designed to generate qualified meetings. Track which research, prospecting themes, and materials are helping sellers open doors and use those learnings to improve future support. Sales Presentations & Everyday Opportunity Support Support standard and smaller opportunities, typically $100K or less, by tailoring existing presentations and materials to the customer and opportunity. Build polished client-facing decks using established templates, positioning, solution narratives, case studies, research, and proof points. Quickly identify the most relevant existing materials instead of rebuilding presentations from scratch. Perform light account, category, audience, or competitive research when needed to make an established story more relevant. Ensure materials are accurate, on-brand, easy for sellers to present, and aligned with established messaging. Escalate opportunities that require original research, custom strategy, or a new problem-led narrative to the Solutions Marketing Analyst or Manager. Sales Alignment & Enablement Serve as a highly responsive day-to-day partner to Sales, understanding seller priorities, pipeline needs, and recurring friction points. Help sellers navigate available materials, case studies, research, and solution stories so they can self-serve effectively when appropriate. Capture recurring requests and content gaps and share them with the Solutions Marketing Manager and Product & Enablement team. Support broader sales and marketing initiatives that create demand, improve seller preparedness, or accelerate opportunities. What Success Looks Like Sellers have a consistent pipeline of well-researched accounts and stronger reasons to reach out. Prospecting support contributes to more qualified meetings and new sales conversations. Smaller and standard opportunities receive fast, polished, relevant presentation support without unnecessary custom development. Sales spends less time searching for materials and researching accounts and more time engaging customers. The Associate knows when to activate existing materials and when an opportunity should be escalated for deeper strategic support. What You Bring 1-3 years of experience in sales development, sales support, marketing, research, enablement, account planning, or a coordinator/associate role. Strong research instincts and genuine curiosity about companies, industries, buyers, and business challenges. Strong PowerPoint or Google Slides skills and good visual judgment. Ability to turn research into concise, usable seller talking points and outreach inputs. Excellent organization and ability to manage multiple fast-turn requests. A proactive, service-oriented mindset paired with the confidence to ask questions and recommend a better path when needed. Familiarity with CRM, prospecting, sales intelligence, and research tools is a plus. Interest in developing toward solutions marketing, insights, strategy, or sales enablement. Please note that this position is not eligible for visa sponsorship, including employer sponsorship for an H-1B visa, OPT-STEM employment, etc. Why Digital Remedy? We are in a high-growth phase, integrating innovative tech from recent acquisitions. You will have a seat at the table to influence our long-term technical strategy and help us "build and scale" for the future. job.title: Solutions Marketing Manager
job.description: The Solutions Marketing Manager leads the team responsible for turning customer challenges into insight-led, differentiated solutions. This role is both a people leader and a senior strategic partner to Sales, setting the standard for how the organization approaches complex opportunities, RFPs/RFIs, and high-priority client conversations. Rather than starting with a product or a predetermined activation, the Manager starts with the customer: What are they trying to accomplish? What does the market tell us? Which combination of capabilities can best address the challenge? And what is the most compelling story for why Digital Remedy can solve it? The Manager owns the strategic approach for the most complex opportunities while building a team and operating model that gives Sales the right level of support across the pipeline. What You’ll Do Lead Customer & Opportunity Strategy Partner with Sales on complex, strategic, and high-value opportunities to identify the underlying customer business and marketing challenge. Lead problem-led solution development that combines multiple products, audiences, platforms, media types, and services around specific customer needs. Define the strategic angle, narrative architecture, and recommendation for major pitches, RFPs, and RFIs. Challenge briefs and assumptions constructively when a stronger strategic approach can improve the opportunity. Translate customer objectives, audiences, KPIs, and market dynamics into clear strategic recommendations. Build Strategic Narratives & Solutions Develop executive-level client narratives that connect challenge, insight, strategy, solution, proof, and expected outcome. Ensure recommendations are integrated solutions rather than collections of disconnected capabilities. Lead custom research and insight development where it can materially strengthen the strategy. Simplify complex capabilities into persuasive stories for senior client and agency audiences. Lead quarterly business reviews for top strategic accounts, setting the standard for how the team frames performance, insight, and forward-looking recommendations that shape the client relationship. Lead the Solutions Marketing Team Manage, coach, and develop the Solutions Marketing Analyst and Solutions Marketing Associate. Establish intake, prioritization, routing, and quality standards so the team deploys strategic resources where they can have the greatest revenue impact. Create clear escalation paths from scalable sales support to custom strategy and executive-level opportunity support. Build the team’s skills in customer discovery, research, storytelling, strategic thinking, presentation development, and sales partnership. Measure team impact through pipeline support, meetings created, opportunity outcomes, turnaround time, and seller adoption, not presentation volume alone. Partner Across Marketing & Sales Work closely with the Marketing Manager, Product & Enablement to apply established positioning, messaging, GTM frameworks, proof points, and foundational materials to customer-specific opportunities. Provide feedback from live opportunities to Product & Enablement on recurring customer needs, competitive themes, content gaps, and emerging solution opportunities. Collaborate with Sales, Research, Product, Creative, and other subject-matter experts to assemble the right expertise around priority opportunities. Advocate for earlier Solutions Marketing involvement so the team helps shape recommendations rather than simply package decisions already made. What Success Looks Like Solutions Marketing is viewed by Sales as a strategic partner, not a production resource. Priority pitches and RFP/RFI responses lead with customer problems and insights rather than product capabilities. The team provides differentiated levels of support efficiently across the pipeline. Sellers bring Solutions Marketing into important opportunities earlier in the process. Team support contributes to stronger client conversations, pipeline progression, and revenue outcomes. What You Bring 5+ years of experience in solutions marketing, integrated marketing, media strategy, sales strategy, brand strategy, agency planning, or a related discipline. Demonstrated ability to translate complex business challenges into clear strategic recommendations and compelling narratives. Experience leading RFPs, RFIs, major pitches, or complex client proposals. Strong research, analytical, storytelling, and executive presentation skills. Ability to connect multiple products and capabilities into cohesive customer solutions. Strong commercial instincts and a collaborative, consultative approach to partnering with Sales. People management or demonstrated team leadership experience. Experience in media, advertising, agencies, ad tech, or B2B marketing is a plus. job.title: Specialist, Sales and Marketing
job.description: This Job Description May Cause Extreme Excitement and Career Growth At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we believe a great workplace isn't just something we say — it's something you can feel when you join the team. Here, it's all about great collabs, ambition, and results but most importantly, we grow here, and we enjoy here. We're searching for that special someone — a driven, talented individual to join our innovative media sales team. In this role, you'll engage with new and existing clients and show them how our innovative media solutions can amplify their brands and deliver measurable success. If you're energized by building relationships, closing deals, and making an impact, we'd love to hear from you. Sound like the right fit? Check out the checklist below and if it sounds like you, hit "Apply Now" and let's chat. Your Day-to-Day (aka the Playbook) Help Brands Thrive: Join our media sales team and play a pivotal role in helping brands and companies grow. By identifying new opportunities, building strong client relationships, and delivering impactful solutions, you'll showcase how our multi-media content platforms and digital assets can drive meaningful results for our partners. Your focus will be on helping clients achieve their goals, ensuring that every campaign is a success. When our clients win, we win—and we believe in celebrating those victories together! Make Connections: Embrace your powers of persuasion and make every handshake and meeting count! Every interaction is a chance to build a genuine connection and show clients how we can help them succeed. You're not just selling; you're building partnerships. You're helping businesses find the right audience in the right place at the right time. When we say One Partner, Endless Possibilities, we mean it! Be A Trusted Guide: In this role, you'll connect with clients on a human level, understand their unique needs, and craft tailored sales and marketing solutions that deliver results. As their trusted advisor, you'll help them navigate the ever-evolving marketing landscape, ensuring every step of the journey is planned with care and precision. Shake Things Up: Bring your creativity and fresh ideas to the table! We're looking for someone who challenges the status quo, embraces innovation, and finds new ways to connect with our audience. Your contributions will help elevate our brand and drive meaningful results for your clients. Join us and Conquer the Media Landscape: You'll be part of a dedicated team of A1 media sales professionals, committed to achieving market leadership. Together, we amplify our impact, deliver exceptional outcomes, and help our clients succeed in ways that truly matter. Identify Emerging Opportunities: It's about being able to see what others can't, anticipating market shifts, analyzing data and predicting the next big thing. Your insights will position our clients and AMP for long-term success. What We're Looking For Proven Sales Ability (or an Unstoppable Desire to Learn) Whether you're a seasoned sales professional or just getting started, we value your drive, energy, and passion for achieving results. job.title: Weekend Meteorologist Reporter
job.description: WSYX/WTTE, the market-leading news operation in Central Ohio, is looking for a dynamic Weekend Meteorologist/Reporter to join our award-winning weather team. This isn't just a weekend weather job. We're looking for someone who understands that weather is one of the biggest drivers of audience engagement across television, streaming, digital, social media, and mobile platforms. You'll be responsible for delivering accurate, compelling forecasts while helping our newsroom own severe weather coverage, producing impactful weather-related stories, and reporting on issues that matter to the communities we serve. As part of our commitment to innovation, you'll also have access to Central Ohio's only augmented reality weather presentation system —a market-exclusive forecasting tool that allows our meteorologists to create immersive, visually compelling weathercasts that help viewers better understand the forecast and stay safe during high-impact weather. The ideal candidate is a strong communicator, confident in breaking weather situations, and passionate about serving our communities with clear, informative forecasting and compelling storytelling. What You'll Do Produce and present engaging weathercasts on ABC 6, FOX 28, streaming platforms, and digital channels. Utilize our market-exclusive augmented reality weather system to create innovative, immersive weather presentations that elevate storytelling and viewer understanding. Report from the field on weather events, breaking news, and enterprise stories that impact Central Ohio. Develop original weather-related and environmental stories that go beyond the daily forecast. Collaborate with newsroom leadership to identify and produce enterprise stories where weather intersects with public safety, transportation, infrastructure, health, agriculture, and community life. Deliver calm, confident coverage during severe weather and other high-impact weather events. Create original weather-related content for digital, social, streaming, and mobile platforms every day. Write and update forecasts for our website, mobile apps, and social media. Shoot, write, and edit stories as needed. Explain complex weather in a way that is easy for viewers to understand. Develop graphics that enhance storytelling and improve viewer understanding. Participate in community appearances, station initiatives, and public outreach events. Fill in on weekday newscasts and other shifts as needed. Looking For Someone Who Has exceptional forecasting skills and strong weather judgment. Is a journalist first and understands how weather affects people's daily lives. Thrives during severe weather coverage and can make quick, confident decisions under pressure. Is an engaging storyteller who can connect weather to the communities we serve. Understands today's audience consumes weather across television, streaming, digital, social, and mobile platforms. Can create compelling digital and social content that extends the life of every forecast. Enjoys experimenting with new technology and finding creative ways to enhance the viewer experience. Works collaboratively in a fast-paced, team-oriented newsroom. Brings energy, curiosity, and a positive attitude every day. While applying online, please include a link to your online demo reel. Bachelor's degree in Meteorology, Atmospheric Science, Journalism, or a related field (Meteorology preferred). AMS and/or NWA Seal or Certified Broadcast Meteorologist (CBM) designation preferred, or the ability to obtain. Three years of prior on-air forecasting experience preferred. Experience reporting, shooting, writing, and editing news stories is preferred. Strong knowledge of severe weather forecasting and live television. Experience with weather graphics systems and forecasting technology. Excellent communication, live reporting, and storytelling skills. Ability to work weekends, holidays, and flexible hours during breaking weather coverage. EEO AND INCLUSIVITY: Sinclair is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and a drug free workplace. job.title: A&R Analyst - Sony Music Nashville
job.description:
About Sony Music Entertainment

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we’re committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

As an A&R Analyst with Sony Music Nashville, you will have a central role in supporting our A&R team by providing important insights and data-driven evaluations on both rostered and undiscovered artists.

In this role, you will implement and manage data-driven methods to discover new artists, run daily reports to aid in artist discovery and analysis, construct statistical insights and predictive metrics, conduct research on artists and analyze new music – both signed and unsigned. This role is a unique opportunity to help the company discover our next superstars and help drive data-assisted decision making within the A&R team.

What you'll do:

  • Conduct research to evaluate new music and improve the A&R team’s understanding of new music metrics including social networking sites, data and analytics
  • Extract, prepare, analyze and present relevant music and social activity data to help identify new potential talent while also monitoring the marketplace and constructing new methods to draw insights from this data
  • Develop and implement new analytical processes, technologies and tools for use by the A&R team and other departments in support of trend identification, etc.
  • Regularly meet with A&R team to provide updates on activity and marketplace
  • Generate weekly reports and lead meetings to brief team on artists of interest
  • Work with internal teams as needed to create and troubleshoot queries, dashboards and other identification tools
  • Create artist-specific reports detailing audience growth and consumption relative to similar artists
  • Compile and monitor stream count and social media metrics for unsigned, undiscovered artists
  • Identify and interpret relevant data in the context of the current music landscape
  • Assess and summarize tendencies in consumption source across genres/subgenres
  • Proactively identify additional areas for analysis and identification of new artists
  • Deliver and present large data sets in a useful and meaningful way, by presenting key information across several methods and platforms to the broader Sony leadership team

Who you are:

  • At least two years of music or entertainment industry experience, with a demonstrated track record of using data to find new and emerging talent
  • A passionate new music listener with a strong knowledge of various genres of music with an emphasis on country format and ability to separate/identify commercially viable talent
  • A team player with an understanding of current tastes and trends of the market, preferably with prior experience interacting with recording artists and an understanding of artist lifestyle
  • A self-starter with exceptional communication skills, time management skills and an ability to prioritize and multi-task, work independently and with teammates
  • An independent thinker with strong computer skills including MS Office (Word, Excel & Outlook) and proven internet and data analytics capabilities, as well as a working knowledge of digital music space and social media
  • Available to attend evening showcases as well as ability to travel as needed
  • Knowledge of music monitoring platforms such as Music Connect, Mediabase and Indify

What we give you:

  • You join an inclusive, collaborative and global community where you have the opportunity to channel your passion every day
  • A modern office environment designed to foster productivity, creativity, and teamwork empowering you to bring your best
  • An attractive and comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life & disability coverage, and 401K + employer matching
  • Voluntary benefits like company-paid identity theft protection and resources for pets, mental health and meditation resources, industry-leading fertility coverage, fully paid leave for childbirth or bonding, fully paid leave for caregivers, programs for loved ones with developmental disabilities and neurodiversity, subsidized back-up child and elder care, and reimbursement for adoption, surrogacy, tuition, and student loans
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community.
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt, and create what happens next
  • Time off for a winter recess

Sony Music is committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all persons regardless of age, disability, national origin, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, veteran or military status, marital and civil partnership/union status, alienage or citizenship status, creed, genetic information or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

job.title: A&R Director - RCA China
job.description:
As A&R Director, you will play a pivotal role in initiating, supporting and implementing A&R strategy that incorporates facilitating cooperation with established and new artists who are already or have the chance to be commercially successful, finding the right songs and projects for new and current priority artists and overseeing the ongoing development and recording of all assigned artists. All of the above is not limited to only artists, seeking label partnerships are also a key priority.

What you'll do:

  • Identify developing and established artists for RCA Greater China review and signing, using existing network or resources.
  • Identify developing and established label partners for RCA Greater China cooperation, using existing network or resources.
  • Work closely with MD to manage the short and long term goals of the label.
  • Project Management: Overseeing A&R process and artist engagements, working with the team to cooperate and communicate between artists, producers, teams, suppliers, etc.
  • Responsible A&R daily management including tracking and coordinating the progress and timeline of production projects with the team, integrates the relevant admin works, regularly updates the Release Schedule of RCA label, deliver various reports, updates, and other relevant presentation materials on behalf of the team.
  • Budget tracking and management of procurement, Purchase Order, and invoicing processes
  • Liaising, “brainstorming” and meeting with internal teams to discuss A&R’s strategy.
  • Demonstrate a good ear for music that will help the artist(s) success and be able to identify the singles that will be hits and provide creative feedback.
  • Attend shows and showcases of both signed and unsigned artists on a regular basis.
  • Manage the administrative and deal making process for prospective clients.
  • Work closely with Finance and BLA to formulate deal prospects.
  • Work with MD to set out company priorities and release timelines.
  • Work closely with other label departments/employees including Copyright, Royalty, Artist Management, Marketing & Promotion, Data Analytics, Commercial & Sales, Creative Services, etc.
  • Provide Artist Management support.
  • Special projects (e.g., TFT, SMP interpolation, writing camps, Virtual Artists, Soundtracks etc.).

job.title: Assistant Manager, Digital Business
job.description:
As the Associate Manager, Digital Business you will be managing accounts of digital service providers (music streaming platforms) and digital retail relationships in Hong Kong, and you will develop projects and initiatives that optimize revenue / opportunities for Sony Music’s artists under these accounts.

Essential to this role is a solid understanding of the digital retail landscape as well as a core understanding of the digital services. Equally important is a strong grasp of various different types of repertoires.

You will boast strong business relationships with current digital partners in Hong Kong and will play an integral role in developing partners, gathering, and synthesizing deal requirements to drive win-win outcomes in negotiations and partner development to grow digital revenue, streaming and market share for Hong Kong.

This role also supports physical product management and oversees sales channel coordination to maximize revenue and market presence.

What you will do:

DSP Account Management

• Manage relationships with key DSPs in Hong Kong (e.g. Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube, local/regional platforms).
• Execute release strategies in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders.
• Negotiate and secure promotional opportunities, playlist placement, and marketing support.
• Monitor platform updates, trends, and algorithmic changes to optimize performance.

Strategy & Partnership Development

• Define partnership strategies, build a robust new digital business pipeline, and execute go-to-market plans to achieve market share, revenue, and chart KPI’s in line with company priorities.
• Represent Sony Music’s interests to partners and cultivate strong, meaningful relationships, setting long-term strategies to optimize existing results and revenue/opportunities for Sony Music artists on these accounts.
• Source requirements, design deal parameters, plan the negotiation strategy and execute negotiations with key digital partners in Hong Kong, encompassing both new local partner deals and renewals.
• Manager projects across various activities related to the partner and their platforms. This could include collaboration on content strategies, reporting integration, ongoing analysis of partner performance, problem solving, or driving marketing & promotional initiatives with large streaming accounts to maximize revenue.

Streaming Performance & Analytics

• Track, analyze, and report streaming performance across all platforms.
• Identify growth opportunities and recommend data-driven strategies to improve engagement and revenue.
• Work closely with marketing and A&R teams to optimize campaign execution.

job.title: Associate Director, Audience Development - The Orchard
job.description:
About The Orchard:

The Orchard is a leading global music distributor and Artist & Label services company operating in 50+ markets worldwide. The Orchard empowers creators and businesses to grow and adapt in the dynamic global music industry. We specialize in being artist focused, blending industry expertise and technology, leveraging data to drive success, and providing streamlined digital and physical distribution solutions. The Orchard’s comprehensive artist & label services offerings include marketing, sync licensing, premium video services, transparent data analysis, advertising, rights management, radio promotion, D2C, and more.

The Orchard focuses on providing a comfortable, social, and engaging environment to encourage productivity and creativity.

We are seeking an experienced and innovative Associate Director of Audience Development to join our New York-based Marketing Strategy & Audience Development team. This role will lead the day-to-day strategy and hands-on execution of first-party fan data acquisition campaigns (email & SMS), with a particular focus on building high-intent email and SMS audiences that can be converted into e-commerce merchandise buyers & beyond.

Reporting to the Vice President, Audience Development, this role combines strategic thinking, hands-on campaign execution and data-driven performance optimization. You’ll leverage proprietary technology, paid and organic marketing channels, live events and third-party audience tools to deliver measurable growth for artists and label partners across multiple genres and career stages.

Please note: This is a hands-on role that will occasionally require evening or weekend work to support priority releases & live events.

What you'll do:

  • Office- first role, in office 4 days a week.

First-Party Data Acquisition Strategy

  • Partnering closely with our Marketing Strategists, you’ll lead the day-to-day development and execution of strategies that grow artists’ first-party fan audiences across email & SMS.
  • Use data to identify the right value exchange for each audience, including exclusive content, early merchandise access, contests, ticket presales, live-event activations and other fan experiences.
  • Develop scalable acquisition frameworks & benchmarks that can be adapted across artists, genres, & campaign types.
  • Partner closely with the Associate Director, Fan Engagement & CRM to ensure newly acquired fans enter CRM lifecycle journeys and receive a cohesive experience from initial sign-up through conversion and retention.

Campaign Execution & Optimization

  • Support our Marketing Strategists by owning the end-to-end execution of fan acquisition campaigns, including campaign planning, audience strategy, platform setup, landing pages, sign-up flows, testing, launch and performance reporting.
  • Collaborate with Marketing Strategy & Global Paid Media teams to develop and optimize impactful paid lead-generation campaigns across Meta, TikTok and other relevant platforms.
  • Establish testing frameworks and best practices across landing pages, forms, incentives, messaging and acquisition channels to improve both the volume and quality of acquired fans.

E-Commerce & Revenue Growth

  • Partner with D2C, CRM and Marketing Strategy teams to connect your acquisition campaigns to downstream product discovery, sales conversion and repeat-purchase opportunities.
  • Use transactional and behavioral data to identify the channels, campaigns and fan segments most likely to generate merchandise revenue.
  • Collaborate with the Associate Director, Fan Engagement & CRM to build clear handoff strategies that move newly acquired fans into personalized welcome, nurture and conversion journeys.
  • Collaborate with the Associate Director, Fan Engagement & CRM and Global Paid Media to evaluate acquisition performance beyond initial sign-up volume, using metrics such as cost per acquired fan, subscriber quality, engagement, first-purchase conversion, revenue per acquired fan and return on investment.

Audience Insights, Measurement & Reporting

  • Develop reporting frameworks that connect fan acquisition activity to downstream engagement, streaming, ticketing and e-commerce outcomes.
  • Define campaign KPIs and benchmarks across acquisition channels, markets, artists and campaign types.
  • Analyze fan behavior to identify high-value audience segments, acquisition sources and conversion patterns.
  • Translate performance data into clear, actionable recommendations for internal teams, artists and label partners.
  • Build case studies and best-practice guidance that can help scale successful acquisition strategies across the organization.

Tools, Technology & Innovation

  • Oversee the strategic use of proprietary and third-party audience acquisition tools, landing-page platforms and CRM integrations.
  • Identify opportunities to improve fan sign-up experiences, progressive data collection, audience segmentation, consent management and data enrichment.
  • Partner with Product, Design & Engineering teams to help guide the development of tools and features that improve first-party data acquisition and measurement.
  • Collaborate with Marketing Strategy, Relationship Management, Fan Engagement & CRM, Privacy and Product, Design & Engineering teams to ensure acquisition campaigns comply with global privacy and consent requirements.
  • Support the Vice President, Audience Development in evaluating and testing new fan acquisition technologies, platforms and partners.
  • Monitor emerging audience-development trends within music and across industries such as gaming, sports, television, film and retail.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Education

  • Partner with Relationship Management, Global Paid Media & Growth Strategy, Brand Marketing, Fan Engagement & CRM, D2C e-commerce and Marketing Strategy teams to integrate first-party data acquisition into artist campaigns.
  • Serve as an audience-development thought leader internally and as a trusted advisor to artist and label partners, providing best-practice guidance and data-driven recommendations.
  • Educate internal teams and clients on the role first-party fan data can play in driving long-term audience ownership and commercial growth.
  • Support the Vice President, Audience Development in educating marketers across global markets on acquisition strategies appropriate to their local audiences, platforms, cultures and privacy requirements.
  • Help establish repeatable processes that make audience acquisition a consistent component of priority artist and release campaigns.

Who you are:

  • 5+ years of audience development, digital marketing, fan acquisition, growth marketing or related experience within music, entertainment or another consumer-focused industry, including e-commerce experience.
  • Proven track record of growing first-party email and SMS audiences and connecting that growth to measurable business outcomes.
  • Hands-on experience developing and executing lead-generation campaigns across paid, organic, artist-owned and partner channels.
  • Experience with audience and marketing platforms such as Klaviyo, Laylo, Salesforce, Braze or similar tools, as well as e-commerce platforms like Shopify.
  • Understanding of conversion funnels, landing-page optimization, audience targeting, A/B testing and customer acquisition economics.
  • Deep understanding of first-party data strategy, including value exchange, audience segmentation, consent management and data privacy best practices such as GDPR and CCPA.
  • Strong analytical skills, with experience using dashboards and KPI reporting to evaluate acquisition quality and downstream conversion.
  • Excellent communicator and collaborator who can advise multiple stakeholders and translate complex audience strategies into clear, actionable plans.
  • Comfortable balancing strategic planning with detailed, hands-on campaign execution.
  • Passionate about music, fan behavior, e-commerce and the use of technology to build lasting artist-fan relationships.
  • Intrinsically motivated to find new and exciting ways to identify and acquire music fans, with a curious mindset and a strong desire to test, learn and scale successful approaches.
  • Comfortable working flexible hours when needed to support our partners, live events and high-priority releases.

What we give you:

  • You join an inclusive, collaborative and global community where you have the opportunity to channel your passion every day
  • A modern office environment designed to foster productivity, creativity, and teamwork empowering you to bring your best
  • An attractive and comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life & disability coverage, and 401K + employer matching
  • Voluntary benefits like company-paid identity theft protection and resources for pets, mental health and meditation resources, industry-leading fertility coverage, fully paid leave for childbirth or bonding, fully paid leave for caregivers, programs for loved ones with developmental disabilities and neurodiversity, subsidized back-up child and elder care, and reimbursement for adoption, surrogacy, tuition, and student loans
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community.
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt, and create what happens next
  • Time off for a winter recess

job.description:

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

job.description:
Bei The Orchard ist ab sofort eine Position im Bereich Business and Legal Affairs zu besetzen – an unserem Standort Berlin. Als Volljurist:in unterstützt Du das Tagesgeschäft und die rechtlichen Anforderungen unseres Business- und Legal-Affairs-Teams.

The Orchard ist ein führendes Unternehmen für Musikvertrieb und Artist Services mit Sitz in New York und in 45 Märkten weltweit tätig – im Vertrieb unabhängiger Künstler:innen wie Bad Bunny, Gorillaz und Raye. Mit modernsten Abläufen und einem einzigartigen globalen Team arbeiten wir mit Labels jeder Größe zusammen und machen deren Musik und Videos bei Hunderten von digitalen und physischen Händlern rund um den Globus verfügbar.

Leidenschaft für Musik und die Musikbranche ist ein Muss. Mit Deinem professionellen und souveränen Auftreten baust Du starke Beziehungen zu Kolleg:innen und externen Kund:innen auf und pflegst diese. Dafür schaffen wir ein angenehmes, offenes und inspirierendes Umfeld, das Produktivität und Kreativität fördert.

Das Team von The Orchard trifft sich von Montag bis Donnerstag im Büro. Freitags wird in der Regel im Homeoffice gearbeitet.

Was du tun wirst:

  • Entwerfen, Verhandeln und Finalisieren von Vertriebsverträgen mit Labels und Künstler:innen.

The Architect is our platform strategist and systems thinker: the person who ensures our business systems ecosystem scales cleanly as it grows, while staying close enough to the business to know why it needs to. This role owns the center of excellence: defining the guardrails, patterns, and integration standards that every Business Solutions Specialist builds on, while remaining hands-on and business-facing rather than operating purely as a back-office architect.

What you'll do:

  • Define and evolve platform architecture standards and development guardrails across our core business systems
  • Partner closely with the SVP, Engineering and backend engineering on API and integration architecture
  • Evaluate and help the team adopt adjacent tools (Zapier, Make, n8n, Pipedream, Salesforce, Zendesk, etc.) as workflows expand
  • Provide architectural guidance and escalation support to the Business Solutions Specialists across business units
  • Engage directly with senior stakeholders to understand cross-business-unit operations and the broader ecosystem
  • Own the technical roadmap for platform scalability and maintainability

job.title: Catalogue Growth & Commercial Manager
job.description:
The Senior Executive / Manager, Catalogue Growth & Commercialization plays a hybrid role across catalogue operations and commercial growth for Sony Music Entertainment Malaysia. This role is responsible for backend catalogue ingestion, optimization and M&A-related due diligence support, while also driving opportunities across D2C, website, AVOD monetization, SEO, analytics and DSP/platform optimization. Success in this role means ensuring catalogue assets are operationally ready, commercially optimized and positioned to maximize long-tail audience growth and revenue.

What you'll do:

  • Works independently as well as closely with various departments within Malaysia, the Asia Pacific region and external partners to support both Catalogue/Ops and Commercial Growth priorities.
  • Manages backend catalogue ingestion, optimization and digital supply chain workflows for acquired, legacy and M&A-related assets, covering product registration, metadata validation, delivery, scheduling, quality control, digitisation and operational readiness across DSPs, video platforms and partner services.
  • Supports M&A evaluation and due diligence by reviewing sales and performance reports, validating catalogue data and coordinating asset submission requirements for potential acquisition opportunities, including audio, video, metadata, artwork, rights documentation and related historical materials where applicable.
  • Supports Sony Music Malaysia’s commercial growth initiatives across D2C and e-commerce for artist merchandise and physical products, website upkeep and optimisation, AVOD and channel monetisation, and wider catalogue commercialisation opportunities.
  • Analyses and optimizes performance across Spotify, YouTube, YouTube Music, AVOD and other partner services by improving metadata, release setup, content packaging, channel hygiene, discoverability and audience signals to strengthen algorithmic performance, engagement and revenue.
  • Tracks and reports catalogue, website, D2C and partner platform performance, supports SEO and discoverability improvements, and identifies actionable optimization opportunities to improve long-tail catalogue value and monetisation outcomes.
  • Assists the team in solving operational and platform issues when required, including metadata mismatches, DSP mapping issues, delivery issues, rights conflicts, YouTube blockage issues and other backend or optimization-related matters.

Who you are:

  • Bachelor’s degree in music business, digital business, marketing, e-commerce, media, analytics, business management or any related field is preferred.
  • At least 4-6 years of relevant work experience for Senior Executive level, or stronger experience for Manager level, across digital operations, catalogue management, digital marketing, e-commerce, analytics, SEO, AVOD or related commercial digital functions.
  • Strong understanding of digital music and video ecosystems, DSP servicing, metadata, platform workflows and catalogue optimization; familiarity with D2C, website management, SEO and analytics is an added advantage.
  • Able to review and interpret sales and performance data, with an understanding of discoverability drivers, partner platform best practices and optimization levers across Spotify, YouTube, YouTube Music, AVOD and similar services.
  • Extremely detail-oriented and organized, capable of managing multiple workflows and timelines, while being proactive, commercially aware, adaptable and confident working cross-functionally in a fast-moving environment.

What we give you:

  • You join an inclusive, collaborative, and global community where you have the opportunity to fuel the creative journey
  • A modern office environment designed to foster productivity, creativity, and teamwork
  • Industry leading benefits across the board to all employees – from discounts on private health insurance and Sony products, to progressive wellbeing services including an award winning EAP and complimentary subscriptions to apps, telehealth, salary packaging for novated car leases, and life insurance and income protection… and of course, many music biz perks
  • We invest in your professional growth & development

Equal Opportunities

As an active part of a culturally and socially diverse society, Sony Music’s aim is that our workforce is diverse and inclusive. Sony Music is an equal opportunity employer and supports workforce diversity.

We employ, retain, promote and otherwise treat all employees and job applicants according to their merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We apply this policy without regard to any individual’s sex, race, religion, origin, age, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition or disability.

Privacy Policy

Please click here to read our privacy policy before beginning the application process as you will need to agree to the terms of the policy before submitting your information.

job.title: College Marketing Representative, Atlanta - The Orchard
job.description:
About The Orchard

The Orchard is a leading full-service music distribution company operating in 48 markets worldwide and servicing top global independent artists and labels. With cutting-edge operations and an unparalleled global team, The Orchard partners with clients to provide full scale solutions across a variety of verticals. Championed by an exceptional community of music lovers and experts, The Orchard empowers creators to grow and evolve in the dynamic, global industry.

The Orchard focuses on providing a comfortable, social, and engaging environment to encourage productivity and creativity.

As a paid part‑time employee of The Orchard, you’ll serve as a key advocate for the artists we distribute. Each month, you’ll promote 10–20 artists through a mix of digital and in‑person marketing across your campus and college town. You’ll be a tastemaker in your community, collaborating with student organizations, local businesses, record stores, DJs, promoters, and more to build meaningful visibility for new releases and touring artists across a wide range of genres.

In this role, you’ll lead listening events, organize campus activations, and create social media content that directly supports our artists. You’ll gain hands-on experience in music marketing while staying ahead of the curve on emerging talent and new music, all while shaping how students in your market discover and engage with The Orchard’s roster.

What you'll do:

  • Organically create awareness of The Orchard’s artists by cultivating authentic relationships with key campus and local influencers including college radio, student organizations, newspapers, and community media to unlock opportunities for reviews, radio plays, interviews, and standout exposure.
  • Maintain a local social media presence that promotes the artists you’ll be working with, utilizing a mix of digital assets that are supplied to you and creating your own content to support The Orchard’s artists
  • Implement in-person marketing initiatives at record stores, lifestyle shops, and on campus
  • Research appropriate online sites, forums, and networks for the key 18-24yr old demographic for each artist
  • Research & attend local and campus events that will best facilitate the promotion of our artists
  • Attend our artists' shows to hand out promotional tools and get feedback from fans
  • Submit a detailed report on your marketing successes and initiatives for each campaign you run

Perks:

  • You will gain real world music industry experience that will be a great addition to your resume
  • You have the opportunity to express your creativity through your locally run social channels, in our team brainstorms, and in your concert/album reviews
  • You’ll have access to inside information that will improve your marketing outreach
  • You’ll receive free ticket(s) into our artists’ shows & possible meet and greet passes
  • You’ll build valuable relationships within your local music industry
  • + many more!

Who you are:

  • You are an Undergraduate Student currently enrolled in a 4 year university in Atlanta with a minimum of 2 years left prior to graduation
  • You are able to manage your own hours and be accountable for the work assigned to you
  • You have a passion for music, an understanding of how your peers discover and consume music, and a deep interest in music business & marketing
  • You have an understanding of social media marketing, you stay current on trends, and you have an active presence creating content on TikTok, Instagram, X, and YouTube
  • You have availability of 20 hours per week
  • You’re well-written, well-spoken, a team player, and an excellent communicator
  • You have transportation methods and live within 30 minutes of Atlanta
  • You have a flexible schedule for team conference calls and tour coverage

What We Give You

  • You join an inclusive, collaborative and global community where you have the opportunity to channel your passion every day
  • A modern office environment designed to foster productivity, creativity, and teamwork empowering you to bring your best
  • Opportunities to connect with our valuable resources, such as our Counsel of Equity & Progressive Action (CEPA), a group created by our employees tasked with developing and implementing innovative solutions to advance a globally-shared goal of ensuring fair and inclusive spaces for all
  • An attractive and comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life & disability coverage, and 401K + employer matching
  • Voluntary benefits like company-paid identity theft protection and resources for pets, mental health and meditation resources, industry-leading fertility coverage, fully paid leave for childbirth or bonding, fully paid leave for caregivers, programs for loved ones with developmental disabilities and neurodiversity, subsidized back-up child and elder care, and reimbursement for adoption, surrogacy, tuition, and student loans
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community.
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt, and create what happens next
  • Time off for a winter recess

The Orchard is committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all persons regardless of age, disability, national origin, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, veteran or military status, marital and civil partnership/union status, alienage or citizenship status, creed, genetic information or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

job.description:

Ability to translate business requirements into functional specifications and work effectively with cross-functional teams.

job.title: Coordinador, PX & Manejo Oficina, Costa Rica
job.description:
El Coordinador de Experiencia de las Personas (PX) y de Oficina (Consultor) proporcionará apoyo esencial al Socio Comercial de PX y al Presidente CAC en general en la gestión de diversos procesos relacionados con las personas y la administración de la oficina. Este rol se centra en asistir en la gestión del ciclo de vida del empleado desde la incorporación hasta la salida, el desarrollo del desempeño, las iniciativas de compromiso y el cumplimiento de las políticas de PX y la legislación laboral local, asegurando un entorno de trabajo positivo y colaborativo.

El rol contribuye a asegurar una experiencia consistente, justa y de calidad, impulsando el engagement, el desempeño, el desarrollo y la efectividad organizativa mediante prácticas centradas en las personas y basadas en datos.

Lo que haras:

  • Apoyo de Business Partnering
    • Actuar como primer punto de contacto (con supervisión) para consultas de gerentes y empleados/as dentro de su perímetro.
    • Dar soporte al/la PX Business Partner en el día a día de temas de personas, asegurando consistencia con políticas internas y prácticas laborales locales.
  • Ciclo de vida del empleado/a
    • Apoyar procesos de onboarding, seguimiento de periodo de prueba, movilidad interna y offboarding.
    • Coordinar y hacer seguimiento de hitos clave del ciclo de vida, garantizando una experiencia positiva y documentación en tiempo y forma.
    • Apoyar los procesos de incorporación, el seguimiento del período de prueba, la movilidad interna y las actividades de desvinculación.
    • Coordinar y hacer seguimiento de los hitos clave en el ciclo de vida del empleado, asegurando una documentación oportuna y una experiencia positiva para los empleados.
  • Desempeño y desarrollo
    • Apoyar los ciclos de desempeño (objetivos, seguimiento, evaluación): comunicación, coordinación de tiempos, soporte en herramientas y reporting.
    • Colaborar con el Socio de Negocios de PX para identificar necesidades de capacitación y coordinar acciones con The Learning Curator, Latin-Iberia o proveedores externos.
    • Asistir en el apoyo logístico para los ciclos de desempeño, incluyendo la programación de evaluaciones y el seguimiento de plazos.
  • Engagement y cultura
    • Liderar iniciativas de engagement y cultura, colaborando con y apoyando a los comités internos (p. ej., Comité de Cultura) y Comunicación.
    • Contribuir a la planificación y ejecución de acciones de experiencia alineadas con los valores de la compañía (GPP).
  • Procesos y políticas de People
    • Apoyar el despliegue de políticas, guías y actualizaciones de procesos; ayudar a que los managers comprendan y apliquen los criterios.
    • Mantener documentación de procesos y FAQs; proponer mejoras a partir de dudas recurrentes y feedback.
  • Datos y reporting
    • Recopilar y dar seguimiento a métricas de personas (movimientos de plantilla, ausencias, completitud de ciclos, acciones de engagement, etc.) bajo la guía del Socio de Negocios de PX.
    • Preparar reportes básicos e insights para el PXBP/PX Leadership; asegurar la calidad del dato en sistemas de RR. HH.
  • Relaciones laborales / Employee Relations (rol de apoyo)
    • Apoyar la gestión administrativa de casos (registro, documentación, seguimiento) o cualquier problema de gestión de rendimiento, bajo la guía del PXBP o equipo de People Relations.
    • Coordinar reuniones, comunicaciones y próximos pasos, manteniendo confidencialidad y cumplimiento normativo.
    • Apoyo en proyectos especiales ad hoc y en la administración según sea necesario.
  • Manejo de Oficina
    • Actuar como punto de contacto principal con el propietario del inmueble en relación con todos los asuntos pertinentes a la oficina.
    • Manejar contratos con proveedores, reparaciones y cumplimiento de normativas operacionales de la oficina.
    • Supervisar y coordinar la empresa de limpieza, asegurando el mantenimiento y limpieza general de la oficina, así como gestionar y dar seguimiento a los proveedores externos responsables de servicios y mantenimiento de la oficina.
    • Gestionar el envío y la recepción de correspondencia y paquetería, asegurando su correcta distribución y registro cuando sea necesario.

Quien eres:

  • 3 – 4 años de experiencia en RR. HH., People, Talent, People Ops o funciones similares.
  • Conocimiento intermedio de procesos de RR. HH.: ciclo de vida, desempeño, formación y reporting.
  • Capacidad para manejar información confidencial con rigor y discreción.
  • Organización y seguimiento: gestión de múltiples tareas, cumplimiento de plazos y control documental.
  • Orientación a datos: manejo de Excel/Google Sheets y capacidad de elaborar reportes básicos.
  • Comunicación clara y efectiva (oral y escrita) y capacidad para interactuar con distintos niveles de la organización.
  • Nivel de inglés: Fluidez en inglés (oral y escrita) requerida
  • Empatía y orientación a las personas; capacidad de escucha activa.
  • Proactividad y mentalidad de mejora continua.
  • Atención al detalle y sentido de la responsabilidad.
  • Capacidad para trabajar en equipo y colaborar en entornos cambiantes.
  • Resiliencia y buena gestión de la presión en periodos de alta actividad (ciclos, cambios, picos).
  • Mentalidad de servicio: buscar soluciones y facilitar el trabajo de managers y equipos.

Lo que te ofrezemos:

  • Un contrato temporal
  • Unirte a una comunidad inclusiva, colaborativa y global donde puedes canalizar tu pasión todos los días.
  • Un entorno de oficina moderno diseñado para fomentar la productividad, la creatividad y el trabajo en equipo, empoderándote para dar lo mejor de ti.
  • Inversión en tu crecimiento y desarrollo profesional, permitiéndote prosperar en nuestra comunidad vibrante.
  • Espacio para acelerar el progreso, generar impacto positivo y crear lo que viene después.
  • Una plataforma para impulsar el cambio positivo, con oportunidades para contribuir a nuestras iniciativas de impacto social, diversidad, equidad e inclusión

job.title: Director (m/w/d) Corporate M&A - Business & Legal Affairs
job.description:
Vollzeit, ab 01.08.2026, unbefristet, Standort Berlin

Du begeisterst Dich für die Entwicklung der Musikindustrie und bist neugierig auf die Bedeutung von strategischen Investitionen und Unternehmenskäufen bei der Gestaltung der Zukunft? Verfügst Du über ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten, einen scharfen Blick für Details und die Fähigkeit, über den Tellerrand zu schauen?

Deine Aufgaben

  • Unterstützung der Teams in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz bei allen Aspekten regionaler M&A-Transaktionen, strategischer Investitionen, Joint Ventures, Veräußerungen und ähnlicher Transaktionen im Unternehmen.
  • Entwurf, Verhandlung und Abschluss einer breiten Palette von Verträgen im M&A Bereich, darunter Mandatsvereinbarungen, Genehmigungsvorlagen, Geheimhaltungsvereinbarungen und Term Sheets sowie Joint-Venture-Vereinbarungen und Firmenbeteiligungs- und Kaufverträge (Share- und Asset Deals).
  • Steuerung und Management der Due Diligence-Prüfung, Erkennen und Bewerten (rechtlicher) Risiken, Koordination interner Stakeholder und Genehmigungsprozesse sowie die Anleitung externer Kanzleien und sonstiger Berater.
  • Leitung funktionsübergreifender Arbeitsabläufe in Zusammenarbeit mit den Bereichen Finance, Ventures & Investments, Steuern, Personal, Operations und anderen internen Partnern während des gesamten Life Cycles der jeweiligen Transaktion.
  • Allgemeine rechtliche Beratung in Bezug auf und Steuerung von Governance-Fragen und andere Themen im Zusammenhang mit vergangenen und aktuellen Transaktionen.
  • Optimierung von Transaktionsprozessen durch Beratung zu Best Practices, Entwicklung skalierbarer Verfahren und Förderung kontinuierlicher Verbesserungen bei Due-Diligence- und Ausführungsabläufen.

Wer du bist

  • Volljurist*in nach deutschem Recht (erstes und zweites Staatsexamen)
  • Mindestens 3 Jahre relevante Erfahrung in einer größeren Wirtschaftskanzlei, idealerweise mit substanzieller Verantwortung in M&A-Transaktionen
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse im deutschen Handels- und Gesellschaftsrecht
  • Starke Verhandlungsfähigkeit und ein präziser Umgang mit Sprache – auch bei komplexen Sachverhalten
  • Ausgeprägtes Kommunikations- und Analysevermögen sowie die Fähigkeit, rechtliche Themen verständlich und adressatengerecht zu vermitteln
  • Teamplayer mit ausgeprägtem Servicegedanken und dem Anspruch, gemeinsam erfolgreiche Transaktionen umzusetzen
  • Souveräner Umgang mit mehreren Prioritäten in einem dynamischen Umfeld, gepaart mit hoher Genauigkeit und fundiertem Urteilsvermögen
  • Flexibel und offen, auch über M&A hinaus bei allgemeinen rechtlichen Fragestellungen zu unterstützen, je nach geschäftlichem Bedarf

Wir bieten dir

  • Raum für Vielfalt und für Innovation. Die Freiheit, Prozesse und Methoden zu challengen und zu revolutionieren.
  • Individuelle Benefits-Pakete kombinierbar aus ÖPNV-Zuschuss, Job-Rad und einem Sport-Abo.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Homeoffice.
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge. Ein Streaming-Abo deiner Wahl.
  • Sowie Konzerte und Events in ganz Deutschland und in unserem schicken Headquarter mitten in Schöneberg.
  • Exklusive Trainings in der hauseigenen Academy.
  • Sowie das Vertrauen, deine Projekte in Eigenregie zum Erfolg zu führen.

Wie du dich bewirbst

Dein Foto, Alter, Familienstand, deine Herkunft, Zeugnisse, die Jobs deiner Eltern und andere Merkmale benötigen wir nicht.

Zeige uns in einem CV oder einer anderen kreativen Form, was dich ausmacht, was du kannst und warum Sony Music mit dir besser klingt!

Wir freuen uns auf dich.
