job.title: Product Manager, Royalty Share - PDEGO
job.description:
About Sony Music Entertainment

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we're committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

Sony Music's Product, Design, Engineering & Global Operations (PDEGO) team is looking for a Product Manager to join our RoyaltyShare product team in our London office. You'll help shape the future of the platforms that power one of Sony Music's most critical business capabilities—processing, calculating, and distributing royalties to artists, songwriters, publishers, and partners around the world.

Working closely with Engineering, Product Design, Finance, Royalty Operations, and business stakeholders, you'll help modernize complex workflows, simplify business processes, and deliver scalable product solutions that improve accuracy, efficiency, and transparency across our royalty ecosystem.

What you'll do:

● Partner with Engineering and Design to define and deliver the product roadmap for Sony Music's RoyaltyShare platform
● Translate complex business, financial, and operational requirements into clear product requirements and user stories
● Own and prioritize the product backlog, balancing business value, technical complexity, and platform health
● Lead Agile ceremonies and work closely with engineering teams throughout the product development lifecycle
● Build strong relationships with stakeholders across Royalty Operations, Finance, Product, and Engineering to understand pain points and identify opportunities for improvement
● Gather user feedback and operational insights to continuously refine product direction
● Help define success metrics and monitor product performance using quantitative and qualitative KPIs
● Participate in product releases, rollout planning, change management, and adoption activities
● Clearly communicate priorities, roadmap updates, and product decisions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
● Support the modernization of legacy royalty systems through incremental product improvements and platform enhancements

Who you are:

● 5-7+ years of Product Management experience delivering complex software products, preferably enterprise or internal platforms
● Experience managing products from discovery through delivery and ongoing iteration
● Strong experience working closely with engineering teams in Agile environments
● Excellent prioritization skills with the ability to balance customer needs, technical constraints, and business priorities
● Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with experience using data to inform product decisions
● Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts for business audiences
● Experience creating product documentation including user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and roadmap documentation
● Experience collaborating across multiple stakeholder groups to build alignment and drive execution
● Comfortable working with technical teams and understanding system architecture, APIs, and software development concepts
● Interest in learning the complexities of music royalty accounting and rights management

The ideal candidate

● Experience building enterprise SaaS, financial systems, ERP platforms, accounting software, or other workflow-driven applications
● Experience working with complex business domains involving financial transactions, payments, or large-scale operational processes
● Familiarity with data platforms and modern data technologies such as Snowflake, SQL, or analytics tools
● Experience with platform modernization or legacy system transformation initiatives
● Experience defining KPIs and measuring operational improvements through product analytics
● Strong understanding of workflow optimization, process automation, and operational efficiency
● Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional teams without direct authority
● Experience working with global stakeholders across multiple regions and time zones

What you'll do as a Royalties Accountant:

  • Prepare, review and analyze capitalized balances, associated royalty payables, recoupable recording and marketing costs, for reasonableness and proper accounting treatment. Prepare label talent provision and marketing recovery journal entries
  • Review foreign royalty expense and prepare monthly accrual vs. actual analysis, intercompany reconciliations and associated journal entries
  • Perform various balance sheet account analysis related to artist, copyright, union and foreign royalties to substantiate balances and clear reconciling items. This includes any royalty system to general ledger reconciliations

  • Special projects/other duties as assigned by management
  • Review and improve internal controls where applicable

Royalty Contract Interpretation and Coding:

  • Read the artist, producer, and/or third-party contract to obtain relevant information.
  • Interpret contractual clauses related to the royalty obligation, including understanding the legal definitions of terms used within the contracts or related documents.
  • Coordinate with Label’s legal and business affairs staff to obtain missing information.
  • Set up and maintain accurate contractual information within the royalty system

Royalty Statement Review:

  • Prepare the appropriate accounting statements as contractually required,
  • Review sales and costs to ensure they are accurately stated.
  • Update and analyze unrecouped balance analysis at account level.
  • Prepare and research variance-reporting analysis to understand fluctuations with balances and payments.

Sales & Suspense Management:

  • Review the new release schedule and work with the affiliate personal to ensure new releases are coded within the appropriate timeframe.
  • Run sales query and reviewing results with Manager.
  • Prepare and review suspense reports and provide reports to affiliate on a weekly basis.

Inquiries & Special Projects:

  • Serve as Point of Contact for various internal and external inquiries related to assigned accounts.
  • Provide Manager with status reports regarding the assigned artist accounts.
  • Provide guidance to the entry-level staff members including providing an overview of tools available to assist in the completion of the assigned tasks.
  • Assist in process design improvements focused on enhancing quality while reducing resource requirements.

  • Relevant work experience
  • Strong proficiency in Word, Excel (Pivot tables & VLOOKUP) and Outlook; SAP, EROS, and JIRA experience a plus
  • Detail oriented individual with strong organizational and leadership skills that can handle multiple tasks simultaneously
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and ability to interact well with different levels within the organization.

job.title: Senior Business Solutions Specialist - PDEGO
job.description:
About Sony Music Entertainment

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we’re committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

About Business Solutions

Business Solutions partners with our label, marketing, and release planning teams to build the tools and workflows that help them run more effectively. We operate as a trusted internal partner, not an order-taking function. Our work is guided by three principles: Fail Fast: test ideas quickly, and don't let perfection get in the way of progress; Learn Quickly: treat every iteration as a chance to learn, document, and adapt; and Move Forward: keep the work, and the people we support, moving.

Role Summary

The Senior Business Solutions Specialist is the trusted day-to-day partner for a dedicated portfolio of business units spanning US and international markets, owning the full solution lifecycle from discovery through delivery, while mentoring the broader NYC Specialist team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for your assigned business units
  • Run discovery, scoping, and requirements-gathering sessions independently
  • Build and maintain business systems, automations, and workflows supporting label, marketing, and release operations
  • Write specs and requirements for integrations with internal Sony Music systems
  • Lead data migrations for assigned business units
  • Test solutions with end users and incorporate feedback quickly

job.description:

The ideal candidate will bring deep accounting expertise, strong operational discipline, and exceptional analytical and financial modeling skills.

In the near term, this person, in coordination with SME central teams, will provide hands-on leadership to strengthen accounting practices, including intercompany accounting, financial operations, and metadata management, to ensure accurate and comprehensive reporting. The Senior Director of Finance & Accounting will also be responsible for the monthly close and forecast, as well as the annual budgeting process. As part of a small, flat team supported by the wider Sony Music Finance, Accounting, and IT infrastructure, this person will touch virtually every aspect of label finance and accounting. The role requires someone who navigate a complex organizational structure and bring the technical accounting expertise the group needs. This will require taking ownership of detailed project management and process design and execution. Through this work, the Senior Director of Finance will build the experience and perspective needed to grow into a future CFO-level leader for the organization.

  • Lead accounting setup, cleanup, and ongoing financial control processes across Alamo, Santa Anna, Foundation, OVO, and related ventures, with particular focus on entity structure, intercompany accounting, eliminations, reconciliations, and balance sheet integrity.
  • Strengthen accounting controls, workflows, and ownership across recurring close, reporting, intercompany, and operational finance processes.
  • Oversee monthly close, management reporting, variance analysis, balance sheet reviews, and corporate deliverables, ensuring results are accurate, timely, and clearly explained to senior management and SME stakeholders.
  • Manage annual budgeting, monthly forecasting, and long-range planning across labels, joint ventures, acquisitions, and new business initiatives, connecting financial plans to operating priorities, deal terms, and profitability targets.
  • Partner with SME central teams, including Accounting, Global Finance, Tax, Royalties, JV Accounting, Metadata, and technology partners, to improve financial operations, data quality, metadata workflows, systems integration, and reporting consistency across a complex organizational structure.
  • Support deal analysis, artist and label investment decisions, catalog and acquisition opportunities, royalty and recoupment analysis, and new venture business plans, ensuring financial assumptions align with contractual terms and operational realities.
  • Act as a senior finance business partner to label leadership and department team members across business units to help drive revenue growth, profitability, cash discipline, and operating efficiency all the business.
  • Serve as a reliable #2 to the CFO, leading detailed project management, integration efforts, process improvement initiatives, and other high-priority finance projects as a hands-on operator and strategic finance leader.

  • 10+ years of progressive finance and accounting experience, ideally within music, media, entertainment, or another complex multi-entity environment.
  • CPA strongly preferred; MBA a plus.
  • Passionate about music, media, and entertainment.
  • Deep technical accounting foundation, including a strong understanding of month-end close processes, balance sheet reconciliations, accruals, eliminations, and intercompany accounting across multiple legal entities.
  • Strong financial planning, forecasting, modeling, and analysis skills, with the ability to translate detailed financial data and analysis into clear recommendations for senior leaders.
  • Sophisticated Excel skills, with the ability to analyze and interpret large data sets.
  • Analytical mindset with a natural desire to ask “why,” coupled with the initiative to reimagine and reinvent processes and improve the accuracy of reporting and analysis.

job.title: Senior Payroll Manager
job.description:
In this role you will be an integral member of the Reward function in our People Experience Team, managing three UK payrolls, in addition to smaller European payrolls. Reporting to Director, Global Total Rewards, with a dotted line to the VP, Payroll, you will be the subject matter expert for payroll, working closely with the wider generalist teams and finance teams to ensure data is accurately inputted, processed, approved and reported on a monthly and annual basis. You will be responsible for the relationship with our external payroll provider as well as leading on all payroll projects.

This role requires a start date of 25th September 2026. Hybrid working options are available

What you'll do:

Payroll Strategy and Vendor Management

  • Responsible for leading and delivering payroll projects for the region, including but not limited to, the implementation of new payrolls
  • Act as a payroll expert resource for the region, advising on best practice to increase payroll efficiency and effectiveness, implementing regional payroll governance with common practices and SLAs
  • Work closely with the global PX systems team to identify opportunities for automation and integration with the HCM
  • Manage the relationship with the external payroll provider for the payrolls actively managed, holding them to strict deadlines and monitoring them to ensure adherence to agreed SLAs

Payroll Processing

  • Ensure timely and accurate payroll execution. Working closely with the wider PX generalist and Finance teams, ensuring data is accurately inputted, processed, approved and reported each pay period. Ensuring all third-party payments are made on time to relevant bodies. You will be the main point of contact for all payroll related activity and employee queries.
  • Manage year end processes (P60, P11D, ERs, Director Emoluments): devise process plan, manage collation of all relevant data and undertake relevant checks. Support Finance on PSA reporting.
  • Respond to family-friendly policy queries and pay projection requests that require manual calculation including Parental Leave pay, Shared Parental leave, Sickness, Unpaid leave etc. Support with policy cost projections as required.
  • Responsible for payroll related responses to third-party audits across all UK Business units. You will also conduct regular audits within our own HRIS system to ensure accurate data and ensure reporting remains fit for purpose for the UK.
  • Ensure that all payroll practices comply with applicable country-specific laws and monitor upcoming legislation changes. Implement any changes in conjunction with the payroll provider and notify the business as required.

Who you are:

  • A proven track record in delivering payrolls across multiple European countries to a high standard, including the UK.

Sony Music's product design team has traditionally focused on B2B - internal tools and suite applications used by Sony employees, labels, and artists. This role expands that scope. job.description:

job.description:
About Sony Music Entertainment

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

The Vice President, People Experience (PX) Business Partner, West Coast owns the strategy, leadership and delivery of the PX agenda for our West Coast business units, approx. 350+ employees across the labels and corporate teams anchored in our Los Angeles office. You are the senior PX voice in the market: trusted partner to the CEO, COO and label/BU Presidents, and the leader who turns their business plans into a coherent, best-in-class employee experiences across the full employee journey.

This is a strategy and a delivery role. You set direction in partnership with the Americas and Global PX leadership, and you lead a team of two to three PX Business Partners to execute it. You join the PX Americas leadership team, and help drive our vision: to be recognized as a people-centric company that transforms the music industry and beyond.

What you'll do:

Strategic Business Partnership

•Serve as day-to-day PX partner and trusted advisor to the CEO, COO, and Presidents across your businesses, with oversight of the wider employee experience delivered through your team.

•Set market priorities with each leader, anchored in the business plan and the annual culture survey, and translate them into a clear PX plan across the employee journey.

•Build durable, strong and candid relationships with local leadership and employees; balancing strategic counsel with hands-on support.

•Drive operational improvement in how the business runs: systems, processes, new technology and ways of working, workflow integration, workforce planning, and staffing models, in partnership with the wider Americas PX team and Business Leaders.

•Provide oversight and judgment on employee relations matters with the People Relations team, owning the leadership-facing dimension of sensitive issues.

•Lead with data, analytics and financials to build the business case for change, including quarterly people-data and insight reviews with each leadership team.

•Contribute to M&A activity through PX due diligence and cultural and systems integration, with the VP PX M&A Lead, PX Operations, and Total Rewards.

Operational Leadership & Delivery
•Lead the annual compensation planning and review cycle for each business unit you support, working with COO & finance lead, local PX partners and the compensation team.
•Partner on the annual Business Planning process with the CEO, COO and Finance Lead, setting the people priorities that enable the strategic plan for the year ahead.
•Drive weekly people planning and executive updates on headcount, open roles, employee contracts and people shifts.
•Partner with the PX COEs and local PX partners across the full employee lifecycle, from hiring to exit, including the intern and early career experience for the LA offices.
•Oversee the onboarding experience of all new hires and ensure PXBPs lead it in partnership with PXOps and the People Leader
•Own the annual employee engagement survey process, for your business units, from planning and communications through analysis and action planning with senior leaders.
Culture, Change & Continuous Improvement
•Lead and role-model a strong, label- and business-specific culture through our Global People Promise and Values, one that fuels inclusion, creativity, innovation, and collaboration.
•Drive organizational change and transformation, guiding leaders and employees through the change curve and building teams that are resilient and steady under pressure.
•Think like a business leader. Build deep commercial and industry acumen and adapt PX practices to enable our creator-first approach.
•Advance diversity, accessibility and inclusion at every level with the D&I team and business unit leadership
•Champion The Learning Collective and continuous growth for leaders, LA-based employees, your team and yourself.
•Deliver for the LA office. Work with Finance, Operations, Comms, D&I, Philanthropy, Social Impact & Environment, Facilities, and Business & Legal Affairs to deliver a strong experience for everyone based there, whether or not they sit in your business units.
•Raise engagement. Own employee engagement initiatives that lift performance and satisfaction, and act on what the culture survey and listening data tell you.
•Advance inclusion. In partnership with the D&I team and business-unit leadership, develop and deliver strategies for diversity, accessibility, and inclusion at every level.
Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership
•Lead, coach, and develop your team of 2-3 PX Business Partners (PXBP), with potential matrixed PXBP reports in other markets. Set clear goals, create access and hold a high bar.
•Partner and collaborate with local PXBP leads in different markets across the US and globally. Ensure cultural connections and trusted partnership, in service of the business and employee experience
•Partner with the COEs across Talent Acquisition, People Operations, People Relations, Total Rewards, The Learning Collective, Organization Success, D&I, PX Branding & Projects and Communications.
•Connect the enterprise. Contribute to a highly collaborative US PXBP, Americas, and Global PX team on cross-functional and global projects and initiatives.
•Ensure compliance with local employment law, data-privacy standards, and relevant policies, with particular attention to California requirements.

Who you are:

Required Experience:

•10+ years in HR / People function, including 5+ years as a senior HR business partner to C-suite or equivalent executives, leading and developing a team of HR/PX professionals, including a global distributed or matrixed team.

•You have demonstrated success coaching senior executives as a trusted partner, with the ability to shape, challenge, anticipate needs, speak in business outcomes and influence at the top table.

•You have a track record driving transformative change across culture, organization and business.

job.title: VP, D2C Fan Engagement
job.description:
About Sony Music Entertainment

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we’re committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

Sony Music is seeking a VP, Fan Engagement to join the global Sony Music D2C organization. Reporting directly to the Head of Sony Music D2C, this role will lead the Fan Engagement function within The Greenhouse, Sony Music’s centralized D2C division.

The purpose of this team is to make D2C marketing a constant, evergreen discipline for labels that today focus their effort on the release cycle. It is a central, cross-label team that acts as an extension of label digital marketing and international market execution — providing D2C expertise, filling execution capacity gaps, and building the frameworks that let others work well — while leaving artist narrative and campaign strategy with the label.

This is deliberately a small centre rather than a large production function. Labels resource their own D2C people for their own repertoire; this team supplies the toolkit, standards and process that unlock the value those teams create. Where a label does not yet have that capability, the team carries more of the work early and steps back as the label staffs up. There is no embedded headcount — the team operates as a shared service across labels and territories.

The VP is accountable for the quality and commercial performance of D2C fan engagement across the roster, and for the relationships that make it work: with label marketing, creative and commerce teams, with the international marketing team, and with partners across The Greenhouse. Much of the work is proposing rather than deciding — the label approves throughout — which makes credibility, judgement and influence without authority central to the role.

The role leads a team of five to six spanning creative direction and design systems, design and production, D2C product management, and CRM and lifecycle marketing. The ideal candidate combines strong D2C product instincts, fan marketing expertise, creative sensibility and operational rigour, with a deep understanding of how fans engage with artists, music, merchandise and culture across global markets.

How This Team Operates

  • A small centre, not a production house. Labels resource their own D2C people; this team supplies the toolkit, standards and process that let them create value.
  • Proposes rather than decides. Recommendations are put to the label for approval. The team holds no authority independent of the label, and labels retain final say on every D2C decision.
  • Reuses and refines rather than originates. Artist narrative and campaign concept sit with the label. The team adapts existing creative for D2C — merchandise creative is the one area where it originates.
  • Depth varies by situation. On a frontline release the team is advisory. Between release cycles, on evergreen catalog, it is the primary owner of D2C activity with label approval. On superstar campaigns it is fully engaged alongside label and international teams.
  • Depth also tapers by label. Heavier engagement early where D2C capability is thin, lighter as the label staffs up — every label lands in the same place.
  • Always-on, not campaign-by-campaign. Label marketing works per release; international marketing works per market, per release. This team spans releases and keeps D2C running between them.

What you'll do:

Creative

  • Build the D2C design system — templates, asset taxonomies and scalable creative frameworks that let labels and territories execute high-quality D2C creative at volume across markets.
  • Establish D2C visual and email standards, including motion templates, content hierarchy, build quality and testing practice, with labels supplying artist voice and brand direction.
  • Produce merchandise and D2C product creative that labels do not produce in-house — pack shots, product mockups, banners and bundle imagery.
  • Produce D2C social assets and CRM builds when label teams lack the capacity, and refine or extend existing creative for D2C where core assets are limited.
  • Create pitch decks and D2C creative concepts that help label teams sell campaign ideas internally and to artist teams.
  • Resolve international asset adaptation, where D2C creative differs meaningfully by territory and is today handled late and inconsistently.
  • Supply campaign creative and merchandising direction to the Store Experience team, who build and run the storefronts.

Product

  • Establish the process linking D2C with marketing, sales and merchandising — the coordination gap labels consistently identify as their biggest constraint, where marketing learns of product and release decisions too late to build a proper campaign.
  • Develop D2C product insight across bundles, exclusives, premium formats and drops, proposed to the label for approval.
  • Own D2C pricing and promotional recommendations across markets, with label approval and international input from the commercial strategy team.
  • Run competitor scanning, launch retrospectives and evergreen product ideation, bringing trend and net-new format thinking to label and commerce teams.
  • Build lifecycle and scarcity frameworks — pre-order windows, limited editions, flash drops, live-show tie-ins, gated access and evergreen replenishment.
  • Ensure D2C approaches are globally consistent where scale matters and locally adapted where fan behaviour, language, pricing, territory, chart rules or fulfilment realities require it.
  • Partner with operations on launch readiness, product setup and localisation, and supply demand signals into the forecasting and insights team.

Marketing, CRM & Campaign Operations

  • Train label teams to think D2C natively — what assets are needed, at what cadence, and which products fit which moments.
  • Build the D2C campaign cadence, framework and schedule that keeps label campaigns on track — a named gap where no one currently owns the rhythm of D2C activity across a release.
  • Own domestic D2C CRM and lifecycle marketing across the full fan journey — email, SMS and owned channels — including automated journeys that keep fans engaged between release moments, not only campaign sends.
  • Develop a fan segmentation framework spanning casual fans, active fans and superfans, enabling more personalised communication and experiences across every channel.
  • Build the first-party data strategy that captures fan preferences and behaviours to create richer fan profiles, and own domestic fan acquisition.
  • Provide D2C budget deployment and retargeting guidance, developed with the label.
  • Create D2C paid media best-practice frameworks across Meta, TikTok and Google, with clear guidance on campaign structure, audience strategy and measurement. D2C performance marketing is a distinct discipline from awareness and engagement advertising and is not resourced consistently across labels today.
  • Define flywheel analytics, channel health standards and reporting — tracking acquisition, engagement, retention and monetisation, and how fans move from streaming, social and owned properties into D2C channels.
  • Establish best practice for loyalty and VIP programmes that reward engagement rather than purchase alone, social commerce integrations, and creator and affiliate partnerships — with labels executing against those standards.
  • Advise label teams on preorder strategy, launch timing, segmentation, local market messaging and campaign optimisation, and drive a test-and-learn culture across creative and messaging.
  • Over time, develop predictive audience modelling to identify high-value fans and churn risk, and prepare the design system and asset taxonomy for AI-assisted asset generation.

Partnership & Interlock

  • Serve as the central D2C fan engagement partner to labels, artist teams and territories — including Columbia, RCA, Epic and the UK — and to Ceremony of Roses, The Orchard and merchandise partners.
  • Define and operate the interlock with the international marketing team, who own market localisation and in-territory execution for US repertoire. This role owns the domestic equivalent and sets the global standard; the handoff between the two requires clear, agreed triggers.
  • Work across The Greenhouse with the Store Experience, Business Operations, Commercial Strategy and Customer Satisfaction functions, whose scope adjoins this team’s at multiple points.
  • Build the relationships and credibility to influence without authority across a highly matrixed global organisation.

Who you are:

  • 10+ years across fan engagement, D2C marketing, CRM, eCommerce, merchandising or digital marketing in a high-volume, multi-stakeholder environment; music or entertainment experience strongly preferred.
  • Deep understanding of music fan behaviour, artist marketing, D2C commerce and fan engagement ecosystems.
  • Track record of enabling distributed teams — building playbooks, standards and frameworks that others execute — rather than only running work centrally. Comfortable moving between doing the work and teaching it.
  • Able to operate through influence rather than authority, and to build the trust that makes label teams want to work with a central function.
  • Strong knowledge of lifecycle marketing, CRM platforms, email and SMS execution, segmentation and first-party data strategy. Familiarity with Shopify ecosystems and D2C storefront operations.
  • Practical experience with D2C performance marketing — paid media planning, audience targeting and return on ad spend — or the judgement to build that capability.
  • Strong creative instincts and experience collaborating across design, marketing, merchandising and product functions, with the credibility to work alongside label creative teams.
  • Experience building scalable campaign workflows, design systems and operational best practice in high-volume environments.
  • Global mindset and sensitivity to local market nuance — fan behaviour, pricing, language, cultural context, release priorities, chart rules and fulfilment realities.
  • Passion for music, fandom, culture and evolving consumer experiences.

What we give you:

  • You join an inclusive, collaborative and global community where you have the opportunity to channel your passion every day
  • A modern office environment designed to foster productivity, creativity, and teamwork empowering you to bring your best
  • An attractive and comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life & disability coverage, and 401K + employer matching
  • Voluntary benefits like company-paid identity theft protection and resources for pets, mental health and meditation resources, industry-leading fertility coverage, fully paid leave for childbirth or bonding, fully paid leave for caregivers, programs for loved ones with developmental disabilities and neurodiversity, subsidized back-up child and elder care, and reimbursement for adoption, surrogacy, tuition, and student loans
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community.
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt, and create what happens next
  • Time off for a winter recess

job.description: Digital Client Partner - Programmatic Platforms Location: Ciudad de México, Santa Fe Area: Ad Operations / Digital Sales Reports to: Director de Ad Operations About Role & Team El equipo de Ad Operations trabaja de manera transversal con las áreas de Ventas Digitales, Operaciones, Producto y partners tecnológicos para asegurar la correcta ejecución, optimización y crecimiento de las soluciones publicitarias digitales de TelevisaUnivision. Como Digital Client Partner - Programmatic Platforms , serás un socio estratégico para nuestros clientes y agencias, combinando conocimiento técnico de publicidad programática con una fuerte orientación comercial y de servicio. Tendrás un rol clave en la gestión de campañas, desarrollo de deals programáticos, optimización de resultados y construcción de relaciones de largo plazo con clientes y partners estratégicos. Serás responsable de conectar las necesidades comerciales de clientes y agencias con las capacidades tecnológicas y de inventario de TelevisaUnivision, utilizando plataformas como Amazon DSP y Google DV360 , así como otras soluciones del ecosistema programático. El rol requiere una combinación de visión comercial, conocimiento técnico, capacidad analítica y habilidades de relacionamiento , siendo un punto de conexión entre clientes, agencias, equipos internos y partners tecnológicos. Supervisar la correcta implementación, ejecución y optimización de campañas de acuerdo con los objetivos comerciales y contractuales establecidos. Monitorear KPIs, analizar resultados e identificar oportunidades de optimización para maximizar el rendimiento y ROI de las campañas. Diseñar, crear y gestionar Private Marketplace Deals (PMP) y otras soluciones programáticas personalizadas. Colaborar con equipos internos, agencias y partners tecnológicos para definir parámetros técnicos, audiencias, inventario y estrategias de compra programática. Brindar soporte técnico especializado a agencias y clientes, atendiendo configuraciones, troubleshooting y escalaciones relacionadas con campañas y plataformas. Generar insights y recomendaciones basadas en datos para mejorar el desempeño de las campañas y generar nuevas oportunidades comerciales. Mantener relaciones estratégicas con clientes y agencias de alto valor, participando en business reviews, presentaciones ejecutivas y seguimiento de oportunidades. Coordinar con partners tecnológicos como Amazon, Google y otros DSPs para implementar soluciones, resolver incidencias y mantenerse actualizado sobre nuevas capacidades y cambios de plataforma. Colaborar con las áreas de Ventas Digitales, Marketing, Producto, Operaciones y Administración para asegurar una ejecución integral de las soluciones programáticas. Identificar nuevas oportunidades de negocio y proponer soluciones que incrementen la inversión de clientes en el ecosistema programático de TelevisaUnivision. Tu deberás tener Licenciatura en Marketing, Publicidad, Administración, Comunicación, Ingeniería, Sistemas o carrera afín. +3 años de experiencia en publicidad digital, programática, Ad Operations, ventas digitales, account management o marketing digital. Experiencia en gestión de cuentas y relacionamiento con clientes y agencias de publicidad . Dominio de plataformas programáticas, idealmente Amazon DSP y Google DV360 . Experiencia en creación y gestión de Private Marketplace Deals (PMP) . Conocimiento de conceptos de compra programática como RTB, DSP, SSP, Header Bidding, audiencias e inventario digital . Experiencia en análisis y optimización de campañas digitales con base en KPIs. Conocimiento de métricas y estándares de publicidad digital como viewability, brand safety, conversiones y rendimiento de campañas . Capacidad para realizar troubleshooting y resolver problemas relacionados con la implementación de campañas digitales. Inglés B1-B2 . Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y relacionamiento con clientes y stakeholders internos. Pensamiento estratégico y orientación a resultados comerciales. Capacidad para explicar conceptos técnicos de manera clara a audiencias no técnicas. Proactividad, orientación al cliente y capacidad para trabajar con múltiples equipos. Habilidad para construir relaciones comerciales de largo plazo y detectar oportunidades de crecimiento. Capacidad de liderazgo e influencia sin autoridad formal. Será un plus si tienes Certificaciones de Google Ads / Google Ad Manager u otras plataformas digitales. Experiencia con Facebook/Meta Ads . Conocimiento de herramientas de analítica y visualización como Google Analytics, Looker, Looker Studio o Tableau . Conocimientos de SQL . Experiencia con DMP, CDP u otras tecnologías de gestión de datos. Conocimiento del ecosistema de medios digitales y streaming. Experiencia trabajando directamente con publishers, plataformas tecnológicas o empresas de medios. Benefits Ser parte de un equipo que está transformando el ecosistema de publicidad digital y programática. Exposición a clientes, agencias y partners tecnológicos estratégicos. job.title: HR Project Manager Co-Op-Temp
job.description: ABOUT THE ROLE & TEAM: TelevisaUnivision is looking for a HR Project Manager to join our team. ABOUT YOU: You are a highly organized and strategic project manager who thrives on bringing structure, visibility, and accountability to complex HR initiatives. You excel at managing multiple projects simultaneously, balancing competing priorities, and partnering with stakeholders across Human Resources, Technology, Finance, and the business to deliver meaningful outcomes. You have a passion for continuous improvement and enjoy building governance, creating transparency, and helping leaders make informed prioritization decisions. You are proactive, detail-oriented, and capable of transforming ideas into well-executed projects while ensuring alignment with organizational strategy and available capacity. YOUR DAY-TO-DAY: (aka Responsibilities) · Establish and continuously enhance the HR Project Management Office (PMO) framework, governance, and project delivery methodology, including standardized processes for project intake, prioritization, planning, execution, implementation, and post-launch support. · Coordinate and administer the HR Portfolio Management process, including project intake, prioritization, roadmap management, governance, status reporting, and executive communications. · Partner with HR Centers of Excellence, HR Business Partners, IT, Finance, Legal, Payroll, and business stakeholders to define project scope, business requirements, timelines, dependencies, and success measures. · Facilitate portfolio governance meetings, maintain project documentation, and provide regular updates on project health, risks, issues, milestones, and resource capacity. · Monitor project progress, proactively identify risks and dependencies, and develop mitigation plans to ensure successful delivery. · Develop and maintain portfolio dashboards, project metrics, and executive reporting that provide visibility into delivery status, resource utilization, business value, and strategic alignment. · Support business case development by evaluating project requests for business impact, effort, complexity, risk, regulatory requirements, and organizational readiness. · Drive continuous improvement of HR project management methodologies, governance frameworks, templates, and operational processes. · Coordinate testing, change management, communications, training, and deployment activities as needed to support successful project implementation. · Foster strong relationships across HR and business functions, ensuring collaboration, accountability, and alignment throughout the project lifecycle. YOU HAVE: (aka Qualifications) · Experience in project management, preferably supporting Human Resources, HRIS, People Operations, or enterprise transformation initiatives. · Experience managing multiple cross-functional projects within a structured project management or portfolio management environment. · Strong understanding of project management methodologies, including Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid delivery approaches. · Demonstrated experience facilitating governance, prioritization, risk management, stakeholder communications, and executive reporting. · Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail. · Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess business needs and recommend practical solutions. · Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate effectively at all levels of the organization. · Experience working with project management tools such as Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, Jira, Asana, Monday.com, or similar platforms. · Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; experience with reporting and visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker is preferred. · Experience supporting HR technology implementations (such as Workday or other HCM platforms) is strongly preferred. · PMP, CAPM, Agile, or similar project management certification is a plus. · Bilingual English and Spanish skills are preferred. TelevisaUnivision is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to characteristics protected by law.

job.title: Jefe de Administración de Riesgos
job.description: Jefe de Administración de Riesgos Ubicación: Ciudad de México Modalidad: Presencial, San Angel Sobre el rol y el equipo En TelevisaUnivision buscamos incorporar a nuestro equipo a un/a Jefe de Administración de Riesgos , quien tendrá un rol clave en la identificación, evaluación, monitoreo y mitigación de riesgos que puedan impactar la operación y los objetivos del negocio. Formarás parte de un entorno dinámico y multidisciplinario, colaborando con diferentes áreas de la organización y con stakeholders nacionales e internacionales, así como con aseguradoras, brokers y especialistas en gestión de riesgos. Esta posición ofrece exposición a diferentes áreas del negocio y la oportunidad de contribuir al fortalecimiento de una cultura de prevención y gestión de riesgos. Sobre la posición Serás responsable de coordinar y dar seguimiento a la administración de riesgos corporativos , generando análisis e información que permitan identificar escenarios, evaluar posibles impactos y definir acciones de mitigación. Trabajarás de manera transversal con diferentes áreas para dar seguimiento a riesgos, incidentes, seguros y planes de mitigación, proporcionando información y recomendaciones que faciliten la toma de decisiones. Buscamos una persona con pensamiento analítico, sólidos conocimientos cuantitativos y capacidad para transformar información compleja en análisis y recomendaciones claras para el negocio. Sobre ti Buscamos una persona analítica, estructurada y orientada a resultados , con experiencia en Administración de Riesgos, seguros, análisis financiero, estadístico, actuarial o áreas relacionadas. Deberás tener capacidad para analizar información, identificar escenarios de riesgo, evaluar posibles impactos y desarrollar recomendaciones prácticas. También deberás contar con excelentes habilidades de comunicación y relacionamiento, ya que trabajarás de manera transversal con diferentes áreas y stakeholders nacionales e internacionales. Tu día a día Coordinar la identificación, evaluación y monitoreo de riesgos que puedan impactar la operación y los objetivos del negocio. Analizar información financiera, estadística, actuarial y operativa para identificar escenarios de riesgo. Evaluar posibles impactos y dar seguimiento a las estrategias y acciones de mitigación. Elaborar reportes ejecutivos, análisis y presentaciones para facilitar la toma de decisiones. Analizar incidentes y siniestros, identificando causas, impactos y oportunidades de prevención. Administrar y mantener actualizada la documentación relacionada con seguros, siniestros y gestión de riesgos. Coordinar y dar seguimiento a la relación con aseguradoras, brokers y proveedores especializados . Colaborar con áreas como Finanzas, Jurídico, Fiscal, Tesorería, Compras, Recursos Humanos y Operaciones en la identificación y mitigación de riesgos. Participar en la implementación y actualización de políticas, procesos y estrategias de Administración de Riesgos. Investigar tendencias, metodologías y mejores prácticas para fortalecer los procesos de gestión de riesgos. Preparar análisis e información para stakeholders nacionales e internacionales. Facilitar la comunicación y coordinación entre diferentes equipos y áreas. Participar en iniciativas de capacitación y comunicación para fortalecer la cultura de gestión de riesgos . Identificar oportunidades de mejora, automatización y uso de datos para hacer más eficientes los procesos del área. Tú deberás tener Licenciatura en Actuaría, Matemáticas Aplicadas, Economía, Finanzas, Estadística o carrera afín. +3 años de experiencia en Administración de Riesgos, seguros, análisis financiero, estadístico, actuarial o evaluación de riesgos. Experiencia en análisis e interpretación de información financiera y estadística. Conocimiento de modelos estadísticos, probabilísticos y financieros . Conocimiento de evaluación y cuantificación de riesgos. Experiencia en elaboración de reportes ejecutivos y análisis para la toma de decisiones. Inglés avanzado . Excelentes habilidades analíticas, numéricas y de síntesis. Capacidad de organización y planeación. Habilidades de negociación y manejo de stakeholders. Capacidad para identificar problemas, evaluar escenarios y proponer soluciones. Excelentes habilidades de comunicación oral y escrita. Orientación a resultados y atención al detalle. Capacidad para trabajar con equipos multidisciplinarios y multiculturales. Será un plus si tienes Estudios o certificaciones en Administración de Riesgos, Finanzas, Actuaría o Seguros . Experiencia trabajando con aseguradoras y brokers . Experiencia en administración de pólizas y gestión de siniestros. Conocimiento de Data Management y análisis de información. Experiencia con herramientas de análisis y visualización de datos. Conocimientos de Inteligencia Artificial aplicada al análisis de información o automatización de procesos. Experiencia en continuidad de negocio y planes de contingencia. Experiencia previa en empresas multinacionales. Experiencia en industrias de medios, entretenimiento, tecnología o servicios . Lo que encontrarás con nosotros Formar parte de TelevisaUnivision , una empresa global de medios y entretenimiento. Exposición a diferentes áreas del negocio y proyectos multidisciplinarios. Colaboración con equipos nacionales e internacionales. Interacción con especialistas y proveedores relacionados con Administración de Riesgos. Participación en iniciativas orientadas a la prevención, continuidad y protección del negocio. Desarrollo profesional en un entorno dinámico y multicultural. La oportunidad de contribuir a la evolución y fortalecimiento de las prácticas de gestión de riesgos. Univision es un empleador que ofrece equidad e igualdad de oportunidades. job.title: Line Producer
job.description: JOB TITLE: Line Producer LOCATION: Miami ABOUT THE ROLE & TEAM: The Network News team at TelevisaUnivision is looking for a Line Producer to join our team! This is a chance to help shape one of our daily news programs for N+Univision, streaming 24/7 on our hit platform ViX . The Line Producer will be responsible for managing the production of daily shows, supporting the Executive Producer with preproduction and team management — and will also play a role in our special programs, beyond the daily news cycle. This role carries real editorial weight: you won't just be executing a rundown, you'll be shaping it — bringing sharp news judgment, sourcing strong stories, and making the split-second calls that define how our audience experiences the news. ABOUT YOU: If you have strong sharp instincts for breaking news, knowledge of TV production and a genuine passion for journalism, this role is for you. YOUR DAY-TO-DAY: Own the daily rundown — story selection, placement, and editorial direction, with a strong voice in what makes the show and why. Bring sound news judgment to every decision: vetting sources, assessing newsworthiness, and shaping the editorial angle of each story. Execute the timing of live shows from the control room, making confident, last-minute calls under pressure. Work closely with the Associate Producer and/or Graphics Producer on the development and production of daily news graphics. React quickly to breaking news, adjusting the show in real time to keep our coverage first and accurate. Participate in special news programming and coverage, beyond the daily shows, including field coordination. Maintain close communication with the assignment desk, production, and technical crews to keep every show running seamlessly. Back-time shows and adjust rundowns effortlessly while on air. Flexible schedule including weekends and holidays. YOU HAVE: Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Journalism or Communications. Minimum 5 years of experience line producing/producing. Strong news judgment and a deep, current knowledge of the news landscape. Experience with social media platforms. Bilingual in English/Spanish, written and oral. Knowledge of iNews or similar newsroom systems (e.g., Dalet). OUR BENEFITS: TelevisaUnivision believes that a happy, well-balanced employee is what makes our culture thrive. We offer a wide selection of perks and benefits including PTO; tuition reimbursement; wellness and employee support programs; 401K; and life and other insurance plans. This is all in addition to our comprehensive y competitive health benefits package featuring medical, dental and vision coverage options. #LI-ONSITE TelevisaUnivision is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to characteristics protected by law.

job.title: Manager, Digital Content Producer - Streaming
job.description: The Manager, Multimedia Content, Live Video Streaming & Programming will lead TelevisaUnivision Local Media's live video strategy and programming across YouTube, Facebook, TikTok, and emerging platforms. This role will lead a team responsible for live production, digital video, and social content, while overseeing programming strategy, content execution, audience growth, and monetization. The Manager will combine strong editorial judgment, digital expertise, and operational leadership to develop engaging, culturally relevant content that connects with Latino audiences across the U.S. ABOUT YOU: You are a dynamic digital media leader with a passion for live content, audience growth, and innovative storytelling. You thrive in fast-paced environments, know how to turn breaking moments into compelling digital programming, and bring strong editorial judgment and platform expertise. You are a hands-on people leader who can inspire a team, collaborate across functions, and use data and audience insights to continuously improve content and drive results. Experience engaging U.S. Latino audiences and a strong understanding of digital video platforms are highly valued. YOUR DAY-DAY: Strategy, Programming & Team Leadership Lead the Local Media live video and multimedia content strategy, aligning programming with audience growth, engagement, and monetization goals. Lead, mentor, and develop a team of social media editors, video producers, and livestreaming specialists, establishing clear priorities, workflows, and performance expectations. Develop and manage a dynamic programming calendar for digital-first live content and related Video on Demand (VOD) assets, adapting programming to breaking news, cultural moments, and audience interests. Monitor digital video trends, platform developments, audience insights, and competitive activity to continuously evolve programming and content strategy. Partner with editorial, marketing, PR, sales, and other stakeholders to ensure coordinated content execution and cross-platform promotion. Live Content Production & Execution Oversee the production of compelling live programming, including breaking news, interviews, special events, community programming, and other original content. Establish rapid-response workflows and production capabilities to quickly activate live coverage around breaking news and high-priority stories. Ensure content is editorially sound, culturally relevant, visually engaging, and tailored to Latino audiences across the U.S. Build relationships with journalists, newsmakers, creators, and other talent to develop compelling programming and expand audience reach. Audience Growth & Platform Optimization Develop strategies to increase discoverability, viewer retention, engagement, and audience growth across platforms. Optimize titles, descriptions, thumbnails, SEO, metadata, calls-to-action, and other platform-specific elements to maximize performance. Incorporate cross-promotion within live streams through slates, lower-thirds, and calls-to-action that drive audiences to other Local Media content, digital products, and platforms. Establish and maintain community engagement and moderation standards that foster safe, inclusive, and active live audiences. Performance, Analytics & Monetization Establish and monitor key performance indicators, including concurrent viewers, watch time, engagement, audience growth, and monetization. Use performance data and audience insights to make programming decisions and continuously improve content strategy. Partner with video and social teams to maximize the value of live content by repurposing streams into short-form clips, reels, and long-form VOD content. Identify opportunities to increase revenue and monetization through programming, audience growth, partnerships, and platform capabilities. YOU HAVE: Bachelor’s degree in Journalism, Communications, Media, or a related field, or equivalent experience. 5+ years of experience in digital video, live streaming, social media, digital programming, or multimedia content production. Strong knowledge of YouTube, Facebook, TikTok, and other emerging video platforms, including platform-specific best practices. Strong understanding of audience development, content optimization, SEO, algorithms, and social engagement strategies. Experience developing and managing a programming calendar or content grid across multiple platforms. Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven news or media environment, including rapid-response coverage. Strong editorial judgment with the ability to identify compelling, culturally relevant content for Latino audiences. Experience using audience analytics and performance data to make programming and content decisions, including KPIs such as watch time, concurrent viewers, engagement, and audience growth. Excellent communication, organizational, and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and productions simultaneously. Bilingual English/Spanish preferred, with strong understanding of U.S. Hispanic/Latino audiences and cultural trends. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location. Please note the national salary range listed in the job posting reflects the new hire salary range across levels and U.S. locations that would be applicable to the position. This role involves shooting and editing commercials for clients and coaching them during the production process to ensure the best on-camera performance and visual storytelling. Adapt multimedia content for various platforms, including websites, social media, presentations, and live events. Operate professional cameras, lighting, sound equipment, and editing software to produce visually compelling content. Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines effectively. Work closely with the sales team to understand clients' vision and come up with a great concept. Coach clients during the shooting of commercials to enhance their confidence and on-camera presence. Guide clients through the commercial production process, helping them deliver their message effectively. job.title: On Air Personality & Content Creator
job.description: TelevisaUnivision is seeking a creative and engaging On-Air Personality & Digital Content Creator to join one of our premier radio brands. This role combines exceptional on-air performance with digital content creation across broadcast, streaming, podcasts, social media, and live events. The ideal candidate is a storyteller, influencer, and content creator who understands how audiences consume media and can develop compelling, platform-first content that grows engagement and extends the station's brand beyond traditional radio. ABOUT YOU: You are an energetic, interactive, and social media savvy media personality who understands that today's talent represents the station both on and off the air. You are equally comfortable entertaining listeners on the radio, engaging audiences on social media, creating digital first content, and helping shape the sound and strategy of a growing multimedia brand. You embrace emerging technologies and understand how to build meaningful audience connections across broadcast, streaming, podcasts, websites, mobile apps, video platforms, and social media. YOUR DAY-TO-DAY: Create engaging, audience-focused content across broadcast, digital, streaming, podcasts, video, and social media. Build authentic audience relationships through compelling storytelling, creativity, and consistent brand representation. Leverage audience insights, analytics, and emerging trends to optimize content performance and audience growth. Collaborate across Programming, Digital, Promotions, Sales, Marketing, Production, and other internal teams to execute multi-platform initiatives. Embrace new technologies, evolving platforms, and changing audience behaviors while maintaining the highest standards of professionalism and compliance. Host and contribute to on-air programming while creating engaging content across digital, streaming, podcasts, video, and social media platforms. Develop, produce, edit, and publish original multimedia content, including interviews, recurring series, promotions, livestreams, branded content, and audience engagement initiatives. Serve as an on-camera personality representing the station across broadcast, digital platforms, community events, remote broadcasts, concerts, and promotional activations. Cover local events, artists, entertainment, and cultural moments by creating timely, platform-specific content that drives audience engagement. Write scripts, copy, interview questions, captions, voice-overs, promotional assets, sponsorship integrations, and other creative content supporting station initiatives. Monitor social trends, audience insights, and performance analytics to identify content opportunities and optimize audience growth. Collaborate with Programming, Promotions, Digital, Marketing, Sales, and Production teams to execute integrated content strategies and station campaigns. Operate production equipment and content creation tools while maintaining compliance with FCC regulations, company policies, and broadcast standards. Perform other duties and special projects as assigned. YOU HAVE: Experience as an on-air personality, digital content creator, influencer, or multimedia storyteller. Strong storytelling, interviewing, writing, communication, and on-camera presentation skills. Experience creating engaging content across broadcast, podcasts, streaming, video, and social media platforms. Strong understanding of audience development, digital content strategy, social platforms, and emerging trends. Experience shooting, editing, publishing, and optimizing video and multimedia content using mobile and professional production tools. Ability to interpret audience insights and analytics to improve content performance and audience engagement. Strong organizational, collaboration, project management, and time management skills. Bilingual English and Spanish preferred. Ability to work evenings, weekends, holidays, remote broadcasts, community events, and other schedules as business needs require. Reliable transportation required. #LI-ONSITE (for 100% onsite requirement) EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER TelevisaUnivision is an equal opportunity employer, dedicated to ensuring a diverse workforce by providing broad outreach to all qualified applicants regarding job vacancies at the station. job.title: Photographer I
job.description: TelevisaUnivision is seeking a dedicated, creative, and passionate full-time Photographer to join our news team. The Photographer will play an essential role in bringing stories to life by capturing compelling visuals for our news programming across live and taped events. As part of a fast-paced and collaborative team, you will work closely with reporters, producers, and other newsroom partners to deliver high-quality visual storytelling. The ideal candidate has a strong eye for compelling images, can think quickly in a dynamic environment, and is passionate about covering the stories that matter most to our community. If you can capture images that speak volumes, see beyond the lens, and bring creativity and strong storytelling instincts to every assignment, we’d love to have you on our team. YOUR DAY-TO-DAY: Shoot and edit daily news stories, breaking news, special reports and stories as assigned with or without reporter using non-linear, computer-based editing equipment. Set up, test, and operate equipment for live and recorded broadcasts, including LiveU and other mobile transmission technology. Troubleshoot technical issues in the field and communicate equipment or transmission concerns to the appropriate team. Edit materials to match script prepared by reporter, producer or associate producer using on-location facilities or any other location required. Work with reporters to get complete stories and makes suggestions on how a story should be produced. Be able to drive, operate and handle all necessary equipment and/or other equipment used in live transmissions. Keep assigned equipment and/or vehicle in good working condition and files all required paperwork, as deadlines require. Be able to work various shifts and times as well as during inclement weather. Might be required to upload video, digital pictures, and copy to the station’s website and social media. Perform routine maintenance and light troubleshooting on equipment. Assist with news production and assignment desk as assigned. Follow all station and company safety policies and procedures, particularly when operating vehicles, working around live events, or covering hazardous weather and breaking news Use sound judgment and editorial awareness when covering sensitive, fast-moving, or high-profile news events. Manage, organize, and archive video and other digital media according to newsroom and company standards. Perform other duties as assigned. YOU HAVE: College Degree or equivalent work experience in Broadcast Communications. At least 2 years’ experience in camera/editing Bilingual English/Spanish communication skills both written and oral Knowledge of editing software’s such as Avid Media Composer Knowledge I-news rundown Valid Driver’s license with clean driving record, as driving a news vehicle daily to and from stories is an essential part of the daily routine. Be able to lift heavy equipment up to 45 pounds, bend and set-up equipment for remotes to allow transmission of pictures or live from-the-scene reports back to the station. Must be able to work outdoor and inclement weather conditions. Must have unrestricted authorization to work in the United States Strong visual storytelling, composition, lighting, and audio skills. Ability to work independently and make sound decisions in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment. Strong organizational, communication, and teamwork skills. Familiarity with newsroom systems, digital platforms, and emerging technology. Ability to adapt quickly to changing assignments, priorities, and breaking news situations. YOUR BENEFITS: TelevisaUnivision believes that a happy, well-balanced employee is what makes our culture thrive. We offer a wide selection of perks and benefits including PTO; tuition reimbursement; wellness and employee support programs; 401K; and life and other insurance plans. This is all in addition to our comprehensive and competitive health benefits package featuring medical, dental and vision coverage options. #LI-ONSITE TelevisaUnivision is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to characteristics protected by law.
