job.title: Privacy Engineer
job.description: About Local Now Local Now is a free, ad-supported streaming service delivering local news, weather, sports, and lifestyle programming to viewers across virtually every connected device. As part of Allen Media Group, we operate at meaningful scale across mobile, smart TVs, streaming sticks, set-top boxes, and the web. We are now investing in a ground-up rebuild of our streaming platform with a privacy-first architecture, modern shared-code strategy, and the engineering rigor needed to grow sustainably. We build for audiences who expect frictionless playback on any device, and for advertisers who depend on us to deliver reliable, high-quality monetization. The work is tangible: every improvement we make is felt by millions of viewers. The Role We are hiring a Privacy Engineer to help build and coordinate the technical privacy posture of our streaming platform. This is fundamentally a full-stack software engineering role — one where a strong builder becomes the go-to owner of the privacy patterns, plumbing, and coordination work that make our platform trustworthy across every surface. You do not need to have spent your entire career in privacy engineering to succeed here. What we need is a capable full-stack engineer who has worked meaningfully across backend and frontend systems, cares about doing right by users, and is energized by coordinating consent, data-handling, and compliance-adjacent work across a wide array of systems. Deeper privacy specialists are very welcome to apply — but the baseline is a solid full-stack engineer with a data-and-privacy lean. What You Will Do Build and evolve consent management plumbing across our client apps and backend services — consent capture, canonical representation, propagation to services and third-party SDKs, and honoring at the edges. Contribute to the technical pipeline for data subject access requests (DSARs): intake, verification, fulfillment, and audit trail. Help maintain a living data inventory: what personal data we collect, where it lives, how it flows, and who it is shared with. Implement PII-handling patterns — data minimization, pseudonymization, retention, secure deletion — and help other engineers adopt them without needing to become privacy experts themselves. Partner with the ad-tech and monetization stack to ensure advertising signal collection, ID resolution, and downstream sharing respect user consent and applicable regulations. Review third-party SDKs and vendor integrations for privacy impact; recommend acceptance, mitigation, or replacement. Coordinate with Legal and Compliance to translate regulatory requirements (CCPA/CPRA, GDPR, VCDPA, and emerging state privacy laws) into concrete engineering work and defensible technical controls. Coordinate the privacy architecture across a wide array of systems — client apps, backend services, data pipelines, ad-tech, and vendor integrations — so that decisions in one place stay consistent everywhere else. Instrument and monitor privacy signals in production; build the tooling that lets us catch drift early and prove our posture over time. Serve as a practical advisor to feature teams so that privacy-by-design is realistic under delivery pressure. What We Are Looking For 4+ years of full-stack software engineering experience shipping production code across backend and frontend systems. Strong backend fundamentals — services, APIs, data pipelines, and storage — combined with practical frontend experience on CTV, web, or mobile. Meaningful exposure to data privacy, security, or compliance-adjacent engineering work. This does not have to be your whole career, but it should be a real thread in it. Ability to reason clearly about data flow across a distributed system: where PII enters, where it lives, where it moves, and where it leaves. Working awareness of privacy regulations (CCPA/CPRA and GDPR at minimum) and an appetite to go deeper as the role grows. Comfortable coordinating across engineering teams and with non-engineering partners (Legal, Compliance, Product). A pragmatic disposition — you can advocate for the right privacy outcome while helping the business ship. Nice to Have Prior hands-on work with consent management platforms, DSAR workflows, or data-mapping / classification tooling. Experience with privacy engineering platforms such as Fides, Ethyca, OneTrust. Background in streaming, media, ad-tech, or another consumer-scale business where user data and monetization intersect. Familiarity with connected TV and mobile SDK privacy behaviors — advertising ID handling, IDFA/AAID/RIDA, and platform-specific consent surfaces. Privacy certifications such as IAPP CIPP/US, CIPP/E, or CIPT. Comfort using AI-assisted development tooling to accelerate policy-to-code translation and data-inventory work. Allen Media Group is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to these characteristics. We are dedicated to providing a workplace free from harassment and discrimination.

job.title: Senior Ad Tech Engineer
job.description: About Allen Media Digital Allen Media Digital is the technology and engineering division of Allen Media Group, powering the ad-supported streaming platforms behind some of the most recognized names in CTV — including The Weather Channel App and Local Now, a free, ad-supported streaming service delivering local news, weather, sports, and lifestyle programming across virtually every connected device. We are investing in a ground-up rebuild of our streaming infrastructure, with a focus on engineering rigor, privacy-first architecture, and sustainable growth. The Role We are hiring a Senior AdTech Engineer to join the AdTech team within Allen Media Digital. This team provides end-to-end technical orchestration, maintenance, and strategic enhancement of the ad technology stack across our premium Connected TV applications — primarily The Weather Channel App and Local Now. In this role, you will balance optimization of our core ad-serving infrastructure, reduction of technical debt, and execution of advanced ad-related feature rollouts for a high-volume, predominantly U.S. traffic footprint. You will be a hands-on technical leader as we redesign the ad experience alongside the broader 2.0 platform rebuild. What You Will Do 2026–27 Application Redesign & Strategy — Provide technical leadership, scoping, architectural mapping, and debugging required for the holistic re-implementation of our adtech features during the upcoming full application redesign. Lead validation of advanced monetization initiatives, including interactive ad units, client-side beaconing migrations, and contextual targeting frameworks. Custom AdTech Development — Design, build, and maintain custom code across the ad-tech stack — from backend services and data pipelines to ad-decisioning logic and integration layers — ensuring our systems are reliable, scalable, and adaptable as ad formats, protocols, and vendor requirements evolve. Platform Orchestration — Serve as the primary technical lead for integrating, configuring, and managing demand-side platforms (DSPs) and supply-side platforms (SSPs). SSAI & CSAI Architecture — Design, maintain, and optimize server-side ad insertion (SSAI) workflows (using tools like AWS MediaTailor) while coordinating client-side ad framework (CSAI) requirements across core platforms like Roku (RAF) and Amazon Fire TV. Protocol & Ad Signaling Management — Configure, validate, and troubleshoot ad-decisioning endpoints using VAST, VMAP, and SCTE-35 markers to ensure precise ad stitching across live and VOD streams, including complex programmatic signaling requirements. Optimization & Performance Analytics — Monitor and analyze operational analytics — including error rates, fill latency, tracking beacons, and ad-decisioning performance — to identify and resolve bottlenecks in the ad delivery pipeline. Privacy & Consent Compliance — Maintain and enhance advertising-related privacy and consent management workflows (via tools like OneTrust), ensuring adtech compliance with CCPA/CPRA, GPP, and state-level privacy standards. Cross-Functional & Vendor Alignment — Partner closely with backend, frontend, product, and ad operations teams to advance privacy-first architecture standards. Act as the primary technical point of contact for external ad-tech vendors and DSP partners to resolve delivery discrepancies. Vendor Collaboration & Knowledge Transfer — Work alongside an external AdTech engineering partner during an active modernization engagement on our ad caching service, absorbing architecture and implementation knowledge in order to take over ongoing maintenance and enhancement. What We Are Looking For Experience 7+ years in backend / distributed-systems engineering, with at least 3–4 of those years specifically in ad tech (RTB, programmatic, SSAI). Proven experience within Connected TV (CTV) ad-serving environments and native TV platforms (Roku, Fire TV, Android TV, Smart TVs). Technical Proficiency Strong programmatic background with deep familiarity in Real-Time Bidding (RTB), header bidding, and identity resolution solutions (e.g., UID2, RampID). Hands-on experience with core AWS services, particularly AWS MediaTailor, CloudWatch, and serverless microservices (AWS Lambda, Google Cloud Run functions). Deep familiarity with leading ad servers and SSP architectures (e.g., SpringServe, Publica, FreeWheel, GAM). Mastery of video streaming protocols (HLS / DASH) and advertising standards (OpenRTB, VAST, VMAP, VPAID, SCTE-35). Experience with data-rich and contextual solutions such as identity graphs, clean rooms, Iris.TV, or Peer39. Engineering Discipline Strong programming skills in Go (Golang) and Node.js, with the ability to read, extend, and maintain existing production services in addition to building from scratch. Familiarity with Go concurrency patterns (goroutines, channels) for background and async processing. Understanding of caching and TTL design principles (invalidation strategy, key design, expiration handling) sufficient to maintain and extend an existing caching layer. Nice to Have Familiarity with cloud data pipelines, specifically ingesting and querying log data within Google Cloud Storage, S3, and BigQuery. Proficiency in C# .NET Core. Ability to accelerate front-end proofs of concept (POCs) in BrightScript or React Native to streamline deliverables for core client UI teams. Specific, hands-on experience with key ecosystem vendors: SpringServe, MediaTailor, Quickplay, The Trade Desk, LiveRamp, Amazon APS, Google (GAM/PAL), and OneTrust. Background in media-industry content management systems (CMS) and video player development (AVPlayer, ExoPlayer). Equal Opportunity Allen Media Digital is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

job.title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
job.description: Senior QA Automation Engineer Local Now | Remote (United States) About Local Now Local Now is a free, ad-supported streaming service delivering local news, weather, sports, and lifestyle programming to viewers across virtually every connected device. As part of Allen Media Group, we operate at meaningful scale across mobile, smart TVs, streaming sticks, set-top boxes, and the web. We are now investing in a ground-up rebuild of our streaming platform with a privacy-first architecture, modern shared-code strategy, and the engineering rigor needed to grow sustainably. We build for audiences who expect frictionless playback on any device, and for advertisers who depend on us to deliver reliable, high-quality monetization. The work is tangible: every improvement we make is felt by millions of viewers. The Role We are hiring a Senior QA Automation Engineer to lead the design, implementation, and scaling of our automated testing strategy as our LN 2.0 streaming platform launches and stays exceptional across every device family we ship on. You will work closely with our QA Manager and the engineering team to architect test frameworks, design test coverage, and drive end-to-end automation for a product where playback quality and ad reliability directly affect business outcomes. This is a senior individual-contributor role with high technical ownership. You will be the foundational automation lead in the new QA practice we are building, establishing the tools, standards, and pipelines that will scale with our platform. What You Will Do Architect, build, and scale maintainable test automation frameworks across mobile, connected TV (CTV) platforms, and web. Drive the test automation roadmap, establishing automation best practices, framework architecture, page-object models, and test data strategies. Integrate automated test suites directly into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Bitrise, Jenkins) for continuous regression, deployment health checks, and release gating. Test video playback (live and VOD), ad insertion (client-side and server-side), and quality-of-experience (QoE) scenarios. Test and debug API/microservice integrations for data integrity, performance, and contract validation. Validate privacy and consent flows: CMP behavior, preference persistence, DSAR-affected paths, and PII boundaries. Report bugs with the rigor that engineers actually want to read — clean repro steps, environments, logs, and severity assessment. Partner with engineering leads on triage, regression coverage, architecture reviews, and quality metrics. Contribute to a device lab strategy and solve the practical realities of automating and testing across many CTV platforms. What We Are Looking For 5+ years of QA experience on consumer software, with at least 3 years leading automation efforts on multi-platform mobile and/or CTV products. Proven track record of architecting automated test frameworks from scratch for web, mobile, or CTV using modern tools (e.g., Playwright, Appium, Detox, XCUITest, Espresso, or Robot Framework). Hands-on experience building and maintaining automated CI/CD test pipelines. Streaming video QA experience — playback, manifests, ad pods, DRM, QoE. Hands-on testing and automation familiarity on Roku, Fire TV, Apple TV, Android TV, Tizen, or Vizio platforms. Strong analytical and bug-investigation skills; able to isolate environmental, timing, and platform-specific issues. Clear written communication; excellent at writing reproducible bug reports and concise automation docs and test plans. Self-directed technical leader who thrives in a remote, distributed engineering culture. Nice to Have Experience with consent / privacy testing or compliance-driven regression suites. Hands-on experience using AI tools like Cursor and Claude to accelerate test authoring, triage, and analysis. Experience setting up physical or cloud-based device farms (e.g., AWS Device Farm, Sauce Labs, HeadSpin) for automated CTV/mobile testing.

Role Summary The Facilities Coordinator performs hands-on maintenance and supports day-to-day facilities operations at WWE's corporate headquarters in Stamford, CT. Reporting to the Facilities Senior Director, this role keeps building systems, office spaces, and on-site amenities running safely and to a high standard, and delivers responsive, white-glove support to staff and executives. This is an on-site, hourly position that requires 24x7 on-call availability and occasional after-hours and weekend work. Reports to: Facilities Senior Director Key Responsibilities Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on corporate headquarters building systems—including HVAC, electrical, plumbing, lighting, and life-safety equipment—troubleshooting and repairing MEP systems to minimize downtime and maintain operational efficiency. Handle general repairs and finishes—including drywall, painting, and carpentry—using hand and power tools. Conduct routine inspections of offices, conference rooms, common areas, and building equipment to identify maintenance needs and safety concerns. Maintain and upkeep the on-site state-of-the-art gym. Perform office reconfigurations, furniture moves, and workstation setups, manage occasional TV installations, and provide event support for executive meetings and corporate functions. Assist the Facilities Director and team with building projects, furniture installations, and space-planning projects (employee adds, moves, and changes), including updating floor and seating charts in AutoCAD. Maintain general supply orders and support inventory management by monitoring maintenance supplies, tools, and equipment—including medical, cleaning, and special-request items—to ensure operational readiness. Manage the maintenance log and CMMS / work-order system, responding promptly to facility service requests in a fast-paced corporate environment while maintaining high standards for professionalism, safety, and customer service. Read and work from blueprints and coordinate with architects and engineers as needed. Coordinate with outside vendors and contractors for scheduled maintenance, repairs, inspections, and facility improvement projects. Provide 24x7 emergency-response support for situations such as power outages, water leaks, and HVAC failures, including after-hours building issues and events. Support and monitor records management and retention Required Qualifications 3–5 years of corporate or commercial facilities maintenance experience (broadcast/media environment a plus). High school diploma or GED; trade-school training or relevant certifications a plus. Working knowledge of HVAC, electrical, and plumbing systems. Valid driver's license. Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Outlook, and Excel. Clear communication skills—able to communicate effectively with executives, peers, and team members. Strong customer-service orientation, with the ability to deliver an outstanding client experience. Self-motivated, proactive, and able to problem-solve and work both independently and as part of a team with minimal supervision, while maintaining accurate documentation. Availability for 24x7 on-call, extra hours, and weekend/after-hours work as needed. Preferred Qualifications Experience with uninterruptible power supply (UPS) systems, generators, and automatic transfer switches (ATS). Experience maintaining security panels and alarms and life-safety systems (fire panel and sprinkler systems) and supporting fire drills. Experience with a computerized maintenance management system (CMMS) or work-order platform. Experience in a broadcast, media, or entertainment corporate environment. Physical Requirements Ability to lift 50+ pounds. Ability to stand, walk, climb ladders, bend, kneel, and work in various positions for extended periods. Together, these brands and businesses produce hundreds of live events annually, serve partners across the globe, and reach hundreds of millions of fans worldwide. POSITION SUMMARY TKO is looking for a VP, Recruiting to lead talent acquisition for UFC, WWE, Professional Bull Riders (PBR), and Zuffa Boxing. Reporting to the SVP, Global Recruiting and based in Stamford, CT, this leader will manage a team of three recruiters, oversee strategic search as well as TKO’s early careers internship program. This is a role for someone who takes immense pride in their work, brings high standards, and earns a reputation as a trusted partner across the business. The VP, Recruiting will be just as comfortable building relationships on the floor of a live event as they are driving process and strategy from their desk. Presence and proximity to the businesses matter here. This person will be in Stamford 3–4 days per week, visit the NYC office frequently, and travel regularly to Las Vegas and Fort Worth to stay immersed in each business, know its leaders and employees, and maintain a pulse on the candidate market. RESPONSIBILITIES Lead the team. Manage, develop, and inspire a team of three. Set high standards. Create an environment where the team does their best work, holds themselves accountable, and takes pride in the quality and consistency of what they deliver. Set recruiting strategy. Develop and deliver recruiting strategies that align with the priorities of each business. Translate what UFC, WWE, PBR, and Zuffa Boxing need to grow into a clear, actionable talent plan. Revisit and adapt that plan as business needs evolve. Partner with the business. Serve as the primary recruiting partner for UFC, WWE, PBR, and Zuffa Boxing. Build strong, trusted relationships with hiring managers and business leaders. Stay connected to each business’s culture, priorities, and talent needs. Show up, be present, and be known. Drive results. Manage a high volume of searches without sacrificing quality. Fill roles efficiently, with the right candidates, and deliver a consistent hiring manager and candidate experience. Be measured by client feedback and satisfaction, and by the success of the people you place once they are in the building. Build programs that scale. Lead the development and adoption of a referral program across UFC, WWE, PBR, and Zuffa Boxing. Drive meaningful usage of AI recruiting tools including Findem and Paradox. Strengthen TKO’s employer brand externally and internally. Develop talent pipelines. Know the candidate market. Build and maintain relationships with top talent before the need arises. Think ahead of the business, not behind it. Lead early careers. Oversee TKO’s early careers internship program with the same rigor and client-service mindset applied to all other recruiting activity. Recruit for senior roles. In addition to leading the team, personally lead searches for senior and critical positions across the portfolio. REQUIREMENTS 10+ years of recruiting experience, with a proven track record leading teams and managing full-cycle searches across multiple business units or brands A client-service mentality. You are responsive, proactive, and treat every hiring manager interaction as an opportunity to build trust and deliver value Strong follow-up and follow-through. You close loops, update stakeholders without being asked, and never let things fall through the cracks A reputation builder. The way you work and the quality of your output speak for themselves Genuine curiosity about the businesses you support. You want to understand how UFC, WWE, PBR, Zuffa Boxing operate, who makes them run, and what talent they need to grow Experience building or significantly scaling referral programs Hands-on experience with AI recruiting tools and a drive to lead adoption across your team and business partners (experience with Findem and/or Paradox a plus) A creative problem-solving approach. You find solutions, not obstacles The ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-volume environment without letting quality slip Comfort with regular travel to Las Vegas, NV and Fort Worth, TX A bias toward presence. You understand that relationships are built in person and you show up accordingly LOCATION Stamford, CT (3–4 days per week in office), with frequent visits to the NYC office and regular travel to Las Vegas, NV and Fort Worth, TX.
